zhes pa'i thob dang cho lo gnang / zla 12pa'i tshes 2nyin/ na pho lung gas pha ri si'i hrin mo yon zhes pa'i lha khang du khri 'don gyi mdzad sgo bsdus pa dang chos kyi rgyal po pe hu'u sku phreng bdun pa'i lag nas gong ma'i dbu zhwa blangs te/rang gi mgo la bsnams nas na pho lung sku rabs dang po zhes dngos su khyab bsgragasabyas/ da dung hpha ran si spyi mthun rgyal khab de hpha ran si gong ma'i rgyal khab chen por bsgyur/ (lo rgyus steng de la hpha ran si thog dang po'i gong ma'i rgyal khab chen po'am na pho lung gong ma'i rgyal khab chen po zhes zer/)1805lo'i zla 4pa'i nang / na pho lung gis dbyin ji dang o si khru ri ya/u ru su/ na pu li si/ su'e ten sogs kyi thengs gsum pa'i hpha ran sir ngo rgol byas pa'i mnyam 'brel la 'thab pa'i 'go btsugs te/ khos lo gnyis la gra sgrig byas pa'i dbyin jir btsan 'dzul gyi 'char gzhi bskyur te/ dmag dpung gi kha lo shar phyogs su bsgyur nas mnyam 'brel dmag dang g.yul gshams par gra sgrig byas/ nyin nyi shu tsam gyi ring hpha ran si'i dmag dbyin ji li mtsho 'gag brgyud nas to'o no gtsang bor slebs/ zla bcu ba'i tshes 20nyin/ 'jar man gyi wu'u ar mu'u (6lo7)nas o si khru ri ya'i dmag mgo sgur/ hpha ran si'i dmag mu mthud du mdun bskyod byas pa dang / zla 11pa'i tshes 13nyin/ o si khru ri ya'i rgyal sa we en na blangs pa dang mnyam 'brel dmag gi dpung gtso bor rgol lan btang / zla 11pa'i tshes 12nyin mnyam 'brel dmag we en na'i byang shar phyogs kyi o li mu'u tshi (tsho༅:ṣṭhaṣṭha)zhes par phyi snar byas/ sa cha de nas u dmag lnga khri tsam dang mnyam 'dzoms byung / skabs der u ru su'i gong ma ya li hran ta sku rabs dang pos o li mu'u tshi'i lho phyogs nas hpha dmag dang 'thab dgos pa'i bka' phab/ de dus mnyam 'brel dmag brgyad khri drug stong tsam yod pa dang / hpha dmag bdun khri sum stong tsam ma gtogs med la/ da dung mnyam 'brel dmag di 6rdo sgrogs

sum brgya lnga bcu tsam yod cing hpha dmag la nyis brgya lnga bcu las med/ mi grangs dang me skyogs kyi stobs shugs bcas phyogs gang thad nas mnyam 'brel dmag gi cha rkyen hpha dmag las ches cher brgal yod pa ma zad/ u ru su'i gong mas phu ra hri'i gong mar dmag rogs byed dgos pa'i re ba bton pa dang des kyang khas len byas/ na pho lung gis sems khral gnang dgos pa'ang de yin te/ phu ra hri'i dmag bcu khri tsam thon dus hpha dmag sen bar gyi shig ltar chag nyil du gtong nges pas/ khos myur du dpung rogs ma slebs bar du mnyam 'brel dmag dang rgyal pham gyi shan 'byed rgyu'i blo thag bcad/na pho lung gis myur du dmag 'khrug byed ched kho'i stobs shugs shin tu nyams pa'i tshul bstan de mnyam 'brel dmag la mgo bskor btang / khos dmag dpon sā wa li mngags nas u'u len gong mar dmag 'khrug byed mi nyan pa'i zhu ba phul tu bcug pa dang / mnyam 'brel dam rga rṣa/sa mngags pa'i pho nya'i sngun du shin tu bla 'thor ba'i tshul bstan de gong mar mjal 'phrad gnang thub pa byung na skal ba bzang po rang red ces gnya' sgur sgur dang sgyid pa gug gug byas nas zhu ba phul ba sogs kyis pha rol por bslu brid thebs/mnyam 'brel dmag gis dngos gnas kho skrag nas bla 'thor 'dug snyam te go skabs de dang bstun nas tshar gcod byed rgyur thag bcad/ don dngos su na pho lung gi lkog g.yo legs 'grub byung ba red/zla 12pa'i tshes 2nyin gyi zhogs par/ o si the li tshi (4lo7༅cho)nas g.yul bshams pa'i 'go btsugs/ mnyam 'brel dmag gi 'char gzhi ni dmag dpung gi stobs shugs gtso bo lho phyogs su bkol de/ mtha' bskor 'gul skyod kyi thabs la brten nas hpha dmag we en na dang to no gtsang bor bskyod pa'i lam bkag nas tshar gcod bya rgyu'o// na pho lung gis kyang pha rol poX ga/34 tshung brtag dpyod 'ib mo byas pa dang pha rol po'i 'char gzhi shes

pas/ de ltar byas nas mnyam 'brel dmag gis lho phyogs nas mtha' bskor skabs dpung stobs phyed du mar btang nas re re bzhin tshar bcad na 'grig snyam/ g.yul 'khrug gi sngon nyi ma der mnyam 'brel dmag gis o si the li tshi'i nub phyogs dang phu'u la chin (rsāṣṭhaṣṭha)ri rgyud nas sā chan mtshe'u'i (9cha7)bar gyi g.yul sa bzung / na pho lung gis kyang o si khru li tshi'i nub kyi kur ti pā hi chu bo'i (༅loṣṭhakhu7)nub brgyud kho nar sgar btab nas bsdad/ khos shin tu dpa' zhum pa'i zol bstan te dmag chig khri tsam g.yas ru nas dgra bo'i 'jigs rngam ma bzod pa ltar gyis phyir 'bro khul byed du bcug pa dang / mnyam 'brel dmag gi stobs shugs gtso bo g.yon rur bsgrig tu bcug de'i dmigs yul ni pha rol po'i dmag dpung gtso bo sa'i gnas babs legs pa'i phu'u la chin nas mar 'bab tu bcug te hpha dmag gi g.yas ru'i g.yul sa len par rngam pa'i bsru brid byas pa red/ de ltar byas na mnyam 'brel dmag gi g.yon ru rjen par thon thub pa dang ru gral thag hrul bzhin nar nar gyis yong srid pas stobs shugs chen po 'don thabs med pas yin/ zla 12pa'i tshes 2nyin gyi zhogs par/ mnyam 'brel dmag gi g.yon ru'i mi ba'i khri sum stong tsam gyis hpha dmag gi g.yas rur rgol kyang /gar ti pa hi'i grog chu kyag kyog yin pas rkyen gyis mdun phyogs su mu mthud du bskyod ma thub/ de bas mdun ru'i stobs shugs nyams dmas su gyur/mnyam 'brel dmag dpon khu'u thu'u tso hphus na pho lung gis mgo bskor gtong ba shes nas dmag dpung gis nges par du phu'u la chin sa sgang 'dzin dgos pa las phar rgol byed mi nyan pa'i gros gzhi bton yang u ru su'i gong ma yid 'thad ma byung ba dang ya li hran ta sku rabs dang pos kyang khor bka' phab ste dmag myur du mar 'bab dgos zer bas/ khos ci bya gtol med kyi ngang nas de lugs bzhin sgrub/ de'i skabs der na pho lung gis mdun ru twe 6rdor spral

drag po byas pa dang mnyam du phu'u la chin sa sgang blangs/ khu'u thu'u tso rmus rang nus ci yod kyis dmag 'ga' khrid nas phyir ri ngos su 'gos kyang ma phan/na pho lung gis phu'u la chin sa sgang blangs rjes der me skyogs btsugs te mnyam 'brel dmag dkyil du bstud mar brgyab/ mnyam 'brel dmag gi g.yon ru'i bkod 'doms pa dmag dpon pu'u khe si hi rmus ci byung gi gnas tshul gsal bor ma shes par mu mthud du mdun bskyod byas/ mjug mthar mnyam 'brel dmag dpung de hpha dmag gis kha gtor nas bskor tshar 'dug la/dpung khag zang zing lang long tu gyur bas bkod 'doms byed thabs kyang ma byung / mang che ba zhig sā chan mtsho thog tu bros kyang hpha dmag gis der phyogs mdel 'phangs bas mi rta mang po 'khyags rom 'og tu nub/ thengs 'di'i g.yul 'khrug tu u ru su dang o si khru ri ya'i dmag chig khri nyis stong lhag gron pa dang / tshig khri lnga stong tsam gyis mgo 'bul byas/ khu'u thu'u tso rmu rmas pa dang gong ma gnyis kyang tog tsam min na na pho lung gi btson mar gyur/ hpha dmag gi phyogs nas dmag drug stong brgyad brgya tsam ma gtogs gron med/o si the li tshi dmag 'khrug las mnyam 'brel dmag gas hpha ran sir thengs gsum par ngo rgol byas pa pham par btang ba zhig yin la/ na pho lung gigayul 'khrug mi tshe khrod ches 'od stong 'bar ba'i rgyal kha thengs sheg kyang yin/ khos bshad rgyur 6 thengs 'dir g.yul 'khrug byas pa ngo ma legs po 'dug kho bor sngon chad thengs sum cu tsam la rgyal kha thob myong mod de ring 'dra ba zhig ma byung 9zer/ g.yul 'khrug mjug rdzogs nas chu tshod nyi shu tsam 'gor rjes o si khru ri ya'i gong mas 'dum 'grig byed pa'i re ba zhus ba dang /ye shu'i 'khrungs skar gyi nyin gnyis par hpha ran sis bton pa'i cha rkyen yongs rdzogs khas len byas/ de rjes o si khru ri ya'i gong mas 'jar man gong ma'i cho zi 'ardonā mi sprag par byas pas/ gnas mchog ro ma gong ma'i rgyal khab rtsa

med du btang /1806lo'i zla 9pa'i nang dbyin jis phu ra hri dang u ru su dpung rogs su khrid nas thengs ba'i ba'i hpha ran sir rgol ba'i mnyam 'brel btsugs/ zla 10pa'i tshes 14nyin ye na (gorsā)nas g.yul 'thab drag po byas pa dang phu ra hri'i dmag la pham nyes chen po byung / de dang dus mnyam du hpha ran si'i dmag dpon chen mo ta wu'u yon gyis or hri tha'e the (ye na'i byang phyogs na yod)nas phu ra hri'i dmag gi stobs shugs chen po pham par byas/ na pho lung gis snying rje med par mu mthud tu phu ra hri'i dmag rjes ded par/ phu ra hra'i gong ma we lan sku rabs gsum pa shar phyogs su bros byol byed dgos byung /1807lo'i zla 2pa'i tshes 8nyin/ na pho lung gis e lor (phu ra hri rgyal khab kyi byang shar na yod)nas glo bur du 'jab rgol byas pa'i u dmag kha 'thor tu btang / zla 6pa'i nang yang bskyar hpho ri ti lan (e lo'i byang shar gyi char yod)gyi nye 'gram du u dmag gi dpung chen pham pas/ u ri si gong mas hpha ran sir 'dum 'grig gi re ba mi zhu ka med byung / 1807lo'i zla 7par/rgyal khab gnyis kyis 〈ther zhi the mthun chings 〉bzhag u ru sus dbyin jir 'brel ba gcod rgyu khas len byas pa ma zad hpha ran si dang mna' mthun rgyal khab kyi 'brel ba 'dzin rgyu'ang khas blangs/1809lor/ dbyin ji'i o si khru ri ya dang mnyam 'brel byas nas hpha ran sir thengs lnga bar ngo rgol byas/ g.yul 'khrug gi khrod du o si khru ri ya'i dmag bstud mar thengs lnga la pham/ 1809lo'i zla 7pa'i nang we en na'i byang shar gyi wa ki la mu'u (7777)g.yul 'khrug khrod du hpha dmag gis o si khru ri ya'i dmag shugs gtso bo pham par byas nas/ o si khru ri yar btsan gyis chings yig 'jog tu bcug pa dang sa mtshams bcad narji da/shā gi 11na

dngul gyi skyin tshab sprod tu bcug skabs der hpha ran sis yo rob kyi mi khri tsho 7500tsam la dbang sgyur ba'in yod pa dang / sa cha kho tsho'i rgyal khab las ldab gsum gyis che bas dar che ba'i sgang yin yang / 'di ni na pho lung nyams rgud du 'gyur ba'i ltas su'ang grub/ khos yo rob hril bor dbang bsgyur ched u ru su 'dul rgyu'i sems thag bcad/1812lo'i zla 6pa'i tshes 23gyi dgong mor/ na pho lung gis dmag khri tsho drug cu tsam khrid nas ni man (2/cig)chu bo bzal te u ru su la dpung 'jug byas/ u dmag gis phyogs gsum nas lan rer 'thab cing lan rer bros pa'i tshul byas/ na pho lung gi dmag dpung u ru su'i sa thog tu slebs pa dang mi dmangs kyis ngo rgol drag po byas/ kho chos yul gru stong bar byas te mkhar grong brtan srung gi byed thabs spyad nas phyogs so so nas hpha dmag la skor bcom byas pas/ hpha dmag gis nyin mtshan kun tu dogs bon byed dgos pas dmag rnams shin tu thang chad/ de ltar hpha dmag gi grer shugs je chung du song bas na pho lung gis myur du g.yul 'khrug gi rting thag gcod bsam mod/u dmag la ji ltar dpung 'jug byas na de ltar phyir bros byed pas 'dod thog tu ma 'khel/ khos kyang sa cha ji ltar mang po blangs na de star gyis srung dmag 'jog dgos stabs dam ga dpung gi stobs shugs kha 'thor tu gyur ba dang 'bru rigs skyel 'dren thad dka' ngal byung / mdor na dgra 'chi bdag yin yang phyir sdur byed dgos pa'i dpung chen gyi 'jigs rngam de snum zad mar me'i 'od ma dngas dang 'dra ba zhig tu gyur/ya li hran ta sku rabs dang pos phyogs so po'i dmag rnams kyi stobs shugs bsdu bar spyi khyab dmag dpon 'ig bsko dgos par sems pa dang / tha mar rang nyid mi dga' ba'i khu'u thu'u tso hphu dmag gi spyi khyab dpon por mi bgi ka swāhā byung /('di'i yar sngon du u dmag la spyi khyab dpon po med/)

skabs der khu'u thu'u tso hphu ni lo drug cu re bdun can gyi rgad po zhig yin/yin na yang khor dmag don thad 'jon thang shin tu chen po yod pa dang u ru su'i mi dmangs kyis kyang re ba bcangs yod/ khos spyi khyab dmag dpon gyi 'gan 'khur rjes thog mar phyogs gnyis kyi gnas tshul la dbye dpyad zhib mo byas/ hpha dmag gi stobs shugs cung nyams yod kyang da rung dmag khri tsho btso brgyad lhag yod pas u dmag da dung de'i 'thab zlar mi yong ba shes/ de bas u dmag gi stobs shugs bskyed de go skabs legs par sgug dgos snyam/de bas khos mu mthud du u dmag phyir 'then byas pa dang lan rer 'thab pa dang skor bcom/ 'jab rgol sogs kyang byed du bcug zla 9pa'i tshes 3nyin/u dmag pa'o lu'u ti no'u la phyir 'then byas/ nyin gnyis kyi rjes su/ hpha dmag gi stobs shugs gtso gras kyang de'i lho nub kyi wa li wa zhes pa'i sa char yong srid/ skabs der khu'u thu'u tso rgyas gnas der g.yul 'gyed thengs gcig spras te kho tsho'i stobs shugs nyams rgud du gtong dgos pa'i thabs jus 'apa/ lu/ 'u ti no'u ni mo si kho dang spyi le 120tsam gyi nub kyi char yod pa dang / de'i nye 'gram gyi lam chen zhig mo si khor shar rer 'then yod/ sa'i gnas bab kyag kyog yin zhing nags tshal shin tu stug phyogs so sor ri chung 'gas bskor yod pas 'thab 'dzing ra ba zhig ched du las pa dang kun nas mtshungs/ thengs 'dir u ru su phyogs la dmag khri tsho bcu gnyis dang me phyogs drug brgya bzhi bcu yod pa dang / hpha dmag la dmag khri tsho bcu gsum dang lnga sto nga / me skyogs lnga brgya brgyad cu gya bdun yod/ khu'u thu'u tsi rmus dmag la ru gral bsgrigs/ g.yul sa ni zheng du spyi le brgyad dang ring thung spyi le bdun tsam yod/ dmag dpung gral shar gsum du bgos (gral shar dang po rkang dmag dang gnyis pa rta dmag gsum pa gra sgrig ru khapa ba~X yin/)

nas 'thab ra khrigs ser bzung / yang gcig bshad na dmag gi sum cha'i gnyis tsam gyis g.yas ru bzung yod pa dang de ltar byed don yang mo si khor 'then yod pa'i lam chen 'dzin ched yin/zla 9pa'i tshes 5nyin/ na pho lung gi dmag shugs gtso bo wa ri ye wa (79567)ru 'byor/ nyin de'i phyi dror/ na pho lung gis dmag bzhi khri tsam dang me phyogs brgya dang gya drug bkol nas dpung 'jug byas/ nyin phyed ring gi dmag 'khrug khrod hpha dmag gis u dmag gi g.yon ru'i 'thab rags gtor te kho tsho me phyogs kyi 'jigs snang las thar/ g.yul 'khrug thengs 'di ni dmag 'khrug chen mo byed par skul ba'i dmag dung gi sgra lta bu zhig go/khu'u thu'u tso spus dus tshod spyad nas myur du 'thab rags 'ga' zhig gso byas pa dang / hpha dmag gi stobs shugs gtso bo kho'i dmag gi mdun ru dang g.yon rur kha gtad nas yod pa rtogs te g.yon ru la dmag dpung rgyab snon byas/ zla 9pa'i tshes 6nyin/ phyogs gnyis kyis g.yul 'khrug byed par gra sgrig byas/ na pho lung gis nyin gang bor sa'i gnas bab la legs par brtag nas u dmag gi g.yon rur rgol rgyu dang de dang dus mnyam du mdun rur dpung 'jugakhyed rgyu byas/ glo bur du g.yon ru la rgol na dgra bo phyogs gnyis su 'thor 'gro ba dang phyi bshol gyi lam 'gog thub pa ma zad/ mo si kho chu bo dang kho lu'u khra chu bo'i bar rtsa med du gtong thub snyam ste/ dmag gi stobs shugs gtso bo g.yas ru la bzhag zla 9pa'i tshes 7nyin gyi zhogs pa'i chu tshod lnga'i stong g.yul 'khrug gi 'go bcoms/ hpha dmag gis dus tshod drug ring phar rgol byas kyang thengs bdun la phyi snar byed dgos byung / mtha' mar na pho lung gis dmag bzhi khri dang me phyogs bzhi brgya phyogs gcig tu bsdus te thengs diḥ/ par phar rgol byas/ phan tshun g.yul 'dres pa dang mi'i ki sgra

dang / rta'i rmig sgra/ me skyogs kyi sgra sogs kyis gnam sa 'gul ba lta bu zhig bzos mthar/ u dmag gi gral shar gsum po gcig mjug gnyis mthud du pham pas/ pa'o lu'u ti no'u ( ༅77)g.yul sa rang 'gul gyis bskyur dgos byung/ snga gzhug tu chu tshod bcu gnyis tsam gyi ring 'khrugs nas da gzod mtshams bzhagathengs 'dir na pho lung la rgyal kha thob yod na yang / kho la mtshon na thob pa las shor ba mang ba'i g.yul 'khrug cig yin/ rgyu mtshan ni hpha dmag sum khri tsam gyi tshe srog shor ba dang phul byung dmag dpon bzhi bcu lhag gron/u dmag gis kyang dmag nyis khri lnga stong lhag dang phul byung dmag dpon nyi shu tsam gron yod/ g.yul 'khrug gi rjes nas pa'o lu'u ti no'u g.yul sa nas phyogs gnyis kyi dmag gi bem po 585000tsam dang rta ro 35400tsam mer bsregs/ u ru su'i snyan ngag pa chen po le man tha'o rmus u dmag gi snying stobs la bstod tshig 'di ltar bris myong /nyin der/dgra bos u dmag dpa' bo'i snying stobs nyongs//phan tshun g.yul bsres khrag gi yur chu bzhur//sa chen bdag gi brang khog ji bzhin du//g.yo 'dar ngang nas dar cig lus te 'khums//me phyogs khri stong khros pa'i ngar sgra yis//mi rta mang po zang zing lang long bzos//bar mtshams med pa'i skyogs mdel rdzas dud kyis//tshe srog ci tsam 'phrog pa su yis rtogs//snang byed dngangs ma 'dar gyis nub rir bros//mun pa'i gos kyis 'dzin ma bklubs na yang //

rgyal pham phu thag gcod pa'i sang nyin ched//u dmag dpa' bo sta gon las su zhugs//hpha dmag la phyogs gang ci'i thad nas kyang gnas bab legs po yod pas/ khu'u thu'u tso drus da dung dgra bo'i do zla min pa shes nas dmag khrid nas mu mthud du shar phyogs su phyi bshol byas pa dang / mo si kho bskyur rgyu thag bcad/ khos bshad rgyur 6 mo si kho dgra lag tu shor yang u ru su rgyal khab da dung pham med/ yin yang dmag don gyi nus pa nyams na da gzod u ru su nyams srid ’ ces bshad/ mo si kho'i sdod 'bangs mang po zhig kyang dmag dpung dang mnyam du bskyod pa dang lhag ma me la btang / mo si kho'i khang pa sum khri tsam las lnga stong ma gtogs tshang ma 'ig ral du btang tshar/ na pho lung gi dmag gis nyin so lnga lhag gi ring mkhar der ngal cigaso byas/ u ru sus rgyal pham gyi shan myur du ma 'byed pa dang 'dum 'grig gi re ba'ang dang len ma byas pas/ na pho lung gi dmag la 'bru rigs sogs dmag gi mkho chas kyis ma 'dang ba'i khar nad yams shig kyang byung bas stobs shugs je 'an nas je zhan du gyur/ lhag par u dmag la rjes 'ded btang yang thengs mang por pham/ grang ngar che ba'i gangs ri zhig brgal nas pe li cin nā (1/1sto//dzipo)chu bor bskyod skabs/ ki sa khe (697)rta dmag dang thug nas pham kha chen po nyos/ mtha' mar dmag gi lhag ma nyis khri bdun stong tsam yod pa u ru su dang kha bral nas bros/ de nas 1812lor na pho lung gis u ru su la dpung 'jug byas pa pham nas mjug rdzogs/1813lo'i zla 3pa'i nang / na pho lung pham pa'i go skabs 'di bzung nas yo rob rgyal khab so sos yang bskyar thengs drug par hpha ran sir ngo rgol byerji pas 7)nyaspra 'brel dmag rtsa 'dzugs byas/ zla 10pa'i tshes 17nas

19bar/ na pho lung gi dmag dang mnyam 'brel dmag gis le pi zhi (lkog:ṣṭha)zhes pa nas g.yul 'khrug byas/ phyogs gnyis la dmag khri drug cu tsam yod pa dang mnyam 'brel dmag hpha dmag las ldab gcig gis mang / g.yul 'khrug gi skabs su na pho lung gi mna' mthun rgyal khab sa khe san (tshimarsā)gyi dmag gis glo bur du ngo log pas hpha dmag la pham nyes chen po byung /1814lo'i stod du/ mnyam 'brel dmag khri tsho gya lnga tsam hpha ran si'i mtha' mtshams brgal nas bskyod pa dang / zla 3pa'i tshes 31nyin pha ri sir 'byor te na pho lung sa dbus rgya mtsho'i er pa (khyalo3)gling phran du btson bkag byasayod tshul bsgrags te po pang rgyal rabs (ṣṭha༅17)slar gso byas/1815lo'i zla 2pa'i tshes 26nyin gyi dgong mor/ na pho lung gis dmag chig stong lnga bcu tsam khrid nas gru bdun la bsdad de dbyin phe'i lta rtog dmag la thabs shes kyis g.yol nas song ste/ zla 3pa'i tshes 1nyin hpha ran si'i ros an (ṣṭhaṣṭha)gru kha nas skam sar 'gos/ zla 3pa'i tshes 20nyin gyi dgong mo chu tshod dgu'i steng pha ri ser 'byor/ khos mde'u gcig gi 'gro sgo yang ma btang bar gong ma'i rgyal khab phyir blangs pa dang / po pang rgyal rabs kyi rgyal po lu'u ye sku rabs bco brgyad pa mtha' mtshams su bros/we en nar gros tshogs 'tshog bzhin pa'i yo rob rgyal khab so so'i 'go khrid pas gnas tshul de thos ma thag myur du thengs bdun par hpha dmag la ngo rgol byed rgyu'i mnyam 'brel btsugs/ na pho lung gis kyang dmag khri tsho nyi shu tsam khrid nas dgra bo'i mdun bsus/ phyogs gnyis kyis per krem gyi go the lu'u ( ṣṭha7)nas ches mtha' mjug gi rgyal pham thag bcad pa red/go the lu'u ni pu ru ser (rkos lo)lho phyogs kyi spyi le 20sar yod/ na pho lung gis tshod dpags byas pa ni zla 7pa'i tshes 1bar du mnyam 'brel — 173 —

dmag gis gra sgrig byas mi tshar bas thog mar phu ra hri dang dbyin ji'i dmag gi ngar shugs med par gtong dgos snyam/ zla 6pa'i tshes 16nyin/ phu ra hri dmagadapon pu li zhe yis sne drangs pa'i dmag len nyi'i (lo7)phyogs su pham pa ma zad/ na pho lung gis dmag dpon ki lu'u zhi dang dmag sum khri sum stong tsam mngags nas phu ra hri dmag gi rjes 'ded dgos pa'i bka' phab/ yin na yang dmag dpon pu li zhe la 'thab rtsal sna tshogs shig yod pas rjes ma chod/ zla 6pa'i tshes 18nyin/ dbyin tha'i dmag go the lu'u lho phyogs kyi man hrin reng ( cha1 1)ri 'dabs nas thug na pho lung gi sems su ki lu'u zhis nges par rgyal kha blangs yod snyam nas ri 'dabs kyi sa'i gnas bab legs shos de rtsod len ma byas/ nyin gung g.yul 'khrug gi 'go brtsams/ na pho lung gis we lan tun gyi g.yon rur phar rgol byas nas dbyin ji dang 'jar man gnyis kha gtor dgos bsam mod/ dbyin dmag gi ru gral dam zhing ngar gyis gdong len ma thub/ chu tshod bzhi tsam gyi ring g.yul 'khrug byas pas dbyin dmag shin tu thang chad pa dang phal cher mgo 'bul byed la nye dus/ glo bur du phu ra hri'i dmag dpon pu li zhe yi dpung de hpha dmag gi mdun ru nas thon pa dang / be lan tun dmag gis go skabs der bltun nas myur du brgol bas hpha dmag pham/ thengs 'dir chu tshod nyer bzhi'i ring dmar 'dzing byas pa dang g.yul sar hpha dmag gi bem po nyis khri lnga stong tsam dang mnyam 'brel dmag gi bem po nyis khri nyis stong tsam yod/ rmas ma grangs las 'das shing dngos gnas mi ro ri bo ba'in dang mi khrag yur chu bzhin no// ya nga ba'i g.yul sa'i rnam pa 'dis we lan tun gyi mig chu dbang /tā trī trī sdo/ nas bshad rgyur/ 6 rgyal kha ni pham kha'i 'phro yi ches che ba'i skyo — gatta~X 'di'i g.yul 'khrug gi rkyen gyis/ sngon chad kyi go the lu'u ri bo de

da lta ming grags che ba'i ljongs rgyu lta skor gyi gnas shig tu grub yod/ ri rtser ljid tshad tun nyer brgyad can gyi lcags kyi seng ge zhig bzhings yod pa dang /de'i g.yu ral gsigs shing mche gtsigs sder bgrad kyis khros pa'i mig zung shar lho'i phyogs su gtad yod/ ri gsham gyi rten rdzas bshams mdzod khang du 'thab 'khrug gi ri mo yongs rdzogs dang yo byad sogs mang po bshams yod/go the lu'u g.yul 'khrug gis na pho lung gi chab srid 'tsho bar rdzogs tshig bkod/ 1821lo'i zla 5pa'i nang / mtshan snyan shin tu che ba'i na pho lung san her li na (cha 7rsā)zhes pa'i gling phran du tshe 'phos/na pho lung gis 1799nas 1815bar du srid bzung zhing / kho'i chab srid kyi 'tsho ba yongs rdzogs ni phyi phyogs kyi g.yul 'khrug dang 'brel nas yod/khos hpha ran si'i gsar brje'i me dpung las mched pa'i mi rigs kyi stobs shugs bkol ba dang zhing ba'i dmag dpung bsdus nas yo rob skam sa'i thog 'gran zla med par gyur yod/ yin na yang kho'i dam ga dpung la btsan 'dzul gyi rang bzhin dang 'phrog bcom gyi ngo bo'ang ldan/ de'i stabs kyi yo rob kyi mis ngo rgol byas pa dang hpha ran si nang khul du'ang 'gal ba byung yod/ ma'o tse tung gis tsa na pho lung gi chab srid 'tsho ba go the lu'u nas mjug rdzogs/thengs de'i thag gcod rang bzhin gyi g.yul 'khrug ni mo si kho nas pham pa de red mi ces gsungs/ dmag 'khrug khrod 'tshar long byung pa'i na pho lung dmag 'khrug khrod grongs pa dang / na pho lung gong ma'i rgyal khab kyang rim gyis nyams par gyur ro//

sa gnas dpa'a'aboskosdebs55ngas kyis/dadus shar sa khul thob la rtsod/khe li mu'u (mtshorko)g.yul 'khrugadus rabs bcu dgu pa'i dus dkyil du/ dbyin ji dang hpha ran si/ u ru su sogs kyis shar phyogs sa khul du rgya bskyed/ kho tshos pha le si than (2163 1 ba0༅cakyi〉sko73)gyi 66gnas mchog mi ste/ ce ru sa lem bdag skyong byed dbang rtsod len byas pas khe li mu'u g.yul 'khrug byung / (1853 —1856)'di ni na pho lung gong ma'i rgyal khab 'jig rjes kyi gzhi rgya ches che ba'i 'dzam gling gi g.yul 'khrug cig red/ 2 gnas mchog mi de skabs der o si man tur ki'i mnga' khongs su yod/66gnas mchog mi rtsod len gyi rgyab ljongs ni yo rab kyis o si man tur ki'i shul ba'ag gi rgyu nor 'phrog 'dod pa de yin/ de'i stabs kyis tsa gnas mchog mi rtsod len de don dngos su tur ki dbang du bsdu rgyu de yin/ 'o na nga tshos u ru su'i gong mas mngags pa'i sku drag men hri kha'o hphu zhes pa tur gir bskyod pa nas 'go brtsams te gleng bar bya/1853lo'i zla 2pa'i nang / u ru su'i gru chen zhig tur ki'i rgyal sa con hri than ten pa'o mkhar gyi phyogs su skyod bzhin yod/ gru steng du lus stobs rgyas shing rdzog nyams che ba'i mi zhig langs yod pa dang / gzhogs gnyis su srung dmag gnyis gus pa'i nyams dang bcas langs yod/ rdzog nyams che ba'i mi de'i ngo gdong du smra mi shes pa'i spro snang zhig gis khengs yod la/ de ni thengs /snyi/ spra rang pho nyar mngags pa'i rkyen gyis los yin/ kho ni u ru

su'i gong ma nyi ku'u la sku rabs dang po'i blon chen nam mtsho dmag gi dmag dpon chen po men hri kha'o hphu zer ba de yin/ kho 'di ltar bskyod pa la tur ki'i srid gzhung gi sems ma bde kem kem du yod pa dang / yo rab nas kyang gtam gleng 'dra min sna tshogs byed bzhin 'dug1825lo'i zla 12par/ u ru su'i gong ma ya li hran ta sku rabs dang po glo bur du sku gshegs pas sku drag dmag dpon gzhon pa 'gas rgyal rgyud 'dzin par nang 'khrug byas/ de ni u ru su'i lo rgyus steng ming du grags pa'i zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshogs pa'i 'os langs zhes pa de yin/ ya li hran ta'i nu bo nyi ku'u las zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshogs pa'i 'os langs pa dmar gsod byas te kho rang rgyal khrir bzhugs/ skabs de nas u ru su'i lo rgyus steng ches gdug rtsub ldan pa'i dbang sgyur gyi 'go brtsams pa red/ khos snying rje med par gsar brje'i mgo mnon rgyu dang / 66gsar brje de gang nas langs pa'am ci'i phyir langs par bsam blo mi gtong ཿzhes chod sems bcangs/khos sems na don gzhan zhig yod pa ni tur ki'i sa cha ham bzung byas nas pa'o si phu'u lu'u si ( lorsā lo)mtsho 'gag blangs nas/ u ru su'i lho phyogs nas sa dbus rgya mtsho'i lam phye rgyu de red/1848lor yo rob du gang sar gsar brje'i las 'gul langs pa dang /bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi sku drag tsho rim gyis khri thog nas lhung / yin na yang / u ru su'i gong ma nyi ku'u la sku rabs dang pos u ru su'i dpung chen la kha lo bsgyur te yo rob gsar brje las 'gul gyi mgo mnan pas/ skabs der khong ni yo rob hril bo'i spyi gtsug tu bkur yod/ khos nga rgyal gyis sna mu ru su'i sku drag ni yo rob kyi bdag po yin pas rgyal khab sus kyang nga tsho'i bgrod lam la bkag 'gog byed mi thub mi ces bsgrags/ de nas khos rgyal rabs gong ma rnams kyis tur ki dbang du bsdu ba'i rmi lam mngon spragyu/ 7ཿda tshogo

brtsams/ yin yang g.yu la 'khrug byed par kha g.yar sa zhig nges par du dgos pas/ don de men hri kha'o spru la sgrub tu bcug1853lo'i zla 2pa'i 28nyin/ men hri kha'o tru con hri than ten pa'o mkhar la 'byor/ tur ki'i 'go khrid par mjal 'phrad gnang dus 'go khrid pa pho brang phyi rol du bsu ma byed du yong dgos pa'i re ba zhus/ don 'dir khas len ma byas pas sdang sems chen po skyes/ zla 3pa'i tshes 2nyin/ kho tur ki'i 'go khrid pa dang mjal 'phrad gnang skabs/ gus 'dud zhu ba phar zhog gus chas kyang spras med par zhwa mo zur gyon byas yod pa dang skad cha bshad skabs kyang rnam 'gyur shin tu rtsub cing gtum drag gi rang gshes mngon/mjal 'phrad gnang tshar dus/ tur ki'i srid 'dzin nga shis gis kho rang tshogs khang chen mor phyin te phyi 'brel gyi don gros sdur zhu rgyu'i re ba zhus kyang /khos ma mthong ba'i tshul gyis kha ya ma byas par 'khor lor bsdad de thad kur u ru su'i gzhung tshab khang du shar rer song / skabs de'i dbyin ji'i lo rgyus smra ba zhig gis/ 6 kho'i steng du phyi 'brel pa'i grub cha las dmag mi'i grub cha shin tu mang / gtum drag dang nga rgyal gyis khengs yod la kho ni rtsod ga'i la me spar du yong ba'i mi zhig los yin snyam :zhes gdengs 'jog byas yod/dngos gnas de lta bu zhig yin te/ kho tur ki la 'byor rjes su'u tan srid gzhung la phyi 'brel yig cha zhig btang nas/ su'u tan srid gzhung gis tur ki'i mnga' khongs su yod pa'i shar phyogs chos lugs kyi dbang char khag theg byed dgos pa ma zad/ ce ru sa lem gyi pa'o li han lha khang gi lde mig u ru su'i do dam pa'i lag tu sprod dgos zer/ zla 3pa'i tshes 22nas 24bar/men hri kha'o rmus yang bskyar snga gzhug tu phyi 'brel yig cha gnyis btang ste/66yu ru su gong ma'i rgyal khab kyi re ba ni cha rkyen med pa'i 'og bton pa yin zheng ba/shāḥ/ tram̐ dang dus mnyam du u ru sus dmag don la shugs bsnan/

da dung zla 2pa'i tshes 28nyin/ men hri kha'o hphu con hri than ten pa'o mkhar la 'byor ba'i nyin der/ mtsho nag gi dmag gru'i spyi khyab dmag dpon khor nyi lo hphu zhes pa ke ri si'i chu'i khongs su brtag dpyad byed par kha g.yar te/ u ru su'i 4 pe sa la pe si mi rtags can gyi dam ga gru mar ma la (6767)mtsho mor kha lo bsgyur nas/ tur ki'i mtsho'i 'gog srung gi gnas tshul blangs/ skam sa nas u ru sus dmag pe sa la pe ya (669766༅)dang phu'u lu'u thig gtsang 'gram du mnyam 'dzoms bya rgyur shugs bsnan/ zla 5pa'i 'gor/ u ru su'i dmag don gyi bya bzhag yongs su legs 'grub byung /zla 5pa'i tshes 3nyin/ u ru su srid gzhung nas tur ki'i srid gzhung la yi ge bskur nas/ men hri kha'o kyu'i re ba dag cha rkyen med pa'i 'og khas len byed dgos/ gal te de bzhin ma sgrub na drag chas bkol rgyu yin zhes zer/u ru su'i 'jigs sna nga gi 'og tu tur gis kho tsho'i bton pa'i 6 gnas mchog ’ dang 'brel ba'i re ba mtha' dag khas len byas mod/ men hri kha'o hphus kyang shar phyogs chos lugs kyi sku drag dang blon 'bangs mtha' dag la u ru sus bdag skyong byed dgos pa'i re ba bton pa ma zad/ nyin bzhi'i nang lan ster dgos par bshad/ de ltar ma sgrub na rgyal khab gnyis kyi phyi 'brel 'brel ba gcod rgyu yin zhes bsgrags/ de ltar byas pas mi rnams kyis da gzod u ru su'i dmigs yul gsal bor rtogs pa red/u ru su'i ches mtha' mjug gi tha tshig 'jigs snang khrod/ tur gis phyogasagacig nas dbyin ji dang hpha ran sir rgyab skyor byed dgos pa'i re ba zhus pa dang / phyogs gzhan nas dgam 'khrug mi 'byung ba'i las su brtson pa byas/ tur gis gdan zhus ltar men hri kha'o hphu zla 5pa'i tshes 13nyin gyi tshogs 'dur zhugs rgyu yid 'thad byung / yin yang kho bsam bzhin du rjes su lus bcug pa dang / de nas thad kur su'u tan pho brang du song na17 /da/ zhu

yi ge ltar khyod dang don zhig gros mol byed dgos zer ba sogs shin tu bab col gyi bya ba mang po las pas/ tur ki'i blon chen tshos u ru su'i cha rkyen dang len mi byed rgyu'i re ba gong mar zhus/ de'i rjes nas dbyin hpha srid gzhung gi rgyab skyor 'og u ru su'i cha rkyen dag dang len ma byas/1853lo'i zla 5pa'i 21nyin/ men hri kha'o tru phyir u ru sur bskyod/kho 'gro khar 6 thengs 'dir spyir btang gi lwa ba gyon nas bcar 'drir 'ong ba yin/ rjes mar dmag lwa gyon nas phyir 'byor srid/mi ces bshad/ nyin 'di nas bzung u ru su dang tur ki gnyis kyi 'brel ba chad/ men hri kha'o hphu dga' lhang lhang gis phyir bskyod pa dang gong ma'i gsol ras chen po bstsol rgyur sgug yod/ thengs 'di'i dmag 'khrug ni u ru su byo sas gcig dang /tur ki dang dbyin ji/ hpha ran si gsum phyogs gcig yin/ g.yul 'khrug byed sa ni khe li mu'u zhes pa'i sa de yin pas/ lo rgyus steng de la tsa khe li mu'u g.yul 'khrug mi zer/ da dung tur ki ni yo rob kyi shar na yod pas lha shar phyogs g.yul 'khrug ’ kyang zer/ tur ki la mtshon na btsan 'dzul par ngo rgol byed pa'i dmag 'khrug cig yin la/ u ru su dang dbyin ji/ hpha ran si sogs la mtshon na pa ar kun (312shed)sa khul dang mtsho nag ham 'dzin byed pa'i drang bden ma yin pa'i dmag 'khrug cig yin/1853lo'i zla 7pa'i tshes 3nyin/ u ru sus dmag dpung tur gis mnga' khongs kyi rgyal phran mor to wa (ṣṭhalo77)dang wa la ci yar (777krokhru)zer ba'i rgyal phran gnyis la 'byor/ tur gis u dmag phyir 'then byed dgos par bshad kyang ma nyan/ zla 10pa'i tshes 16nyin tur gis kyang g.yul bshams pa dang / g.yul 'khrug gi thog dang po'i yol ba ni zhi no'u phu'u (khro rmejohā )mtsho mo'i 'thab 'khrug nas phyes/— 1//3lo'i zla 11pa'i tshes 17nyin/ u ru su'i mtsho dmag dmag

dpon na zhi mo spus khrid pa'i u ru su'i mcho dmag ru khag cig gis tshong rdzas skyel 'dren pa cig gi kha nas gtam thos pa ni tur ki'i dmag gru zhi no'u phu'u mtsho mor slebs 'dug zer/ zla 11pa'i tshes 20nyin/ gong gi dmag dpon de 'i no'u phu'u mtsho mo bskyod nas tur ki'i gru'i gnas tshul la brtag dpyad 'tshol zhib nyin bcu'i ring la byas te/ zla 11pa'i tshes 30nyin tur ki'i dmag grur phar rgol byas/ u ru su'i dmag la me skyogs bdun brgya lhag yod pa dang / tur ki'i dmag la me phyogs lnga brgya bcu las med/ stobs shugs sogs gang ci'i thad nas u ru sur 'gran zla med/ phyogs gnyis kyis dus tshod bzhi tsam ring la g.yul 'khrug byas pa dang / dbyin ji nas mngags pa'i 66tha ye blu rtags can gru bros pa shin tu mgyogs pa'i rjes ma zin/ de min tur ki'i gru bco lnga tsam gtor ba dang dmag sum stong tsam gyi srog shor/nyis brgya tsam bzung / u ru su'i phyogs nas kyang gru 'ga' chag skyon byung yod la dmag nyis brgya tsam gron yod/u ru su la zhi no'u phu'u mtsho mo'i g.yul 'khrug gi rgyal kha thob pas/dbyin phos tur ki'i khe phan gnyer bar 'jigs snang chen po zhig byin/ u ru su'i stobs shugs lho phyogs su bskyed par bkag 'gog byed ched/1854lo'i zla 1po'i tshes 4nyin/ dbyin hpha mnyam 'brel dmag gru pa'o si phu'u lu'u si ( losdo lo)mtsho 'gag brgyud nas mtsho nag tu bskyod pa dang /u ru su'i dmag gru mtsho nag tu yong mi chog par bsgrags/ 1854lo'i zla 3pa'i tshes 12nyin/ dbyin hpha dang tur ki gsum gyis mnyam 'brel chings yig bzhag zla 3pa'i tshes 27dang tshes 28nyin la/ dbyin phos snga gzhug tu u ru sur dmag 'khrug byed rgyu bsgrags/ g.yul sa'ang phyogs so so nas rgya bskyed pa red/ sngar gyi to no gtsang po dang mtsho nag ko cwa su'u ( mebalko)phud pa las gzhan/ dbyin pho'i dmag gru da rung pa'o lu'u zitsho /stumi/chu)

dang mtsho dkar/ khan tsha cwa (70meb)gling phyed kyi shar rgyud na yod/1854lo'i zla 8pa nas bzung / khe li mu'u (༅༅rko)gling phyed g.yul sa gtso bor gyur/ yin yang ches mtha' mjug gi rgyal pham shan 'byed sa ni se wa si tho phor (677677)yin/khe li mu'u gling phyed ni mtsho nag gi dkyil du yod pa dang / gling phyed lho nub tu gru kha'am 'gag btsan po se wa si tho phor yod/ de ni 1784lor bskrun pa dang u ru su'i mtsho nag gi 'gag sgo gtso bo yin/1854lo'i zla 9pa'i tshes 14nyin/ dbyin hpha dang tur ki'i mnyam 'brel dmag khe li mu'u gling phyed kyi ye rmu pa'o tho li ya (༅lko khye64༅)skam sar 'gos/ mnyam 'brel dmag la thog mar dmag dru khre lhag yod pa dang /1855lor dpung rogs mang po 'byor bas dmag khri tstsha bcu bdun la slobs/u ru sur thog mar dmag sum khri lhag yod pa dang rjes nas dpung rogs 'byor yang khri tsho bcu gcig lhag las med/ dmag don gyi phyogs nas mnyam 'brel dmag gi gnas bab legs po yin/ u ru sus spyod grwa 'i me mda' thag ring du mi slobs pa dang nus pa yang zhan/ 'bru rigs sogs dmag gi mkho chas skyel mkhan yang zhing ba dag las thon pa'i shing rta yin pa dang / de'i khar char babs nas lam gyi 'dam rdzab las ma thar bas/ dus ltar mkho chas skyel 'dren bya ma thub rkyen rmas dmag mang po skyob thabs ma byung / mnyam 'brel dmag gi drag chas sngon thon yin pa'i khar/ mkho chas skyel byed me 'khor yin/ dbyin hpha dang tur ki'i mnyam 'brel dmag mtsho 'gram gyi byang nas lho phyogs su mdun skyod byas pa dang / ar mā chu bo'i ( 7lo65 4)'gram nas g.yul 'thab drag po zhig byas par/ u ru su'i dmag la pham nyes chen po byung ba dang / mtsho dmag gi spyi khyab dmag dpon men hri kha'o rmu la bla 'thor sdo zlocu1 pas/ khos myur du dmag dpung phyir 'then byas/ zla 9pa'i

tshes 25nyin/ mnyam 'brel dmag se wa si tho phor du 'byor/ ming du grags pa'i se wa si tho phor bskor pa'i dmag 'khrug gi 'go brtsams pa dang nyin 349ring g.yul 'khrug byas/u dmag gis se wa si tho phor dam por srung yod/ 1855lo'i zla 6pa'i nang ma/nyam 'brel dmag gis phar rgol byed rgyur thag bcad/ zla 6pa'i tshes 18nyin/ dbyin dmag g.yon dang hpha dmag g.yas su bgos te phar rgol byas/mi lo bzhi bcu'i yar sngon gyi na de ni na pho lung go the lu'u nas pham pa'i nyin yin phyir/ hpha ran sis gong mas (na pho lung gi tsha bo )dmag dpon le zhi e la bka' phab nas de ring khu bo'i sha 'khon len ched dmar 'dzing chen po byed dgos par skul/ yin na yang / 'thab 'khrug gi go rim 'khrug pas rgyal kha ma lon par dmag phyir 'then byed dgos byung / mnyam 'brel dmag lnga stong tsam dang u ru su'i dmag bdun stong tsam gron song ba red/zla 7pa'i tshes 10nyin/ u ru su'i mtsho dmag gi 'go khrid gtso bo zhe mo spru la mnyam 'brel dmag gi mda' phog nas shi/ zla 8pa'i nang / g.yul 'khrug gi 'go yang bskyar brtsams/ mnyam 'brel dmag gi me stogs kyis nyir rer u ru su'i dmag nyis stong nas sum stong tsam gyi tshe srog 'phrog de bas u ru su'i dgra 'gog gi nus pa rim gyis zad de rgyal pham phu thag gcod pa'i nyin bsu ba dang 'dra'o//zla 9pa'i tshes 5nyin/ mnyam 'brel dmag gis thengs drug par phar rgol byas/ 'di ni ches mtha' mjug gi phar rgol yang yin/ me sbyogs bdun brgyas bstud mar nyin gsum ring phar rgol byas pas/ phyogs mdel khri bco lnga tsam tshar ba dang / u ru su'i dmag rags phal cher gtor/ tshes 8nyin/mnyam 'brel dmag drug khri tsam gyis phar rgol byas pas/ u dmag bzhi khri lhag gron/ mtha' mar mnyam 'brel dmag gas 'gag tshang ma bladi13/ —

thangs 'da' g.yul 'khrug tu u ru su'i dmag lnga 'bum nyis khri gnyis stong lhag gron yod pa dang / dpal 'byor thad ru'u pe dung phyur brgyad kyi gyong gud byung yod/ mnyam 'brel dmag la'ang pham nyes chen po byung yod pa dang / tur ki'i dmag 400000tsam dang / hpha ran si'i dmag 95000/dbyin ji'i dmag 22000bcas gron yod/khe li mu'u g.yul 'khrug ni dus rabs 19pa'i lo rgyus don chen 'ig yin/g.yul 'khrug mjug rdzogs rjes/ u ru su'i gong ma yo rob skam sa'i bdag 'dzin gyi khri kha nas lhung ba dang / u ru su'i nang khul nas kyang gsar brje'i las don mtshams med du 'phyur bas/ 1861lor zhing bran lam lugs la bcosasgyur mi byed ka med byung / u ru sus shar phyogs su ma nga 'a khongs rgya bskyed par gnod skyon thebs na'ang / da dung ham sems kyi me lce ga'il ma thub par a she ya du lag pa rkyong 'go bcoms/ lhag par ya 'i ya 'bring ba dang krung go'i sa char 'dod ham gyi mig zung bgred/ji / sto chi 1 ma gcichi —— — ———sku chos ri / mur dmag gi mā la ho pho'o ri bo'i phyogs stegs/— 184 —

mi rigasalangs kyis dbyin jir rto rgol gyi g.yul 'khrugawa wa1857wa 1859lo'i rgya gar mi rigs kyi 'os langs chen mo/1498lor ta nā mas yo rob nas rgya gar la bskyod pa'i mtsho lam yod pa rtogs rjes/ phor ju ghal gyi mi rgya gar la slebs/ kho tsho ni rgya gar la ches thog mar skyod mkhan gyi yo rob mi yin/ dus rabs 17par slobs dus/dbyin ji dang hpha ran sis kyang rim bzhin phor ju ghal gyi dbang cha med par bzos pa dang / rgya gar bdag 'dzin byed ched phan tshun g.yul 'khrug kyang byas/ 1756—1763lo'i bar gyi lo bdun ring gi g.yul 'khrug tu dbyin jis hpha ran si pham par byas pa dang dus mnyam du rgya gar la btsan 'dzul byas/ 1757lo'i zla 6pa'i tshes 23nyin/ dbyin dmag sum stong tsam gyis ka le ka ta'i (mebapoṣṭhaṣṭha)byang phyogs kyi spyi le lnga'i char yod pa'i phu'u la zhi (rsā /1tugre)sde ba nas rgya gar dmag dang g.yul 'khrug byas/ rgya gar la dmag grangs drug khri brgyad stong tsam yod na'ang sgrig lam lhod cing nang khul du 'gal ba che ba sogs kyis pham/ dbyin jis bhang ga la (2322186636)blangs/ phu'u la zhi g.yul 'khrug ni dbyin jis rgya gar dbang du bsdu ba'i thog ma'i mtshon byed du grub/ dus de nas dbyin jis bhang ga la lte ba byas te/ mu mthud du mtsho thog dang skam sa nas btsan 'dzul byas/ dus rabs 19bar slobs dus rgya gar ni dbyin jis dbang du bsdus tshar ba dang / rgyu nor tshang ma dbyin ji'i phyogs su 'dren 'go brtsams/dus rabs bcu dgu ba'i dus dkyil du/ dbyin ji'i bzo las gsar brje'i mjug rdzogs pa dang bzo las ma rtsa'i dbang bsgyur gnas bab gtan 'khel byas/ bzo las 'byor ldan gral rim gyi re ba ni rgya che ba'i /rdo ḍi dang

rgyu cha'i thon yul/ nyo tshong rang dbang bcas yin pas/ sngar las lhag par rgya gar mi ser spel ba'i dbang bsgyur dang dpal 'byor ham 'phrog byas pa red/ gna' bo'i 'dzam gling na ming du grags pa'i sring bal 'khel 'thag las rigs kyi rgyal khab chen po rgya gar gyi tshong ra na dbyin ji'i sring skud dang sring bal dngos rdzas kyis khengs yod pa ma zad/ da dung lcags rigs dang shel sgo/ shog bu sogs kyis kyang khengs yod/ de bas rgya gar gyi lag rtsal bzo las nyams rgyad du btang ste bzo ba khri stong mang po las shor byed du bcugadus rabs bco brgyad kyi mjug nas dus rabs bcu dgu ba'i lo rabs nyi shu pa'i bar/ dbyin ji mi ser spel mkhan gyis rgya gar la sa khral lam lugs gsum lag bstar byas yod de/ gci ga ni khre men ta ar lamadasags yin la/rgya gar na yod pa'i dbyin ji'i mi ser spel mkhan/de ni zhing bas lag nas sa zhing gi khral bsdus te dbyin ji mi ser spel mkhan la sprod dgos pas mang tshogs kyi khur bo shin tu lci/ gnyis ni le the wa ar spyod :do code :sna sar mtha ཿbye :go /smos 151 3byelam lugs yan la/ nga ba' ga ga nga las sum cha ga ga shārdeste /ce) /ste/ (ste/ /rje/ 'jug /de/ /// the / /ste/gam ga sa cha ga ga ra la ba' dad gzhung la da da sa/ gsum zhing sder sa 'ing bogs mar gtong ba'i lam lugs yin la/ de ni sa zhing beng sde kung hre'i yin par khas len dgos pa dang / kung hre ni khral bsdu'i — 186 —

las khungs yin pa'o// sa khral lam lugs 'di dag lag bstar byas pas/dbyin ji mi ser spel mkhan la yong sgo shin tu mod po byung ba dang 'ing ba rnams sa khral gyi mnar gcod 'og dbugs kyang gtong len byed dka' ba'i tshad du slobs/ tshul de ni shin tu ya nga ba'i rnam pa 'ig yin la snying rje ba'i yul du gyur yod/ ltogs skom gyis mnar ba'i rgya gar mis khyi ro dang rta ro kha zas byed pa dang / nyin 'ig grong 'dabs su rnga mong 'ig 'gro bzhin pa kho tshos mthong ma thag spyang tshogs bzhin rub te sha dum bu dum bu bcad nas rlon zas byas te de ma nyid du zas tshar pa lta bu yin/ snying rje med pa'i mnar gcod kyis zhing ba rnams dbyin ji'i mi ser spel mkhan la sdang sems je cher gyur/ rgya gar gyi rgyal phran so so'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin mnga' bdag ni mi ser spel ba'i dbang bsgyur gyi ka rdo lta bu yin mod/ yin na yang dbyin ji'i mi ser spel ba'i dbang bsgyur gnas bab nyin re las shugs je cher gyur bas/mi ser spel mkhan gyis rgyal phran so so'i dbang cha bdag gnyer byed rgyu'i thag bcad de/ snga gzhug tu dpon po'i dmigs bsal dbang cha dang sa bdag tshogs pa med par gtong ba'i bka' bsgrags/ de dag gi rgyu nor mi ser spel mkhan gyis blangs pa dang kho tshor dbang cha cung tsam yang med par bzos/gzhan da rung rgyal phran rgyal bo kha shas kyi lo phogs dang cho lo/ thob thang sogs med par byas pa dang / rgya gar chos lugs dang dbyi si lan chos lugs kyi dgon pa so so'i sa cha'ang lag nas blangs/ tha na ma'o kur rgyal rabs kyi gong ma de sku gshegs rjes rus rgyud kyis rgyal srid bzung mi chog pa byas/ de'i stabs kyis bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag dang chos lugs pa so so'i sems su'ang tsher ma zug pa lta bu'i na zug skyes te mi dmangs dang mnyam du dbyin jir ngo rgol byas pa red/ — 187 —

dbyinaji'i mi ser spel mkhan gyis rgya gar mis rgya gar mi la rdung ba'i byed thabs shig bton/ de ni zhing ba dang lag shes bzo las pa mang po 'ig dmag la zhugs su bcug kho tsho'i sma ra 'jog mi chog la rna lung sogs kyang 'dogs mi chog lhag par chos lugs dad mos kyang byas mi chog pas/ pha mes yang mes ring dar ba'i chos lugs la rgyab gtod mi byed ka med byung /de nas yang 1849lor dbyin jis rgya gar la dbang yongs su bsgyur ba'i rjes su/ kho tshos srid dbang gi rkang brtan po tshugs song snyam nas bzo zhing dmag gi srid jus bcos bsgyur byed 'go bcoms/ rgya gar dmag phyogs so sor mngags pa dang bzo 'ing dmag ni dbyin ji'i lag 'og gi yin pa'i bka' bsgrags/ 'di ltar btsan shed dang khrel med kyi bya ba las rgyu mang drags pas/bzo zhing dmag gi nang khul nas mi lnga'i rtsa 'dzugs byung / de dag gis phan tshun la skul slong byas te dbyin jir ngo rgol byed rgyu byas/ 'di ltar bzo zhing dmag ni rgya gar mi rigs kyi 'os langs chen mo'i thog ma'i sgul shugs su gyur/1856lor/ lkog tu 'os langs rtsa 'dzugs byas shing dbang cha dang sa zhing shor ba'i sku drag na na sa zhi pu'u yis mi mang po phyogs so sor mngags te srid gzhung dang dmag mang tshogs sogs su dbyin jir ngo rgol gyi bya ba sgrub tu bcug da dung dbyi si lan chos lugs dang rgya gar chos lugs la dad pa'i yul 'khyar grwa ba 'os langs khag so sor brda 'phrin bskyal ba dang / dmangs khrod sgyu rtsal pas kyang sa cha so so nas dbyin ji'i gdug rtsub mngon pa'i 'khrab gzhung 〈sngo nag gi me long 〉zhes pa 'khrab ston byas nas/ dbyin ji'i mis rgya gar gyi bud med la brnyas bcos byed tshul dmar rjen du bstan/ 'os langs kyi gnas tshul nags tshal la me shor ba bzhin sa cha so sor khyab/ tshang ma mnyam 'brel byed ched/ 1856lo nas bzung 'os langs brda rtags me tog par ma snyizlo bka leb byung / me tog pad ma ni dmag khrod kyi brda rtags su

grub pa dang / bag leb ni mang tshogs kyi brda byed du grub/ sde ba zhig gis bag leb cig sde ba gzhan zhig la byin na/ des bag leb gsar pa 'ig bsregs nas kyang gzhan zhig la ster ba sogs khyim tshang khri stong mang po brgyud nas 'os langs byed pa'i blo sems gcig tu bsgril/ 'os langs rtsa 'dzugs pas sa cha so so nas nyin gcig la 'os langs byed dgos pa thag bcad/ de ni 1857lo'i zla 5pa'i tshes 31nyin yin/1857lo'i 'gor/ dbyin ji'i mi ser spel mkhan gyis me mda'i mde'u mang po zhig bkrams/ de ni nor gyi tshil dang phag tshil byugs pa'i shog bus btum yod la so brgyab nas kha 'byed dgos/ chos lugs kyi srol ltar na/rgya gar chos lugs la dad mos byed mkhan tshos nor sha spangs yod pa dang /dbyi si lan chos lugs la dad mos byed mkhan tshos phag sha za mi chog pas/mi rnams kyi sems su de ni kho tsho'i chos lugs dad mos la brnyas bcos chen pobyas pa red snyam/ zla 5pa'i tshes 9nyin/ mes la the (lkoṣṭhaṣṭha)grong du dmag brgyad cu gya lnga tsam gyis mde'u de bkol spyod ma byas pas kho tsho'i rgyab kyi dmag lwa bshus pa dang drag chas blangs nas lcags sgrog brgyab ste lo bcur khrims thag bcad/ dmag mi rnams kyi khong khro'i me lce gnon thabs ma byung bar 'os langs nyi chad sngon la snur nas/ rgya gar mi rigs bcings 'grol dmag 'khrug gi yol ba thog mar phyes/zla 5pa'i tshes 10nyin/ mes la the grong nas ru khag gsum gyi dmag mis thog mar 'os langs byas/ kho tshos dbyin ji'i dmag dpon mang po 'ig dmar gsod byas pa dang dmag khul 'ga' gtor/ da dung btson la bcug pa'i chab srid nyes can mang po bskyabs/ lhag par tu sbrag srid khang bcom nas mi ser spel mkhan phan tshun bar 'brel ba byed thabs med pa bzos/de'i dgong mor 'os langs dmag rdi lir bskyod pa dang / phyi spran ༵༵sa ra

mkhar 'gram du 'byor nas/ mkhar nang gi 'os langs dmag dang lhan 'dzoms byas/ de nas 'os langs dmag gis mgyogs myur ngang mkhar nang gi mi ser spel ba'i las khungs dang dngul khang / dmag khul sogs bcom pas rdi li 'os langs kyi lte bar gyur/'os langs dmag gis mo kur rgyal rabs kyi dbang cha slar gso byed dgos pa dang gdung rgyud hwa tor hra hi pir rgyal bor bkur ba ma zad/ da dung mi bcu'i grub pa'i srid 'dzin u yon tshogs pa rtsa 'dzugs byas/ rtsa 'dzugs de ni 'os langs kyi mgo khrid las khungs yin la/ dmag don gyi dbang cha bzung yod/ zla 5tshes 12nyin/ srid 'dzin u yon tshogs pas gong ma'i ming spyad de 66khrag dron dang chu rgyun gyis rgya gar sa char yod pa'i dbyin ji'i ming gtsang 'khrud byed dgos mipa'i 'bod skul btang ba dang / sa zhing zhing ba rnams la bgos pa ma zad/ sku drag sa bdag la khral je ljid du btang ba dang tshong ba'i lag nas btsan gyis dngul g.yar/ rdi li'i 'os langs dpung kha~X de ma thag mi ba'i khri tsam la 'phar ba dang / me skyogs kyang chig brgya lhastu 5)lo/'i zla 6pa'i zla stod du/ dbyin ji mi ser spel mkhan gyis gdug rtsub kyi byed thabs spyad nas 'os langs kyi mgo gnon par gra sgrig byas/de nas rdi li mkhar bskor mod rgya gar dmag mi'i me mda' 'phen rtsal ha cang bzang bas pham/ mtha' mar mi ser spel mkhan gyis 'bar ma (5570771(20718)lo kyedang i ran (128ba77)sogs nas dmag bsdus pa dang / da dung krung go la dpung 'jug gi lam bar du yod pa'i ru khag bzhi phyir 'then nas 'os langs dmag gi mgo gnon la btang / 'os langs dmag nang khul gyi sku drag tshos g.yul 'khrug la rgyal kha mi thob snyam nas lkog tu dbyi/ zlor /brel ba bzung ste rang srog g.yol 'go brtsams/ kho tshos hwa

tor hra hri'i 'gebs srung 'og tu/ lkog nas ngo tsha khrel med kyi bya ba mang po las/ de bas 'os langs dmag gi stobs shugs je gnyom du phyin/zla 9pa'i tshes 14nyin/ dbyin jis me skyogs bstud mar brgyab pa dang lam lnga ru bgos nas rdi lir phar rgol drag po byas/ mo si lin chos lugs pa stong phrag 'gas gri bzung nas dbyin dmag gi gdong bsus/ dbyin dmag gis me mda' brgyab pas mi nyis brgya tsam de ma nyid du bsad/ yin yang kho tsho phyi snar mtho gang med par dbyin dmag dang lag 'dres/ dbyin dam ga gis rdi lir rgol ba'i 'thab 'khrug de nyin drug bdun tsam la bsrings pas 'os langs dmag gis dbyin dmag lnga stong tsam gyi srog blangs pa ma zad/dmag dpon chen mo gnyis kyang bsad/ tshes 19nyin gyi dgong mor/ grogs las dgra mang ba'i gnas tshul 'og 'os langs dmag rdi li mkhar nas 'then/dbyin dmag mkhar du thon pa nas bud med dang byis pa rnams dmar gsod byas/ de dag gi ro'i khron pa yongs rdzogs kyi kha bkang / ngo tsha med pa'i hwa tor hra hri sogs sku drag rnams kyis mgo 'bul zhus/di li mkhar shor ba'i rjes nas/ 'os langs dmag 'khrug gi lte ba ni li khe no dang yan zhi zhes par gyur/ li khe no nas srid dbang zhig btsugs nas mu mthun du 'os langs byas/ zla 7pa'i zla smad nas zla 8pa'i zla stod du/dbyin dmag gis thengs gnyis la li khe no mkhar la phar rgol byas kyang dmag lnga khri tsam gyis gdong bsus pas re zhig bya thabs ma rnyed/ zla 9pa'i zla dkyil du/ dbyin ji nas rgyab skyor dpung rogs mang po zhig 'byor bas thengs gsum par phar rgol byas/ thengs der dbyin dmag mkhar nang tshud thub pa byung yang / na na sa zhi pu'u dmag dpung gi spyi khyab dpon po khang the ya tho pes khan phor phar rgol byed rgyu'i dmag 'khrug gi 'go bcoms pas dbyin dmag phyi snur byed dgos byung / 1858lo'i zla 3pa'i 'gor/—da~X/ sngag

bzhi khri lnga stong lhag gis me skyogs 180tsam bkol nas yang bskyar li khe no mkhar la dpung 'jug byas/ nyin nyi shu tsam gyi dmar 'dzing khrod o ti (tsho7)zhing chen gyi zhing ba tshang mas mkhar srung / 'os langs dmag gi lag cha shin tu zhan stabs/ zla 3pa'i tshes 21nyin/ 'os langs dam ga bros pas li khe no mkhar dbyin dmag gi lag tu shor/ dbyin dmag gis gza' 'khor gnyis tsam gyi ring mkhar nang gi mi dmar gsod byas/ thengs der li khe no la dbyin sgor khri drug brgya tsam gyi gyong gud thebs/zla 3pa'i zla mjug tu/ dbyin dmag gis 'os langs lte ba yan 'i mkhar bskor/ yan ci'i rgyal mo ni la khe zhi mes pa ye zhes pa de yin/ kho mo'i khyo bo dmag 'khrug khrod shi ba nas dbang cha tshang ma mos bzung yod/ kho mos 'go khrid nas dbyin ji'i dmag gi mdun bsus/ yan zhi mkhar la dmag chig khri tsam yang med rung kho tshor stobs shugs ha cang 'dzoms po yod/dbyin dmag gis bstud mar nyin 'gar me phyogs brgyab pas mkhar nang du dka' ngal chen po byung / khang the ya tho pe dpung rogs la slebs kyang dbyin dmag gis phyir bskra da/ dmag mi lnga brgya tsam gron pa dang nyin brgyad la 'chi bar phangs sems med par 'khrug pas dbyin dmag mang po bsad kyang /mtha' mar dbyin dmag gi stobs shugs 'og 'os langs dmag pham/ zla 4pa'i tshes 4nyin gyi dgong mor/ rgyal mos dmag tshig stong tsam khrid nas bros te khang the ya tho pe dang mnyam du bka' lor mkhar bzung / zla 6pa'i zla dkyil du/ dbyin dmag gis bka' lor mkhar bskor/ skabs der rgyal mo dpa' bo kher rgyugs kyi dbyin dmag gi khrod du mchongs nas mi mang po gri 'og tu btang yang mtha' mar rta las lhung ste 'das/ de dus mo lo nyer gsum la son ma thag yin/—do/ 2zhi sprang bka' lor mkhar sogs shor bas 'os langs dmag gi

stobs shugs rim gyis je zhan du song / skabs der sa cha so sor 'os langs byed pa'i mi grangs khri tsho bcu gnyis tsam la slebs yod/ de'i nang nas khang the ya tho pe yis khrid pa'i dmag dpung gis 1859lo'i zla 5pa'i bar du dbyin jir ngo rgol byas/ dbyin jis sa cha so sor bka' bsgrags te mi su zhig gis kho tshor skyabs bcol na der sa zhing dang dbang cha sprod rgyu yin zhes bshad pas/bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi sku drag mang po zhig 'phro rim 'phror mgo sgur/de'i stabs kyis/ 1859lor 'os langs dmag gi mgo yongs su mnan/rgya gar mi rigs kyi 'os langs chen po ni drang bden gyi mi rigs bcings 'grol dmag 'khrug cig yin mod/ de pham pa'i rgyu rkyen ci yin zhe na/'os langs dmag la gcig gyur gyi 'go khrid dang rtsa 'dzugs kyi nus pa zhan pas yin/ dmag don gyi phyogs nas kyang lag cha shin tu zhan pa dang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin pa dag la mi rigs bcings 'grol dmag 'khrug gi 'go khrid nus pa med pa dang / de dag gi nang nas kyang na na sa zhi pu'u dang la khe zhi mes bā ye/ khang the ya tho pe sogs phud gzhan tshang mas mi rigs la rgyab 'gal byas te dbyin jir lkog nas rogs skyor mang po byas pas kyang yin/rgya gar mi rigs 'os langs kyis rjes kyi 'byor ldan gral rim dmangs gtso'i las 'gul la cha rkyen legs po bskrun/ de dang hin nyi bka' wa mi rigs kyi 'os langs dang / ab gha ni si than mi rigs kyi 'os langs yi ran pa pu'u chos lugs pa'i 'os langs / krung go'i zhi bde gnam rgyal gyi 'os langs sogs kyis/ a she ya mi rigs bcings 'grol las 'gul gyi rba rlabs thengs dang po 'phyur bar byas/— 193 —

yo rab6) rabs 'o rgyus steng gi g.yul 'gyed gal che'in zhigawa waphu ra hri dang hpha ran si'i dmag 'khruga'ajar man dang hpha ran si'i bar 'gal ba byung nas dus yun ring bo 'gor yod/ dus rabs bar ma nas bzung hpha ran si yo rob gi rgyal khab chen po zhig yin te 1673—1813lo'i bar/ hpha ran sis 'jar man la thengs bcu ba'i tsam la btsan 'dzul byas/ 1870lor phyong/sa gnyis kyi 'gal ba dza drag tu gyur nas/ mtha' mar gzhi khyon che ba'i 'jar pho'i dmag 'khrug chen mo (1870—1871)byung /dus rabs 19pa'i rjes te/ lhag par du hpha ran si gong ma 'i btsan rgyal gnyis pa'i skabs su (1852—1870)ma rtsa ring lugs 'phel rgyas chen po byung zhing / bzo las gsar brje legs grub byung / yin na yang lo rabs drug cu pa'i dus su 'byor ldan gral rim khag cig gi khe phan gyi tshab mtshon na pho lung sku rabs gsum pa'i gnas bab la g.yo 'gul byung ste/ khos phu ra hris 'jar man gcig gyur byed par bkag 'gog byed ma thub pas 'byor ldan gral rim gyis kho la 'khang ra byas/ rgyal nang du'ang 'gal ba shin tu rno ngar can mang po byung ba'in yod de/ 'ing ba dbul bor gyur ba dang las bzo ba las shor gyis nyi ma gtong thabs byas/ zas dang khang ba'i rin gong ldab 'gyur gyis 'phar/ las ku'i dus tshod nyin rer chu tshod 12—16la btang / de'i stabs kyis zhing bas rnyog dra bzos shing bzo bas las 'khyur byung / srid gzhung la ngo rgol byed pa'i tshogs pa yang byung / lhag par gong ma 'i lam lugs med par bzos nas 'dra mnyam byed dgos pa'i 'bod skul bton/1shā pho/ lung sku rabs gsum pas rgyal nang gi 'gal ba sel ched phyi

phyogs su dmag 'khrug byed pa'i 'go bcoms/ khos 'jar man nang khul gcig gyur byed par bkag 'gog byed ched/ le yan chu bo'i byang rgyud kyi 'jar man gyi sa btsan 'phrog byas pa dang / hpha ran si'i 'byor ldan gral rim gyis yo rob la dbang bsgyur byed pa'i dka' khag dag sel ci thub byas/'jar man ni dus yun ring por kha 'thor gyi tshul du gnas yod/ dus rabs bcu dgu'i lo rabs lnga bcu'i skabs nas 'jar man ma rtsa ring lugs kyi dpal 'byor gong 'phel chen po byung ba nas zhing ba'i rgyal khab de bzo las can gyi rgyal khab tu gyur/ ma rtsa ring lugs dpal 'byor gong 'phel kyis kha thor rnams gcig gyur la skul/ phu ra hri ni 'jar man mna' mthun rgyal khab las ches stobs shugs che ba zhig yin/ 1862lor/ ham sems che ba'i o thope si mes phu ra hri'i phyi 'brel blon chen gyi 'gan 'khur rjes/ nges par du 'jar man gcig gyur byed dgos par snyam/18yo 1866lor/ phu ra hris snga gzhug tu tan mag dang o si khru ri ya pham par byas te/ 'jar man byang phyogs gcig gyur byas/ yin yang lho phyogs kyi mna' mthun rgyal khab bzhi hpha ran si'i mnga' 'og tu yod/ skabs der hpha ran sis 'thab 'khrug gi 'gag sne si thig la si bzung yod pas/ lho phyogs 'jar man mna' mthun rnams la 'jigs snang skul bzhin mchis/phu ra hris 'jar man gcig gyur byed pa'i ches mtha' mjug gi gegs sel ched/ hpha ran si dang g.yul 'khrug par gra sgrig byas/phu ra hris 'jar man gcig gyur byed par glo thag bcad yod la/ hpha ran sis gcig gyur byed par bkag 'gog byed rgyu'i blo thag bcad yod phyir/g.yul 'khrug ni g.yol thabs med pa zhig tu grub/g.yul 'khrug sngon gyi hpha ran si'i phyi 'brel 'brel ba ha cang mi bzang /dbyin ji dang u ru su sogs kyis mtha' gcig tu phu ra hri la rgyab snroshā che/ po

byas pa dang / lho phyogs nas na pho lung sku rabs gsum pas dbyi tha li'i nang srid la the gtogs pyas pas des kyang hpha dmag la ngo rtsol byed rgyu las dpung rogs byed mi srid / yin na yang hpha ran sis gnas bab de dag la bsam blo ma btang bar rang nyid kyi stobs shugs ches chen po yin par 'dod nas phu ra hri la thengs gcig 'khrug pa'i go skabs btsal/ tag tag skabs 'dir si pan gyi rgyal rgyud 'dzin par rtsod gleng byung bas/ khos don der kha g.yar te phu ra hrir dmag drangs/1870lo'i dpyid khar/ si pan rgyal mo ye hra pe la sku rabs gnyis pa 'das rjes rgyal rgyud 'dzin mkhan gyi bu med rkyen rgyal khri re zhig stong bar lus/si pan gyi srid 'dzin blon chen phu'u li mu'u yis lkog nas pe si mes dang gros chings bzhag nas/ phu ra hri'i gong ma we len sku rabs dang po'i nu bo li o por ti zhes pa gong mar gdan drangs nas rgyal sar bkod rgyu byas/1870lo'i zla 7pa'i tshes 1nyin/ gsang ba'i gros chings 'di si pan gyi〈mnyam sgrog tshags par 〉gyis brtol bas/ na pho lung sku rabs gsum pa thugs shin tu khros/khos hpha ran si'i pa'o len na yod pa'i gzhung tshab pa chen po mngags te e mu'u si chu tshan na lus phung gso bzhin pa'i phu ra hri'i gong we len sku rabs dang por de ltar bsgrub mi rung par bshad kyang ma phan/ de nas we len sku rabs dang po rlangs 'khor 'bab tshigs su 'byor dus bsam blo btang chog pa'i bka' gnang / yin yang 'di'i bar nas glog 'phrin yi ge bcos pa sogs bsam bzhin du na pho lung la zhe sdang bslangs/ 1870lo'i zla 7pa'i tshes 19nyin/ hpha ran sis phu ra hrir dmag 'khrug byed pa'i brda btang / de tshos kyang 'dod don legs 'grub byung / na pho lung sku rabs gsum par g.yul /lta/ thog mar slong mkhan gyi nyes ming btags/
byu lja 6 sdu stse tshi khyu sto spre ṭā ṣpe

g.yul 'khrug gi sngon du/ hpha ran si'i skam dmag gi dmag dpon gyis4 nga chos gra sgrig byas tshar yod mices bsgrags/ yin yang don dngos su g.yul sa brtan po 'ig kyang bzung med/ ru khag 'ga' rer me skyogs med pa dang /yang 'ga' rer myur skyob kyi sman rdzas dang 'grim 'grul yo byad med pa sogs gnas tshul shin tu sdug g.yul 'khrug gi 'go rtsom dus/ hpha ran si'i dmag khri tsho bzhi bcu lhag yod mod/ 'on kyang myur du g.yul 'khrug tu zhugs thub pa khri nyi shu tsam ma gtogs med/ dmag dpung shin tu kha 'thor yin te/dmag dpon gyis rang gis bkod 'domasas byed sa'i dmag dpung mi rnyed pa dang / dmag dpung gi bkod 'doms mkhan mi rnyed pa'i gnas tshul byung /zla 7pa'i tshes 26nyin/ dmag dpung bdun tsam phyogs gcigatu bsdus nas me tshi (zaṣṭha)dang si thig la si'i (777lo)sa char bsdad/ gzhan yang dpung khag cig pa'o ar hphu'u (7po )zhes par bzhag dmag gi spyi'i grangs khri 25tsam yod/ zla 7pa'i tshes 28nyin/ na pho lung sku rabs gsum pa dngos su me tshi la phebs nas dmag la bkod 'doms mdzad/ skabs der kho rang yang the tshom gyis myur du phar rgol byed ma thub/phu ra hri'i phyogs kyi gnas tshul la bltas na/ dmag don gyi phyogs nas gra sgrig byas pa legs shing / ming du grags pa'i dmag don pa khe lo se we tshis brtsams pa'i 〈dmag don smra ba〉zhes pa'i gzhung lugs rmang gzhi byas nas lam lugs 'thus tshang ba zhig gtan la phab yod pa dang / dmag mi khri tsho brgya lhag g.yul sar slebs thub pa las khri tsho lnga bcu lhag gza' 'khor gnyis kyi ring 'dzoms thub/ phu ra hri'i gong ma yang dngos su dmag dpung la bkod 'doms byed du phebs yod/ zla 7pa'i zla mjug tu/ phu dmag khri tsho 40tsam nub lho'i mtha' mtshams la mngags/ phu dmag la bsdoms pa'i ru dpung brji bsdo sdud rji dang lam gsum du bgos nas hpha ran ser g.yul 'khrug byed

rgyu'i sta gon byas/dmag don gyi bkod 'dom sa phyogs nas bshad na'ang / phu dmag hpha dmag las sgrig lam dam zhing dpa' ngar che ba sha stag go/ hpha dmag gi bkod 'dom pa 'ga' re dmag don gyi nyams myong ci yang med pa'i na gzhon yin la/ 'ga' re smra ra thar thor skyes yod pa'i bgres po yin/ gang ltar yang hpha dmag la dmag don gyi sgrig lam lhod cing stobs shugs kha 'thor gyi tshul du gnas yod/zla 8pa'i tshes 2nyin/ hpha dmag 'jar man gyi sa char bskyod par/ phu dmagagis pham kha chen po byin/ tshes 4nyin/ phu dmag hpha ran si'i mtha' mtshams las brgal te phyogs yongs nas ngo rgol byas/ tshes 6nyin gyi zhogs par/ phyogs gnyis kyis ru dpung wer thig nye 'gram nas thug phan tshun lag 'dres mod hpha dmag gis phu dmag gi gdong ma brtan par bros/ wer thig g.yul 'khrug khrod du phyogs gnyis kyi dmag 10000tsam gron/ nyin der/phu dmag gi ru dpung dang po dang gnyis pas kyang hphu'u ar kha pa he zhes pa'i sa cha'i si phe ci yon nas hpha dmag gi ru dpung gnyis pa gtor/ hpha dmag nāms ga~Xg las gcig mgyogs kyis phyir bros pas hpha ran si'i sgo chen ngas rno pho ༵/nga sku rabs gsum pas gnas bab legs po med pa shes nas/zla 8pa'i tshes 12nyin dmag dpung gi ches mtho'i bkod 'doms dbang cha pā tsan zhes pa'i dmag dpon der sprad/ kho rang shing rta la bsdad nas byang phyogs kyi zhwa lung (22)zhes par bros te me khi ma hung gi dpung lhag ma dang mnyam du bzhugs so// zla 8pa'i tshes 16nyin gyi snga dro'i dus chod dgu'i steng /pā tsan gyi dmag dpung dang phu dmag g.yul 'dres pas phyogs gnyis kyi dmag chig khri drug stong lhag gron/ zla 8pa'i tshes 18nyin/ kyi la /mi sbyalu dzog

(ṣṭhaṣṭharsālko chu)nas phyogs gnyis kyi dpung khag gcig yang bskyar thugaskabs der phu dmag khri tsho nyi shu lhag la nye ba yod pa dang / hpha dmag khri tsho bcu bzhi yod/ dza drag che ba'i g.yul 'gyed khrod phu dmag nyis khri lhag gron pa dang / hpha dmag tshig khri sum stong tsam bsad cing lnga stong tsam bzung /'di ltar zla ngo phyed la g.yul 'khrug byas pas/ hpha dmag phyogs gnyis su chad de/ phyogs gcig zhwa lung gi phyogs su bros pa'i me khi ma hung gi dpung khag dang / phyogs gcig me tshi zhes pa'i sar bkag yod/ phu dmag gi ru dpung dang po dang gnyis pas (bsdoms pas dmag khri bco lnga yong cing khra li rgyal bos dngos su bkod 'doms gnang bzhin yod)pu tsan dazu/ga me tshi na yod pa bskor yod/me khi ma hung gis skabs 'dir zhwa lung nas dmag dpung gsar ba 'ig btsugs/ der bsdoms pa'i dmag khri tsho 13yod pa la/ me skyogs 380yod/yin na yang 'di ni gnas skabs ring rtsa 'dzugs byas pa zhig yin pas dmag mi mang por dmag gi sbyong brdar thob med/ de bas dmag rnams la me ma da' 'dzin tshul dang 'ben la gtod tshul khrid dgos 'dug na pho lung sku rabs gsum pa dang me khi ma hung gnyis kyis pha ri sir bros na bsam mod/ mi dmangs gsar brje'i nyen khar skrag nas re 'ig pā tsan dmag gi lhag ma dang mnyam 'dzoms byed ched/ pā tsan dmag dpung skyob par phyin/ zla 8pa'i tshes 24nyin/ phu dmag gi skya dmag zhwa lu nga du 'byor yang me khi ma hung gi grib ma tsam yang ma ma thong / rjes nas kho pā tsan dmag dpung skyob par song ba shes nas myur du lam 'gog par gra sgrig byas/skabs der me khi ma hung gis kyang pā tsan dmag skyob rgyu las sla mo min pa shes pa dang / phu dmag gi ru dpung gnyis kyis kho'i bgrod lam 'gog bzhin ༵ pyes /sa mdun bskyod ma byas par chi me lu zi la song / yin yang /

skabs der pha ri si nas glog 'phrin btang ste dmag dpung shar lho'i phyogs su mdun bskyod byed dgos pa'i bka' phab pa sogs kyis dpung khag der gcig gyur gyi bsam blo'am stobs shugs shig ma byung / zla 8pa'i tshes 30nyin/hpha dmag gis nyin gung gi zas la spyod skabs phu dmag gis glo bur phar rgol byas pas dmag lnga stong tsam gron pa dang me phyogs 42tsam gyi gyong gud byung /de bas me khi ma hung mu mthud du mdun bskyod byed ma thub par stel jam(22161 57 667/tsho)gyi sa dang 'brel ba'i se ting zhes par song / skabs 'dir hpha dmag la g.yul 'khrug gi nus pa yongs su nyams song /se ting nas 'bru rigs kyis ma 'dang ba'i khar phu dmag gas mu mthud rgol rdung byas pas/ ci byed 'di byed med pa'i gnas su bskyal/ zla 9pa'i tshes 1nyin/ phu dmag gis me sgrogs bdun brgya bkol nas se ting mkhar la dpung 'jug byas/ me skyogs kyis mkhar de thal rdul du btang ba dang mkhar nang nas mi 25000tsam shi me khi ma hung la'ang rmas lci mo phog thams cad 'chi lam ma gtogs med pa'i dus der/ na pho lung sku rabs gsum pas dar dkar bslangs nas phu dmag la skyabs bcol/ 'di ni lo rgyus steng ming du grags pa'i 6 se ting nas skyabs bcol byas pa mi zhes pa'i don rkyen yin/ zla 9pa'i tshes 2nyin/ phu dmag gis hpha ran si'i gong ma dang sku drag blon chen/gzhan da dung dmag dpon so dgu gtso byas pa'i dmag mi khri tsho 10bzung ba dang / me phyogs 650tsam thob/ se ting nas pham pa'i gnas tshul pha ri sir khyab ma thag mi dmangs la khong khro chen po bslangs/ zla 9pa'i tshes 4nyin/pha ri si nas gsar brje'i las 'gul spel/ hpha ran si'i gong ma'i btsan rgyal gnyis pa'i srid dbang rtsa slog byas te/ btsan rgyal gsum pa'i spyi mthun rgyal khab dbu brnyes pa khyab bsgrags byas/ gsar du btsugs pa'i srid gzhung de'i ming la lha rgyal srung srid gzhung /zer/ phu ra hri'i dmag dpogā ༵ si spras

kyis 'dod ham da rung ma tshim par hpha ran si'i byang shar gyi sa khul mang po bdag tu gnyer/ zla 9pa'i tshes 19nyin/ pha ri sis mkhar grong bskor/skabs de nas bzung phu tha'i dmag 'khrug gi ngo bo yongs su 'gyur/ 'jar man la mtshon na btsan 'dzul rang ba'in gyi g.yul 'khrug cig yin la/ hpha ran sir mtshon na btsan 'dzul la ngo rgol byed pa'i drang bden gyi g.yul 'khrug cig yin/ hpha ran si ba rnams kyis mtshon cha thogs te mes rgyal srung skyob ched dmar 'dzing byed pa'i gra sgrig byas/ yin na yang 'byor ldan gral rim gyi sna rgyal srung srid gzhung g.yul 'khrug la shin tu skrag nas 'i/ bas thag gcod kyi thabs la 'bad/ 1871lo'i zla 1po'i tshes 28nyin/ smyo rgyal srung srid gzhung des 'jar man la mgo 'bul byas/ zla 5pa'i tshes 10nyin/ hpha lan khe hphu'u nas mthun chings la ming rtags bkod/ hpha ran sis 'jar man la ar sa si (༅po lo)yongs rdzogs dang lu'u lan ( lo)gyi phyed ka byin pa ma zad/ hpha sgor dung phyir 50yi gyong gsab sprad/phu hpha dmag 'khrug ni 'dzam gling nye rabs lo rgyus steng ches ming du grags pa'i g.yul 'khrug cig yin/ hpha ran sir pham kha byung ba des rgyal nang gi gral rim gyi 'gal ba je cher gyur ba dang / pha ri si'i kung hre'i 'byor med gral rim gyi gsar brje'i las 'gul bslangs/ phyogs gzhan nas g.yul 'khrug des 'jar man gcig gyur byed par phan chen po thogs yod pa dang lhag par 'jar man ni yo rob skam sa chen po'i stobs ldan gyi rgyal khab cig tu gyur bar skul 'ded kyang thebs pa yin/ g.yul 'khrug gi rjes nas/'jar hpha gnyis kyi 'gal ba zhi rgyu phar zhig de las kyang rno ngar du gyur yod pas 'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang po'i g.yul 'khrug la rmang btings pa red/phu hpha g.yul 'khrug gis dmag don lo rgyus steng go gnas gal chen zhig bzung swāhā 2pa sprang g.yul 'khrug gi thabs shes la gong 'phel chen po byung ba

dang / lhag par du me skyogs kyi gal chen rang bzhin shes yod/ bzung dmag khrod kyi hpha ran si'i dmag dpon zhig gis bshad rgyur/ phu dmag gis spyi le lnga'i sar bsgrigs pa'i skyogs dmag la brten nas rgyal kha thob pa red zer/ gzhan yang / dmag 'khrug las lcags lam gyi gal chen rang bzhin shes pa ma zad/ da dung dmag dpung gi lam lugs dang / bkod 'doms do dam/ sgrig lam sogs 'thus tshang du gtong rgyu ni rgyal kha thob pa'i thabs shes nyag cig yin pa ra sprod byas/

jag rkun gnyis kyi 'thab 'khrugawa waljar u dmag 'khruga'ajab rgol ni btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis dmag 'khrug slong bar rgyun par spyod pa'i thabs lam zhig yin/ nye rabs nas bzung lngar pan btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis mtsho steng gi 'jab rgol chen po thengs gnyis byas te dmag 'khrug thengs gnyis bslangs pa red/ thengs shig ni 1941lo'i lo mjug tu lngar pan gyis a me ri kha'i zhi bde rgya mtsho'i dmag gru ru khag gi gnasagazhi mu tig gru khar 'jab rgol byas te zhi bde rgya mtsho'i dmag 'khrug gzhi nas bslangs/ thengs gzhan zhig ni snga dus kyi mu tig gru kha'i dus 'gyur zer ba yin te/ de ni 1904lo'i zla 2tshes 8nyin gyi mtshan mor lngar pan mnyam 'brel dmag gru ru khag gis lu'u hron gru kha ru sdod pa'i u ru su'i zhi bde rgya mtsho'i dmag gru ru khag la glo bur du 'jab rgol byas pas/ ljar u dmag 'khrug (1904—1905lo)gi 'go bslangs/ de ni glo bur du langs pa'i dmag 'khrug cig min par ljar u gnyis kyis yun ring por gri bton gzhu bkang byas pa'i 'bras bu yin/ khe li mu dmag 'khrug gi phyis su/ u ru su gong mas phyi phyogs su rgya bskyed pa'i kha phyogs a she ya du bsgyur zhing / btsan rgyal gyi gdon lag krung go'i phyogs su brkyangs/ 1886lor u ru sus rgyal khab kyi zhabs 'dren pa li hung krang la lkog rngan du dngul mang po sprad de dkyil shar lugs lam(man kru'u le nas chi chi har dang har dzin brgyud yod)bzo skrun gyi sa cha bogs mar len rgyu'i dbang cha blangs/— 2slo ba

pe — — /ye 4 cangawa ge 3—— 194lo'ili hron gru kha/1898lor/ u ru sus btsan dbang gis lu'u hron gru kha dang ta len bogs mar blangs shing lu'u hron gru kha de u ru su'i zhi bde rgya mtsho dmag gru ru khag gi gnas gzhir bsgyur zhing / krung go'i byang shar sa khul yongs rdzogs u ru sus stobs shugs khyab khongs su gyur/ u ru su'i shar phyogs sa khul gyi stobs shugs che ru btang bas ham sems kyis myos pa'i ljar pan dang 'gal ba dza drag du gyur/ljar pan btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi dus rim du bslobs rjes blo gcig sgos zhi bde rgya mtsho'i shar phyogs kyi bdag po byed rgyur bsam zhing de ni kho ri ya (50722)gnas gzhi byas te krung go'i byang shar sa khul btsan bzung dang phyis su gom gang mdun spos kyis krung go dang a she ya yongs la rgya bskyed rgyu'i 'char gzhi yod/ljar pan gyis kṣ-imā kon chings yig〉brgyud de kho ri ya dang krung go'i tha'e wan/ phing ho gling phran/ li'o tung gling phyed bcas sa khul mang po btsan bzung byas/u ru sus ljar pan pha mthar bskrad de rang nyid kyi mnga' khongs rgya — 205 —

bskyed slad hpha ran si dang 'jar man la mnyam 'brel byas nas ljar pan kyi shugs mgo bsnan/ de bas lngar pan gyis kyang btsan dbang 'og rgya nag las dngul srang khri 300)spen rgyu cha rkyen byas te li'o tung phyed gling phyir sprad la/de ni lngar pan la mtshon na gcan gzan kha nas sha 'phrog pa dang 'dra bas skog tu dmag 'khrug gi go skabs btsal te u ru sur 'khon lan slog rgyu'i sems thag bcad/ krung go'i byang shar dang kho ri ya sogs 'phrog rtsod byed slad 'jar u bar gyi 'gal ba nyin re bzhin dza drag tu gyur bar ma zad/phyogs gnyis gas dmag 'khrug gi sta gon legs par byas te dmag 'khrug langs chog chog byas yod/dmag 'khrug gi snga rol du/ lngar pan gyis sta gon phun sum tshogs pa byas yod/ der sbyong brdar legs shing sgrig chas 'dzoms pa'i dmag mi khri 15lhag yod la/ ma 'gyangs par dmag shugs bskyed de mi 375000lhag la slobs/ ljar dmag la stogs chen rigs sna tshogs 1140yod la/ de las 'jar man nas nyo 'dren byas pa'i skyogs chen dang me mda' 147yod/ mtsho spyod dbang cha 'phrog rtsod byed ched ljar pan gyis mtsho dmag la lhag par mthong chen byas te/ dbyin ji nas dmag gru mang po nyo 'dren byas/1903lor slebs dus/ ljar pan gyis dmag gru sna tshogs 100lhag dang mtsho dmag gru kha legs shos mang po bcas bzung yod/ 1903lo'i zla 12bar/btsan 'dzul pa tun shang phen pā lang ljar pan mnyam 'brel dmag gru ru khag gi dmag spyi chen mor bskos/ kho'i gtso gnyer 'og nas ljar dmag gis 'thab 'khrug gi 'char gzhi zhib mo bkod sgrig byas pa red/u ru su'i dmag don sta gon ljar pan las cung zhan/ dmag mi'i ru dpung skyel 'dren byed slad dbus shar lcags lam dang der ma lag bskrun parji ba/nā pa sring / lu'u hron gru kha dang li'o dbyang bar gyi dmag don bzo

skrun la shugs snon byas/ skabs der u ru sur 'dzam gling stong ches che ba'i dmag dpung yod kyang / shar phyogs sa khul du dpung khag gnyis las mngags med la/ der bsdoms pa'i dmag mi 98000lhag yod/ gzhan yang / nyen srung ru khag la dmag 2400tsam dang / skyogs chen 148 me mda' sbag sbag 8bcas yod/ rgyang thag ring bas skyel 'dren ha cang khag po yo da de/ u ru su'i dmag sde gcig mo si kho nas lu'u hron gru kha la slobs tshe zla gcig lhag 'gyangs/ mtsho dmag gi thad nas mtsho gru sna tshogs 63las med la de las mang po 'ig rnying dul du song yod pas shin tu zhan/ de'i phyir/dmag stobs phyogs yongs nas bsdur na lngar pan gyi dmag grangs ni u dmag gi ldab 3dang / skyogs chen phal cher ldab 8 me mda' sbag sbag ldab 18 dmag gru ldab 1 3bcas yin/1904lo 'i zla 2tshes 6nyin gyi snga dro'i chu tshod dgu pa'i steng / ljar pan mnyam 'brel dmag gru ru khag tun shang phen pā lang gis dbu khrid 'og co hri pa'o nas chas te gsang ba'i ngang nas krung go'i mtsho ser byang khul du song /zla 2pa'i tshes 8nyin gyi sa srod du u dmag tu brdzus nas lu'u hron gru khar 'byor zhing / mtshan gung gi dus su u dmag la gtad de phyogs mdel 16brgyab pa las 3dmigs dben la 'khel bas u dmag gi sgrig chas la gnon skyon tshabs chen bzos/zla 2ba'i tshes 9nyin u ru sus ljar pan la dam/ga rgyag pa'i dril bsgra gas pa dang / tshes 10nyin/ ljar pan gnam bskos gong mas kyang dmag 'khrug gi bka' bsgrags pas ljar u dmag 'khrug dngos su 'go bcoms pa red/zla 2ba'i zla dkyil du/ lngar pan mnyam 'brel dmag gru ru khag gis lu'u hron gru khar 'jab rgol thengs gnyis pa byas pas u dmag gi gru gnyis sogs dmag chas sgrig ga'i thad la gnod skyon tshabs chen thebs/20byin sprang

u dmag la nyen zhib dmag gru bcu lhag yod pa de ljar pan la mtshon na nyen khar grub yod/ ljar pan gyis da dung lu'u hron gru kha bkag ste u dmag gru kha'i nang rol du bkag sdom byas pa dang / zla smad du mi 77gyis grub pa'i ljar pan shi phod ru khag gis rdos bkang ba'i gru rnying lnga kha lo bsgyur te gru kha'i nye 'gram du rang nyid bkas te mtshor byings kyang / u dmag gi gru da dung sngar bzhin rang dbang gis 'gro 'ong byed thub/ zla 3tshes 27nyin/ ljar dmag gis thengs gnyis par bkag sdom byas/ yin yang u dmag gi gru sngar bzhin 'gro 'ong byas/ zla 5pa'i zla stod du/ ljar dmag gis thengs gsum par bkag sdom byas shing tun san tse zhon gyis spyi'i bkod 'doms byas/ 'char ga'i ltar gru 15bkad de byings pas gru chen po 'gro bar lam bkag pas u dmag gi mtsho'i steng gi nyen zhib las 'gul la dka' tshegs chen po bzos/ljar dmag gis da dung lu'u hron gru kha'i phyi rol tu 'gad rdzas mang po bzhag par ma zad/ u dmag gi 'gro 'ong byed pa'i dmag grur rgyag par yang sta gon byas te sgug dmag 'khrug byas nas nyin mang po ma 'gor yang u dmag gi gru 9la gtor skyon thebs pa dang / zla 4tshes 13nyin u ru su'i zhi bde rgya mtsho'i dmag gru ru khag gi dar sgreng dmag gru 6 phe ti lu'u pā hphu lu'u hpho si khe ’ rtags can la lngar dmag gi smyogs mdel phog pas chur byings shing dmag spyi mā khā lu'u hphu 'das/ de nas ljar pan gyis mtsho skyod dbang cha phal cher bzung yod/ de bas mgyogs myur ngang dmag dpung mtsho steng nas skam sar 'gro thub pa byung /1904zla 2tshes 8nyin/ ljar pan gyi skam dmag ru dpung 12pa kho ri ya'i ran khron sa cha nas skam sar 'gos nas mu mthud du byang phyogs su mdun bskyod byas/ zla 4tshes 4nyin ye krig bdag bzung byas shing / mtsho lam brgyud ༵ shān pa'i ru dpung gnyis pa dang nye srung dmag dpung gnyis mnyam

sdeb byas nas dmag ru dang po btsugs pa dang / dmag spyi chen mo ho mu'u we kren gyis 'go 'dzin byas nas/ zla 4ba'i smad du ya lu'u gtsang bo brgal bar u dmag gis rgol lan sprad/ yin yang ci'u lan mkhar dang hphin hong mkhar sogs su pham par byas/ de 'dra'i btsan gnon 'og u dmag li'o dbyang grong phyi rol gyi the tsu chu bo 'gram la phyi snar byas/ der mthud lngar dmag ru dpung gnyis pa'i thon dang po dang / gsum pa/ bzhi ba bcas gsum po zla 5tshes 5nyin li'o tung gling phyed kyi tshwa mtsho nas skam sar 'gos/zla 5pa'i tshes 26nyin u dmag las ldab 9yod pa'i ljar dmag gis u dmag dang dus tshod 14ring dza drag chen po'i dmag 'khrug byas te ci'u kro'u 'phrog par ma zad/ u dmag la dpung rogs yong sa'i lu'u hron gru kha'i bgrod lam yang bcad pa red/ zla 6tshes 14 — 15nyin/ lngar dmag ru dpung gnyis pas lu'u hron gru khar dpung rogs su yong ba'i u ru su'i ru dpung dang po pham par byas/ u dmag byang phyogs su bros par ljar dmag gis rjes 'ded byas te li'o dbyang gi nye sar slebs/ zla 6pa'i zla smad du/lngar dmag ru dpung dang po dang gnyis pa/ gzhan gsar du grub pa'i ru dpung bzhi ba bcas so so li'o dbyang gi nye sar 'byor la/ der khyon bsdoms dmag mi 125000dang / phyogs chen 484bcas yod pas/ li'o dbyang btsan dbang gis 'phrog ste u dmag byang shar gyi byang khul du bskyod rgyu'i sta gonabyas/ de ltar ljar dmag gis lu'u hron gru khar btsan 'dzul byas kyang rjes phyogs kyi sems khral med par btang ba red/u dmag gis li'o dbyang du dmag mi khri 22lhag bsdus pa dang phyogs chen 500lhag 'gog sgo rim pa gsum bsgrigs nas ljar dmag dang thag gcod rang bzhin gyi dmag 'khrug cig byed rgyu'i sta gon byas yod/zla 8tshes 24nyin dmag 'khrug gi 'go bcoms/ ljar dam/ 0spya 'char

gzhi ni u dmag bskor te tshar gcod byed rgyu de yin ste/ ljar dmag ru khag dang pos shar phyogs nas u dmag gi g.yon rur brgol rgyu dang / ru khag gnyis pas nub phyogs nas u dmag gi g.yas rur bsgol rgyu dang / ru khag ba'i bas mdun ngos nas u dmag la 'thab ste de nus pa gzhog rgyu byas/ u dmag gas g.yas ru'i ru khag gnyis par dpung rogs la gra sgrig ru khag bkod sgrig byas yod la/ de khrod mār tan na'o rmus sne khrid pa'i thon gcig yod/ kho tshos ljar dam ga zhi pa'o li ya'i ru khag gsum pa'i nye sar 'byor ba rtogs rjes bka' med rang 'gul gyis kha phyogs bsgyur te nub ngos kyi zhing sa las brgal nas ljar dmag dang 'thab ste lngar dmag pham par byas/ 'on kyang u dmag bkod 'doms pas gnas bab legs po 'di bed spyod ma thub pas tha mar g.yul sa nas pham par gyur/ljar dmag gis mdun ngos nas pham kha nyos rjes ga ler u dmag gi g.yon rur rgol/u dmag gi spyi khyab bkod 'doms pa kha'o lu'u pa'o thig cen gyis ljar dmag gi gnas tshul gsal bo ma rtogs pas de dag gis phyogs kun bskor bar dogs nas 'gog sgo rim pa gnyis par phyir 'then byas/zla 8tshes 30nyin/ lngar dmag gi dmag khag gsum gyis dus gcig tu u dmag la rgol ba byas par u dmag gis kyang skyogs chen dang me moda'/gri mdung sogs kyis ljar dmag khag so sor ngo rgol byas te/ phyogs gnyis kyis nyin gcig ring la 'thab rjes u dmag phyir 'then mi byed thabs med byung / tshes 30nyin gyi mtshan mor lngar dmag 1880rkang 'jab lag 'jab kyis the tsu chu bo brgal te phyi nyin zhogs par u dmag gis g.yon dur 'thab pa ma zad/ u dmag g.yas ru la'ang phar rgol gyi shugs bsnan/ yin yang u dam/ sdug tram̐ so nas rgol lan bskrad pas lngar dmag phyir 'then byas pas

u dmag gi gnas bab je legs/ su song / yin yang u dam ga gis go skabs legs po 'di dam 'dzin ma thub pas mtshan mo der 'gog sgo rim pa gsum par phyir sdur byas/ zla 9tshes 1nas tshes 2nyin gyi mtshan mo'i bar phyogs gnyis gas yang bskyar g.yul bshams te dza drag che ba'i dmar 'dzing byas/skabs 'dir u dmag spyi khyab kha'o lu'u pa'o the cen gyis ljar dmag gis dmag shugs yod tshad bton yod pa ma zad pham nyes tshabs chen bzos pa ma rtogs pas/ gnas bab legs kyang tshes 3nyin gyi nangs mor li'o dbyang bskyur nas hrin dbyang srung / de nas li'o dbyang dmag 'khrug las u dmag 170①dang ljar dam/ga 2358lhag shi mthar/ li'o dbyang ljar pan gyis blangs/ u ru su srid gzhung gis pham kha'i gnas bab bsgyur ched dmag shugs la shugs snon byas nas 1904lo'i zla 9ba'i zla mjug tu/ byang shar sa khul du u dmag mi grangs khri 21la slebs/ 1904lo'i zla 9tshes 22nas zla 10tshes 4nyin gyi bar li'o dbyang dang hrin dbyang bar gyi hra hu sa khul du dmag 'khrug brgyab pas phan tshun la shi rmas thebs/ de nas so sos rang rang gi g.yul sar shugs snon byas te 1905lo'i zla 1po'i bar du bsdad/ gnas tshul 'di'i 'og tu ljar pan gyis dmag shugs yod rgu bton nas lu'u hron gru khar btsan rgol byas pa red/1904lo'i zla 6pa'i zla dkyil nas ljar dmag ru khag gsum pas mtsho dmag dang mnyam 'brel byas te lu'u hrin gru khar dpung 'jug byas/ u dmag 35000lhag gis rgol lan slog ljar dmag ru khag gsum par dpung rogs 'byor pas dmag grangs 50000zin pa des thengs du mar rgol ba byas kyang tshang ma u dmag gis phyir bdas/zla 11pa'i tshes 27nyin gyi mtshan mor/ ljar dmag gis dmag shugs yod tshad phyogs gcig tu bsdus te u dmag gi 203mtho sgang rji pha)1 snyil sa

shing / nyin dgu'i ring gi drag 'dzing brgyud dmag mi 16000lhag gi tshe srog rin thang gis zla 12tshes 5nyin mtho sgang de ljar dmag gis dbang du bzung /mtho sgang 'di thob pas phal cher lu'u hron gru kha'i dmag 'khrug gi mjug 'bras gtan 'khel byas pa red/ ljar pan gyis mtho sgang du skyogs chen bkod sgrig byas shing / zla 12tshes 9nyin u ru su'i dmag gru rtsa med du btang /rim bzhin u dmag gi 'thab ra 'gog srung gtso bo'i nye sar bcar/1905lo'i zla 1po'i tshes 1nyin/ lu'u hron gyi skam sa srung ba'i dmag spyi hri the ser gyis dmag dpon gzhan pa'i ngo rgol la ma 'dzems par pho nya mngags nas ljar dmag la mgo sgur rgyu'i re ba zhus/ zla 1po'i tshes 2nyin u dmag gis dngos su mgo sgur yi ger ming thel bkod de ljar dmag gis lu'u hron gru kha bzung bas dus yun zla 5lhag gi dmag 'khrug mjug rdzogs pa red/'thab 'khrug de'i khrod lngar dmag 60000lhag gi tshe srog shor la/ u dmag 32000lhag gi tshe srog shor ba dang / mi 20000lhag gson bzung byas/lu'u hron gru kha blangs pa nas bzung ljar dmag gis rgya mtsho spyod dbang yongs su bzung 'i/ rjes/ ljar dmag gis rgyal kha dang bstun nas hrin dbyang btsan bzung byas pa nas ljar u dmag 'khrug gi ches mtha' mjug gam yang na ches dza drag che ba'i dmag 'khrug gi mjug sgril/ dmag 'khrug 'di'i khrod du ljar sbyo/shā /0 //0lhag la shi rmas thebs shing / u dmag 120000lhag la shi rmas u dmag gi skam sa'i dmag dpung pham yang mtsho dmag gi mjug 'bras ji 'dra yin nam zhe na/ de yang pham song ste/ ljar u dmag 'khrug gi thog ma'i dus su/ gong ma nyi ku'u la sku rabs gnyis pas u ru su'i phor lu'u yi dmakā ༵ rud bag gis 6 zhi bde rgya mtsho'i dmag gru khag gnyis pa zhes pa
