btsugs nas shar phyogs su dpung rogs la mngags/dmag gru ru khag 'di la dmag gru rigs sna tshogs 38dang / rogs 'degs dmag gru 20lhag yod cing mtsho dmag dmag dpon la'o si the wun si ci yis spyi khyab bkod 'doms byed kyi yod/ thog mar dmag gru de dag 1904lo'i zla 7pa'i dkyil du 'gro rgyur sta gon byas kyang legs grub ma byung bas zla 10tshes 15nyin da gzod 'gro rgyu byung / skabs der ljar pan gyi mna' 'grel rgyal khab dbyin jis su'u yi hri chu bor dbang bsgyur byas yod phyir/ u dmag gis a hphe ri kha gling gi gru kha zhig bskor te 'gro dgos pa byung la lam thag spyi le 30000lhag brgyud pa de ni sa'i go la'i phyi thig ring tshad kyi 173zin/dmag gru ru khag 'di dus skabs thung ngu'i nang sgrig 'dzugs byas pas dmag rtsal gyi sbyong brdar med par dmag shugs ha cang zhan zhing nang khul 'gal ba'ang rgyun chad med pas mngar shugs med pa ma zad/ lam bar du dgod gtam 'ang gang mang bzos yod de/ kho tshos dmag gru re mthong ma thag ljar dmag red snyam nas de ma thag rmongs rtul gyis sgrogs 'del 'phangs/tha na u dmag la'ang de ltar byas pas phan tshun rgyag res byas myong / zla 10pa'i tshes 22nyin/ u dmag gis byang mtsho ru dbyin ji'i nya gru kha shas pa/rsha hā/ /bzlo//na ji'i srid gzhung gis 'di dang bstun nas u dmag la u dmag dmag gru ru khag gis 'bar rdzas sgul shugs gnad don thag gcod byed ched dmag gru'i steng gi gnas so sor sol ba brtsigs shing / des gru'i ljid tshad che ru btang bas myur tshad je dal du song /1905lo'i zla dang po'i zla mgor/ lu'u si the wun si cis lu'u hron shor ba rtogs rjes gong ma nyi ku'u la sku rabs gnyis par dmag phyir 'then rgyu'i re ba zhus mod/ gong mas mu mthud du shar bskyod byed dgos pa'i ༵/'a rdab/

dus yun ring bor mtsho nang du bskyod phyir gru'i 'bas su mtsho rtsa skyes pas gru'i myur tshad sngar bas kyang je dal du song bar ma zad/ de'i khrod lu'u si the wun si ci dang kho'i lag rogs pa hphu'u kha'i sa mu'u gnyis la nad gzhi lci mo 'is phog pas dmag shugs shin tu nyams par gyur la/ dmag mis rang srog gcod pa'i bya ba'ang bar med du byung ba ma zad/ tha na thengs du mar 6 dmag dpung gi zing cha mi yang byung /—u dmag dmag gru dpung khag gis zla 7lhag la mtsho bskyod byas pa brgyud rjes/ 1905lo'i zla 5bar shar phyogs kyi g.yul sar slebs/ skabs der ljar pan mnyam 'brel dmag gru ru khag gis te ma mtsho 'gag tu a thang chad pa'i dmag gru 'di tshor sgug yod/ljar pan mnyam 'brel dmag gru ru khag gi dmag spyi tung shang phen pā lang gi sta gon legs po zhig byas te dmag gru bskyar gso dang mtsho dmag la ngal gso byed du bcug rjes/ dmag rtsal sbyong brdar legs po byas/ khos u dmag kho re ya dang ljar pan bar gyi te ma mtsho 'gag brgyud de he tshan we ru 'gro par chod dpags byas nas/ ljar pan dmag gru ru khag gi gtso gas gnas 'dir bkod sgrig byas pa ma zad/ dus mtshungs su u dmag phal cher brgyud nges pa'i mtsho lam du chu'i 'gad rdzas bzhag cing bya ra byed mkhan rtsa 'dzugs byas nas/ 'phred du spyi le 225yod pa'i mtsho khyon la dra rgya bzos/zla 5ba'i tshes 27nyin la/ u dmag dmag gru ru khag te ma mtsho 'gag tu slebs rjes nye rabs su skad grags che ba'i rgya mtsho chen pa'i g.yul 'khrug thengs shig bslangs/ phyogs gnyis ga'i dmag shugs bsdur na/ lngar pan ni u dmag las cung 'dzoms po yin kyang / ches gal 'gangs che ba zhig ni/u dmag gis nyin 220lhag gis mtsho 'grul brgyud pas thang chad shugs zad kyi tshad 11 snang rdar ma zad/ dgra bo'i gnas tshul la rgyus lon dang rtogs

dpyod med la dam ga 'khrug gi thog ma'i 'char 'god kyang med pas dmag gru tshotsho — —/ tsho / snyi /ri ra pha ) riri kyi med ci ma 'guzu ci cho ga sgon tre(byung sa — pham goX lngar pan dmag grus u dmag gi phyogasasu'ajabagolabyedapa ru khag so so'i 'go khrid pas pha rol bo'i dar gru la rgyag rgyu dang / de nas he tshan we la 'bro rgyu las ci yang mi shes/ tung shang gis dngos su khrid pa'i dmag gru gtso gras kho re ya'i mtsho'i nye sar skung nas bsdad yod la/ des rang nyid kyi dmag gru ru khag la dmag chas bkol sa 'dang nges shig yong ched/u dmag dmag gru ru khag te ma mtsho 'gag brgyud tshar rjes da gzod phar rgol byed rgyu'i thag bcad/1905lo'i zla 5tshes 26nyin gyi mtshan mor/ u dmag dmag gru ru khag gis ljar phyogs kyi bkag sdom thig lam dang po brgal la/ lngar phyogs rtog dpyod dmag grus kyang ring nas rjes 'ded lta srung byas shing / gnas tshul ji bzhin skud med glog 'phrin brgyud de tung shang la yar zhu byas/ de bas tung shang gis u dmag gi nus pa dang 'gro phyogs/ myur tshad sogs ༵ 1/sa ḍiṅgen

gsal bo byung ba red/ zla 5ba'i tshes 27nyin gyi zhogs pa'i chu tshod 7gyi steng /u dmag gis ljar pan mtsho srung dmag gru mthong / chu tshod 9dang skar ma 40stong yang bskyar ljar pan mtsho srung dmag gru zhig mthong / skabs de'i u dmag gi dmag gral rnam pa ni/ dmag gru ru khag dang po dang gnyis pas g.yas ru grub pa dang / ru khag gsum pa dang mtsho srung dmag grus g.yon ru grub/ skyel 'dren gru rnams dkyil du yod/ chu tshod 11pa'i rjes su/ lu'u si the wun si cis dmag gral rnam pa bsgyur te/ gzhung bstar gcig tu sgrig rgyu'i the/kā ༵ba/ yin yang / dmag gru'i myur tshad mi mnyam pas rnyog 'dzing chen chu tshod 12pa tsam la bslebs dus/ lu'u si the wun si cis bsam par ljar dmag gis 'phred bstar byas te kho tshor rgol bar yang bskyar dmag gral 'phred bstar sgrig rgyu'i bka' pha pas rnyog 'dzing sngar las che bar gyur ba red/chu tshod 13dang skar ma 40yas mas su/ tung shang dmag gru gtso gras de 'phred bstar gcig byas te u dmag gi mdun nas mngon shing u dmag dmag gru ru khag 'phred gcod byed rgyu'i dmigs yul bcangs/ tung shang gis dmag gru ru khag yongs la 6 rgyal khab kyi pham nyes dmag 'khrug 'dir rag las pas/ dmag mi tsho 'bad 'bungs byos mi zhes skul ma btang /skabs der lu'u si the wun si cis yang bskyar dmag 'khrug gral bstar sgrig rgyu'i bka' phab kyang dus tshod med par gyur/ tung shang gis u dmag 'phred gcod byas zin par ma zad/ u dmag dang bar thag nye sa nas mtsho khul la g.yon bskor gyis 660 midabyibs su bzos/ dbyibs de ltar du sgrig bzhin pa'i dus su/ lngar pan dmag gru tag tag u dmag gi me shugs kyi khar lhung zhing / dmag gru mang che ba'i mthong lam rang nyid kyi dmag gru gzhan pas bgag /76 parji phar rgol byed thabs bral/ yin yang / u dmag kyang gral

bstar bsgyur ba'i rnyog 'dzing du lhung phyir lu'u si the lhun si cis me phyogs 'phen rgyu'i bka' phab kyang nges med du 'phangs pas mda' rdzas 'phro brlag bzos shing go skabs bzang po de yang shor/ ljar dmag gis gru dbyibs de bsgrigs tshar rjes nas shugs rtsal sprugs kyis u dmag gi dar grur brgyab pas/ ma 'gyangs par/ u dmag dmag gru 66a'o si li ya pe ya mirtags can de chur byings/ ljar dmag gis rang nyid kyi byang cha spyad nas phar rgol byas te chu tshod 14dang skar ma 25steng lu'u si the wun si cis dar grur dmag 'khrug gi nus pa nyams pa ma zad/ dmag dpon lu'u si the wun si ci la rmas ljid mo phog pas gson bzung byas/ dmag gru gzhan dag kyang gtor nas chur nub/u dmag dmag gru lhag ma rnams ljar dmag gi dmigs 'ben las bros mod myur tshad dal drag pas 'ga' shas gtor/ chu tshod 16pa yas mas su mtsho steng du smug sprin 'thibs pas tung shang gis dmag dpung byang phyogs su spos/yin yang phyogs gnyis ku'i mtsho srung dmag grus yang bskyar dza drag che ba'i dmag 'khrug byas/chu tshod 19pa tsam la sleb ga rjes da gzod u dmag dmag gru ru khag la nyi pa'o ca tha'o rmus tshab byed bkod 'doms byas shing mu mthud du byang phyogs su drangs/ nyin de'i mtshan mor/ ljar dmag gis chu mdel 75lhag u dmag gi sar 'phangs te gru chen zhig chur byings/ tshes 28nyin gyi zhogs pa'i chu tshod lnga'i steng du nyi pa'o li tha'o rmus khrid pa'i dmag gru nyung gras shig he tshan we phyogs su bros byol byas pa'i lam bar du ljar dmag dang 'phrad pas/thar ba'i re ba zad nas mgo 'dzul byas/de nas u ru su'i 'i bde rgya mtsho'i dmag gru ru chen gnyis pa rtsa ba nas med par bzos pa'o//dus yun lo gcig dang zla 3lhag gi ljar u dmag 'khruka delha ༵ ru tsho'i

pham nyes dang bstun nas ma jug sgril/ thengs 'di'i dmag 'khrug khrod du ༵༵༵ khri 12shi ba dang / 'gro song ma dngul u sgor dung phyur 26lhag la u ru su pham pa'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo ni rul srung nyams dmas su gyur ba'i gong ma'i sger gcod la ma lugs la rag las yod/ de las gzhan da rung dam ga dpon mtho gras khag rmongs shing nus pa zhan pas bkod 'doms nor 'khrul byas pa dang / dmag dpung la 'thab ra'i byang tshad 'an 'ing /'thab 'dzing la sun snang skyes pa/ dmag mi mi nyung ba zhig gis me mda' gsar ba bkol mi shes pa dang / dmag mang che bas kha par ci yin mi shes par skud pa bcad nas lham bsdams pa/ spyi le stong phrag 'ga'i lam thag gis dpung rogs dang 'bru rigs/ mkho dngos 'don sprod byed dka' bar gyur ba sogs tshang ma ni u dmag pham nyes su gyur ba'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo yin/ljar pan ni u ru su dang mi mthun par ming kri we zhin rjes su 'phel rgyas mgyogs pa'i ma rtsa ring lugs kyi lam du bskyod cing / des dmag shugs sbyong brdar dang dmag chas sgrig sbyor la shugs snon byas pas 'thab 'dzing gi nus pa u ru su las che/ rgyal spyi'i steng du/ dbyin ji dang a me ri khas kyang ljar pan la rgyab skyor thob la/ u ru sur mtshon na skabs der phyi 'brel med par rang rkyang du lus yod pa red/ de bas ljar u dmag 'khrug khrod du rgyal kha ljar pan la dbang ba'ang smos ma dgos so//ljar u dmag 'khrug ni btsan rgyal ring lugs rang bzhin gyi jag rkun ༵༵༵ /khrug cig yin la/ phyogs gnyis kur mtshon na der bden kha spu tsam 'thab 'dzing 'di'i g.yul sa gtso bo ni krung go'i byang shar sa khul yin parji krung 1spya'i rjodag dbang la gnod 'tshe tshabs chen bzos par ma zad/

krung go'i mi dmangs la'ang brjod las 'das pa'i sdug bsngal chen po bzos/'jar u dmag 'khrug gis 'thab rtsal thad la shugs rkyen gting zab pa ba'ag 'thab sa'i dam ga 'khrug ni dmag 'khrug 'di'i khrod du thog mar ma ngon pa yin te/ 'gog srung ru khag gis 'dzing rags bskrun pa dang /lcags dra 'then pa'i 'go bcoms pa 'dis snga mo 'i so ra sogs brtsigs pa/'i 'thab ra'i tshab byas pa yin/ de bas ljar u dam ga 'khrug gis 'thab rtsal phyogs su nang don gsar ba mang po 'ig gsab snon byas pa red/lja ra u dmag 'khrug gis da dung mtsho dmag gi 'thab rtsal phyogs nas kyang mthor 'degs su btang ste/ thog mar chu 'dzul dmag gru dang chu rme da' spyad/ 'thab 'dzing nyams myong las gsal don/ rgyang bskyod stogs chen ni dmag gru ru khag gi go tshon gtso bo yin pas/ de dang bstun nas dmag gru'i myur tshad dang khrab chas 'gog srung sogs mthor 'degs byas yod/ljar u dmag 'khrug khrod du/ thog mar me mda'i rigs mang po 'ig gsar du bzos pa ma zad/ lag 'bom dang mad mang mnyam 'phen gyi skyogs chen gsar bzo byas pas dmag 'khrug gi gnod 'tshe nus pa je cher gyur/ gong gi de dag tshang mas rjes kyi 'dzam gling dmag 'khrug thengs dang por shugs rkyen chen po thebs yod pa red/

6 hphan tan sha 'phag 'phrul 'khor dang so mu'u chu bo'i g.yul 'gyed/wa wa'adzam gling 'khrug chen thengs dang po'i khrod kyi zad gron che ba'i 'thab 'khrug thengs gnyis/'dzam gling 'khrug chen thengs dang po'i snga rol tu/ yo rob gling gi par /na gling phyed ni me rdzas dong kha bzhin ga dus yin yang 'gad sla ba'i gnas ga tu 1snyi/4/lo'i zla 6par o si khru ri ya dang hong ga ri btsan rgyal gyi rgyal sras dang / dmag rgyal ring lugs pa hpho lan chi hphe ti nan sku dngos kyis dmag dpung khrid de o si khru ri yas btsan bzung byas yod pa'i par sig ni ya nas dmag don sbyong brdar byas pa ma zad/ par sig ni ya'i rgyal sa sā la ra wor 'tshams 'drir phyin/ skabs 'di dang bstun nas ser we yar dmag rtsal dang stobs shugs ngoms te 'jigs snang skul/zla 6pa'i tshes 28nyin gyi snga dro'i chu chod 10pa'i steng hphe ti nan gyis 'khor lo ru khag sā la re wo khrom lam du bskyod skabs/ snga mo nas sgug bsdad yod pa'i ser we ya'i rgyal gces gzhon nu phu'u lan 'i pa'o yis myur du stel kram khrum mda' blangs te mde'u gnyis kyis hphe ti nan bza' zla gnyis lnga ba'i lam tu bskyal/ 'di ni lo rgyus stong skad grags che ba'i sā la re wo don rkyen yin pa ma zad 'dzam gling 'khrug chen thengs dang po 'byung ba'i rkyen du gyur/'dzam gling 'khrug chen thengs dang po ni (1914—1918)btsan rgyal ring lu/10 kyi 〉phrog bcom byed pa'i dmag 'khrug cig yin/ dmag 'khrug

tu zhugs pa'i btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi rgyal khab tshang ma ste/ mna' 'brel rgyal khab kyi 'jar o tshogs pa dang gros chings rgyal khab kyi dbyin hpha u tshogs pa sogs gang yin yang btsan 'dzul byed rgyu'i dmigs yul bcangs nas/rang gis btsan 'phrog byas zin pa'i sa cha la srung skyong byed rgyu dang / nyen kha che ba'i rang gi 'gran zla rtsa med du gtong rgyu ma zad/ rgyal khab gzhan du mi ser spel yul dang nus stobs kyi mnga' khongs rgya bskyed par brtson/ btsan rgyal ring lugs ni thengs 'dis dmag 'khrug slong mkhan nyes can yin/ sā la re wo don rkyen ni btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis dus yun ring bor btsal rnyed byung ba'i dmag 'khrug gi kha g.yar sa kho na red/ thengs 'di'i dmag 'khrug khrod ser we yas o hong btsan rgyal gyi btsan 'dzul la ngo rgol byas te mi rigs bcings 'grol byed pa'i drang bden gyi rang bzhin yod na yang / des dmag 'khrug spyi'i bden don min pa'i rang bzhin gzhan la bsgyur mi thub/sā la re lo don rkyen byung rjes/ 'jar man gyi dbang sgyur mkhan dmag 'khrug slong bar shin tu brel/ dbyin hpha u btsan rgyal ring lugs dang bsdur na/ 'jar man gyis dmag 'khrug rgyag par snga mo nas gra sgrig byas yod pa ma zad ha cang gya nom pa yang yin/ 'jar man gyis dmag 'khrug gi 'char gzhi ni snga mo 1905lo nas 'jar man dmag gi spyi dpon hri li hphan pa'o yis 'then yod pas 'char gzhi de'i ming la hri li hphan 'char gzhi zer/ 'char gzhi de'i kha phyogs ni myur bar dmag 'khrug brgyab ste myur bar rgyal kha 'thob rgyu de yin la/ nang don gtso bo ni u ru sur bar thag ring ba dang lcags lam mang po med pa/ dmag mi rnams rgyal mtshams su bskyal na phal cher zla ngo gcig dang phyed ga'i dus tshod dgos par bsam blo btang ste/ dus chod 'di'i ring la 'jar man gyis myur du dmag don 'gul skyod byas chog pa dang / ru dpung chen po gcig gis u ru sur lta rtog byas chog pa dang ru dpung che/ 2rdo bdun

gyis hpha ran si dang dmag 'khrus rgyag rgyu/ de'i khrod kyi ru khag brgyad kyis 'jar hpha sa mtsham sa srung rgyu dang / dmag shugs gtso bos gnam nas thog babs pa ltar 'gog srung gi shed shugs chung ba'i la 'o san pa'o dang sgyel kram brgyud de hpha ran si'i mtha' khul la bskyod nas/ hpha dam ga rnam sa 'jar pho'i sa mtshams nas tshar gcod rgyu/ de nas hpho ar mtsho 'gag blangs nas dbyin ji dang yo rob gling skam sa chen po'i 'brel mchos bcad de/ gza' 'khor drug gi nang hpha ran si rtsa med du gtong rgyu/ de nas stobs shugs gcig sgril byas te mna' mthun gyi rogs skyor med pa'i u ru sur mdung kha gtod rgyu'i 'char ga'i 'then yod/ 'on kyang / 'char gzhi 'dis rang gi stobs shugs la gdeng 'jog tshad mthon po byas rkyen mthar yo ngas rdzogs rmi lam ba'in ma ngon sum du ma grub/1914lo'i zla 7pa'i tshes 28nyin o hong btsan rgyal gyis ser we yar dngos su dmag brda btang / de'i rjes nas gros chings rgyal khab dang mna' 'brel rgyal khab dag rim bzhin 'thab 'khrug la zhugs pa dang / 'dzam gling 'khrug chen thengs dang po dngos su 'go brtsams/ dmag 'khrug de yo rob nas rim gyis a she ya dang a hphe ri kha gling sogs la rgya bskyed/ 'on kyang /dmag 'khrug yongs su yo rob skam sa ni g.yul 'gyed kyi gnas gtso bo yin/'di nas dmag 'khrug gi lam thig gsum chags pa ste/ nub lamawa wa 'jar dmag gis dbyin ji dang / hpha ran si/ stel kram bcas la 'thab pa/shar lamawa 'jar o dmag gis u ru sur 'thab pa/ par kun gyi 'thab lamawa o dmag dang ser we ya gnyis 'thab pa'o//zla 8pa'i tshes 2nyin 'jar man gyis 'char gzhi ltar la'o san — 222 —

phyogs sa khul la dpung 'jug gi gzhi thig je chung du btang /zla 9pa'i tshes 4nyin gyi sa srod du/ 'jar dmag pha ri si'i shar phyogs kyi mā an chu 'gram du slebs pa dang chu bor brgal 'go bcoms/ phyi nyin kyi skya rengs shar ba dang mnyam du dbyin pho'i dmag gis ngo rgol byas/ dmag 'khrug tu zhugs pa'i phyogs gnyis kyi dmag mi khri tsho 150la slebs/ dza drag gi 'thab 'khrug tu 'jar dmag khri tsho 20lhag shi rmas byung bas/ tshes 9nyin nas phyir 'then byas te tshes 10nyin ye na gtsang 'gram du slebs pa dang /phyogs gnyis ka kha gtad du 'dug dgos pa'i gnas tshul byung / zla 12par slobs na'ang nub lam phyogs su rgyal pham gyi dbye ba ma byung / mā an gtsang boragayul 'gyed kyi 'bras bu des glog 'khyug pa nang bzhin hpha ran si med par gtong rgyu'i hri li hphan 'char gzhi rtsa ba nas thor/shar lam steng u dmag gis nub lam gyi 'thab rtsod la gzhigs 'degs byed ched snga mo nas 'thab kyang rgyal pham gyi dbye ba ma byung / zla 12bar par kun 'thab lam du o hong dmag khag tshang ma ser we ya mnga' khongs nas phyir bskrad/ de nas 1915lo'i zla 10ba'i zla stod du o ser dmag 'khrug zhi 'jags su song /'jar man gyis nub lam steng gi dpung 'jug la pham kha nyos rjes/dmag 'khrug gi 'thab jus bcos bsgyur byas te/ 1915lor stobs shugs gcig tu sgril te shar lam phyogs nas u ru su pham par bzos nas zhi chings 'jog rgyu'i 'char gzhi 'then yang stong zad du song /'jar man nas shar nub phyogs gnyis kyi 'thab ra'i yun ring bor zad gron che ba'i 'thab 'khrug rgyag dgos byung / yin yang 'jar man gyi mi shugs dang dngos shugs tshang ma nyams pas yun ring por 'thab 'khrug byed thabs ༵༵ / tram̐ bas hri li hphan 'char gzhi nyams chag byung ba ni 'jar man

pham pa'i snga ltas su grub/1916lor 'jar man gyis yang bskyar dmag shugs gtso bo nub lam phyogs su bsgyur/ zla 2ba'i tshes 21nyin lngar dmag gis sngar med pa'i me shugs dang dug rdzas bkol te hpha ran si'i phen tan g.yul sar dpung 'jug byed rgyu'i 'go brtsams/ hphan tan ni skabs der hpha ran si'i bzo skrun gyi 'gag gnas gtso bo zhig yin te hpha ran si'i byang shar phyogs su gnas la 'jar hpha mtha' mtshams dang thag mi ring / lcags lam dang gzhung lam bcu drug hphan tan la brgyud yod pas/ de ni hpha ran si'i g.yul sa'i ches che ba'i 'grim 'grul gyi 'gag rtsa yin pa ma zad pha ri sir bgrod pa'i lam gtso bo dang hpha dmag gi rten gzhi gtso bo zhig yin/de'i rkyen gyis hpha dmag gis btsan rdzong 'di nges par du srung dgos pas dmag shugs la mu mthud nas shugs bsnan nas me phyogs 600lhag bkod sgrig byas/(de'i nang phyogs chen 244yod) pho dmag gis 'dir 'gog srung byed pa'i 'thab rags rim pa bzhi bzos yod/ 'thab rags rim pa bzhi ba ni hphan tan yun gtan 'thab rags dang btsan rdzong gnyis kyis grub pa yin pas/ hpha ran si bas 'di ni su zhig kyang brgal mi nus pa'i 'gag cig yin par sems yod/ 'on kyang 'jar dmag gi drag jus dmag dpon phor kun han gyis bsam bzhin du btsan rjong 'di gtor rgyu'i dmigs 'ben bzung nas/ khong gis bshad rgyur/ phen tan blangs nas hpha ran si'i mi rnams kyi yid ches la blo kha bsgyur rgyu dang hpha ran si phyogs yongs nas pham par rgyag rgyu yin zer/ 'jar dmag gis hphan tan 'phrog phyir stobs 'byor che ba'i dpung khag bkod sgrig byas yod de/ dmag shugs spyi la dpung tshogs khag lnga yod de ru khag 17dang mi grangs khri 27yod pa dang / me phyogs 1204yod pa'i nang skyogs chen 683yod/ gzhan gnam gruspra ཿ/zid rji we

lan rgyal sras kyis bkod 'doms byed ba'in yod/ tshes 21nyin gyi thogs par rkang dmag gis phar rgol gyi 'go bcoms pa'i sngon la 'jar dmag gis chu tshod bcu tsam la me phyogs brgyab/ hpha ran si'i rtsom pa po zhig gis skabs de'i rnam pa zhib 'bri yod pa ni/ sngar med ya nga ba'i snang tshul mig gis lta mi bzod cing me phyogs kyis mi lus dang mkho chas/ so phag tshang ma bar snang du gtor/ 'bar rdzas kyi tsha bas gangs 'khyugs bzhus pas/ me phyogs brgyab shul gyi dong chen chus bkang te rmas ma mang che ba chur 'thims nas shi 'dugamig dbang nyams pa dang sha khrag lus 'byar gyi mis sa phug nas lag nyob bgyis te bde 'jags 'tshol bzhin yod na'ang / cang ma 'gor bar kho tsho grogs po'i thog log ste lus po yongs kyang zungs khrag gis brlan par byas zhes bris yod/ shugs chen po'i me phyogs drag 'phen gyi 'thab 'dzing khrod rkang dmag gis dpung 'jug byed 'go brtsams/ 'jar dmag gis me phyogs kyis 'thab ra'i khrod kyi hpha dmag rnams rtsa med du btang song snyam pa las/ hpha dmag gis da dung rang sa srung zhing shugs chen pos rgol lan sprod pa yid la'ang ma shar/ yin yang / nyin der 'jar dmag gis 'thab rags rim pa dang po blangs /tshes 22nyin nas 25nyin bar gyi nyin ba'i'i nang / 'jar dmag gis yang bskyar phar rgol byas te 'thab rags rim pa gnyis pa dang tu'u o man phyogs stegs mnga' 'og tu bcug pho dmag dpung khag du mar bcad/hphan tan gyi gnas bab ha cang nyen kha chen por gyur/dza drag che ba'i dus 'dir hpha dmag gis spyi khyab bkod 'doms pa zha nyes zla 2pa'i tshes 25nyin dpung tshogs khag gnyis pa'i dmag spyi pe ting dmag 'khrug der zhugs dgos pa'i bka' phab/ pe ting gis g.yul sa 'gog kāṭā/ rji shas su bgos pa dang chabs cig tu 'grim 'grul dang bzo

bkod phyogs gnyis kyi tshogs pa btsugs nas/ pa le tu'u khe grong nas hphan tan 'gag yod pa'i gzhung lam brgyud de dngos po dang dmag mi mang po kha snon byas/ bsdoms rtsis byas pa ltar na zla 2pa'i tshes 27nas zla 3tshes 6nyin bar cha snyoms byas na dus tshod 24nang mo ṭa 6000gzhung lam 'dir brgyud yod/ dmag mi khri tsho 19dang phyugs zog khri 17g.yul sar bskyal te dmag shugs la kha snon byas/ de nas bzung ga'i khyon chen po'i sgo nas rlangs 'khor gyis mi shugs dang dngos shugs skyel ba'i 'go bcoms pa'i mig dpe bstan/'jar hpha phyogs gnyis kyis mu mthud du dmag shugs la kha snon brgyab pas 'thab 'khrug gi rnam pa ni sog le 'then pa lta bur byung /zla 3pa'i tshes 5nyin nas bzung / 'jar dmag gis sngon la spyi le 15yod pa'i mdun ngos kyi g.yul sa de spyi le sum cu'i mtshams su rgya bskyed pa dang / dmag 'khrug gi mdung kha gtso bo de ma si gtsang bo'i g.yon 'gram du gtad/ der ma zad dmag 'khrug mgyogs por rgyag pa de gom stabs brtan pos phar rgol byed par bsgyur/ skabs der blo yul las 'das pa'i 'khyams mdel zhig gis hpha dmag la gnas bab legs po bskrun pa'i rmang bting /zla 4ba'i zla 'gor phyogs gnyis kyi 'thab 'dzing khrod du hpha dmag gi 'khyams mdel zhig gis ma bsam sa nas si po khor nags tshal du sbas pa'i 'jar dmag gis gsang ba'i go tshon gnas gzhi la phog ste phyogs mda' khri45bkad pas thengs 'dis 'thab 'dzing khrod kyi 'bar 'gad ches chen po byung / 'jar dmag gis grangs las 'das pa'i phyogs chen la mdel med par gyur te 'thab ra'i khrod 'gul ma thub/ hpha dmag gis go skabs 'di ma shor ba byas nas rim bzhin 'jar dmag gi me skyogs sngon dang rkang dmag rjes kyi thabs jus gtor/zla 2pa'i zla mjug nas zla 4ba'i bar gyi nyin zhag 7spridī sta rjor

dmag khyon bsdoms pa'i spyi le 6nas 7tsam gyis mdun bskyod byas/ zla 6pa'i tshes 23nyin 'jar dmag gis ru dpung 20yi dmag shugs bkol nas yang bskyar shugs chen po'i phar rgol byas kyang mthar hpha dmag gi mjug mtha'i 'gog sgo de gtor ma thub/hphan tan g.yul 'gyed ni shin tu dza drag chen por gyur/ phyogs gnyis kyis mi mthud du shugs gsar ba kha bsnon byas pas zad gron che ba'i 'thab 'khrug tu gyur/ zla 8par slebs yang 'jar dmag gis da dung hpha dmag gi 'gog sgo de gtor ma thub/ 'jar dmag gi zla 6dang phyed ring la dpung 'jug byas kyang / spyi le 7— 10las bskyod med/ 1916lo'i zla 10pa'i tshes 24nyin/ hpha dmag gis dmag mi khri 17dang me sgrogs 70 gnam gru 150bcas bkol nas gzhi khyon chen po'i ngo rgol byas te tu'u o man skyogs stegs phyir blangs/ dus de nas bzung 'jar dmag gom pa re re ba'in phyir 'then 'go brtsams/phen tan g.yul 'gyed khrod phyogs gnyis kyis skyogs chen dang me mda' sbag sbag/ me gtong skyogs sogs bkol spyod byas stabs shi rmas chen po byung /'jar man gyis khyon bsdoms pa'i ru dpung lnga bcu'i dmag 'thab 'khrug tu zhugs kyang mi grangs khri 60la nye ba gron/ hpha ran sa'i dam ga 'khrug la zhugs pa'i dmag shugs ru dpung 69la dmag mi 358000gron/ lo rgyus steng dmag 'thab 'di'i ming la hphan tan sha 'thag 'phrul 'khor zer/ mdel rdzas kyi gyong gud de las kyang ha las pa 'ig red/ zla 10ring gi dam ra gsod khrod phyogs gnyis kyi phyogs mdel khri 4000lhag dang mde'u bgrang gis mi zin pa 'phangs/ g.yul sa'i steng bkad pa'i sa dong gi tshad ni khang brtsegs bcu tsam zab/ phen tan g.yul 'gyed ni 'dzam gling 'khrug chen thengs dang po'i da/)ཿsa /tshams yin la des 'jar man gyi dmag don rgyas pa nas

'grib pa mtshon/ 'jar dmag gi spyi khyab drag jus dmag dpon phor kun tan gyis zla 8pa'i tshes 28nyin rang skyon ngos len gyis go gnas las babs pa dang zhen ten pa'o zhes pas spyi khyab drag jus dmag dpon gyi 'gan bzhes/der ma zad hphan tan g.yul 'gyed byed bzhin pa'i skabs su hpha dmag gispyi khyab dmag dpon zhwa hphe yis 'jar dmag gi stobs sil bar byas nas hphan tan gyi gnon shugs chung ngur gtong rgyu'i thad bsam gzhigs byas/dbyin pho'i dmag gi 'go khrid kyis gros bsdur byas pa brgyud so mu'u gtsang po'i 'gram rgyud nas g.yul sa gzhan gcig 'dzugs rgyu gtan la phab pa ma zad/ 1916lo'i zla 6pa'i zla mjug nas sa khul der dmag don 'gul skyod byed pa'i 'char gzhi bkod/skabs der hpha dmag mang che shos hphan tan na yod pas so mu'u gtsang bo'i sa khul du 'then nas pa ru dpung 16yod la/ de la sa dmag 'khrug gi nyin dang por ru dpung 5 ma gtogs thon med/ de bas phar rgol gyi 'gan gtso bo dbyin dmag gis 'khur/ dbyin dmag la bsdoms pas ru dpung 21dang de'i khrod skya dmag ru dpung 5yod/1914lor dmag 'khrugaci gi 'go bcoms pa nas so mu'u gtsang bos khul cung tsam lhang 'jags yin/ 'on kyang 'jar dmag gis gtsang bo'i 'gram rgyud sa khul nas sa 'og tu phyogs bsdus kyi g.yul sa sra brtan bzos yod/dbyin khre 40zab pa'i sa 'og tu dong lam gyi rgya bzos te nang du za khang dang lu ba bkru sa/ myur skyob sa tshigs sogs las pa ma zad bongs che ba'i rdzas mdel gyi mdzod dang / tha na skabs der dmangs tshogs khyim tshang du mthong dkon pa'i glog sgron (khra'e yi'u glog 'don 'phrul 'khor gyi glog shugs 'don pa)yang yod/ 'jar dmag gis sa khul 'di srung skyob byed ched go rim ldan pa'i bkod sgrig byas nas sa 'og dong lam du 'dzul sa dang phyir ༵༵ sa/ sgo

tshang ma sde ba'i 'dug khang dang nye ba'i nags tshal du sbas yod/ 'jar dmag gis srung skyob khongs gtogs de ri ldebs rgyud nas rim bzhin je mthor btang yod la ar 'dam lcags rtsib mas bzos pa'i skyogs chen gyi skyogs stegs kyis bkang yod/ dbyin pho'i dmag gis phar rgol byed 'dod na nges par tu mdel shugs 'di dag gi 'og nas 'gro dgos pas mi srog 'bor chen btang na ma gtogs 'gro mi thub/ yin yang / 'jar dmag gis mtho sa nas dbyin hpha dmag dpung gis bkod sgrig gsal bor mthong thub/ de dang mnyam du 'jar dmag gsang myul ba gang sa gang du 'gul bskyod byas te gsang 'phrin mang po bsdus/ tha na dbyin tpa'i dmag dpon gyis gsang gtam yang shes thub/ de bas dbyin po'i dmag gis phar rgol byed rgyu'i nyi pa'ang kho tshos phal cher shes 'dug pas dmag 'khrug byed rgyu'i gra sgrig bzang byasazla/ 6pa'i tshes 24nyin gros chings rgyal khab kyi dmag dpung gis bongs che ba'i phyogs chen tshogs pas sa mu'u gtsang 'gram gyi 'jar dmag la rgol pa'i 'go brtsams/ gza' 'khor gcig gi ring rgyun ma chad par skyogs mdel 'phangs pa dang / zla 6pa'i tshes 30nyin skyogs 'phen dza drag tu gyur bas grangs med pa'i phyogs mdel 'jar dmag gi sgar la 'phur nas gnam sa cha lang brdabs pa lta bu byung / nyin 7ring dbyin pho'i dmag gis bsdoms pas phyogs mdel khri 150brgyab/ grangs ka 'di ni thengs 'di'i dmag 'khrug sngon gyi zla 11ring dbyin ji'i bzos pa'i skyogs mdel yongs las kyang mang / cha snyoms byas na smi gru bzhi ma gcig gi sar phyogs mdel tun gcig la nye ba brgyab yod/ 'jar dmag gis kyang rgol lan sprad/ mjug mtha'i nyin kha shas la char pa chen po babs pas phyogs gnyis kyi dgra 'gog gi sa 'obs thams cad 'dam du gyur/— 230 —

zla 7pa'i tshes 1nyin gyi zhogs par/ dbyin tpa'i dmag dpung gis me phyogs rgyag mtshams bzhag ste rkang dmag gis phar rgol byed pa'i dmag dung bus te 'jar dmag gi g.yul sar bskyod 'go bcoms/ yin na yang mdun bskyod kyi gom pa ha cang dal/ rgyu mtshan ni dmag mi re res ljid tshad la pang 66yod pa'i dngos po khur yod de/ der me mda' dang mde'u 220 'bom gnyis dang bye khug gnyis bcas yod pa las gzhan/ da rung lcags khem dang kha par sgrig chas/ 'phrin skyel phug ron gyi sgam sogs dmag spyod dngos rdzas yod/ kho tshos dpa' ngar bskyed nas dgra bo'i sa 'obs kyi mdun phyogs su slebs dus 'jar dmag gi mdel shugs kyis dbyin tpa'i dmag mi khri stong mang po lnga ba'i lam du brdzangs/ 'jar dmag gis mu mthud du phyogs stegs thig tshad sgrig ste mdel 'phang pas nyi ma nub khar g.yul sar shi rmas byung ba'i dbyin pho'i dmag khri 6la slebs/ nyin ma gcig gi ring shi rmas kyi mi grangs rshadi /dra mang por slebs pa ni 'das pa'i dmag 'khrug khrod byung ma myong ba ga ༵ /7pa'i tshes 14nyin bar/ gza' 'khor gnyis ring dmar 'dzing byas kyang / dbyin dmag khrod ches mgyogs pa'i ru khag mdun du spyi le gsum tsam bskyod thub pa dang / hpha dmag kyang spyi le 6tsam las mdun du bskyod med/yin yang / 'jar man gyis hphan tan la dpung rogs byed rgyu'i nus pa med par gyur bas hpha ran sis hphan tan bzung ngo //1916lo'i zla 9ba'i tshes 15nyin dbyin dmag gis khong tsho'i gsang ba'i mtshon cha than khe thengs dang por dmag 'khrug la bkol spyod byas/ de'i rjes nas than khe ni thengs 'di'i dmag 'khrug khrod kyi mtshon cha yag shos su gyur/ mtshon cha 'di'i gsar gtod ni grong khyer rgol ba'i mdel phyogs dang dug rlangs la bsdur na don snying chen po ldan/ than khe gzir kārdod sdod

mkhan gtso bo ni o na si the si wun tun hrang zho yin/ 'jar phyogs kyi gsang myul mgo bskor ba'i ched du mtshon cha chen po 'di'i ming la than khe zer/dbyin skad du 6 lcags snod kyi don yin/ so mu'u gtsang bo'i dmag 'khrug byed pa'i sngon la dbyin jis than khe 48bzos/ dbyin dmag gi bkod 'doms dmag dpon he gis than khe 'di dag dmag 'khrug la bkol dgos pa'i bka' phab/ 'on kyang skabs de ni than khe tshod lta byed bzhin pa'i sgang yin pas nas pa ha cang zhan pa dang kha lo bar sbyong brdar yang thob med/than khe 49las 10tsam 'jar dmag gi dmag sar bskyod pa red/ 'jar dmag gi me mda' sbag sbag des gtos che ba'i than khe la rgol lan sprod ma thub par phyir bros/ than khes 'jar dmag gi lcags dra rnams bcad de skyogs chung rnams bcom pa dang 'obs las brgal/ de'i khrod kyi than khe gcig gis sde ba gcig dbang du bzung / than khe gzhan dag gis dmag 'obs shig dbang du bsdus shing 'jar dmag 300lhag gson bzung byas/yin na yang than khes kyang 'jar dmag gi 'gog srung ma lag las brgal ma thub la so rme'u gtsang bo'i g.yul sa'i gnas bab bcos bsgyur byed ma thub/mna' mthun rgyal khab kyis kyang dus mi ring par than khe bzos/ 'dzam gling 'khrug chen thengs dang po mjug rdzogs la nye ba'i skabs than khe ni g.yul sar rgyun du mthong thub pa'i mtshon char gyur/so mu'u gtsang bo'i dmag 'khrug de zla 7pa nas phar rgol byed pa'i 'go bcoms te zla 11bar slebs/ dus rer 'jags shing dus rer 'khrug pa'i ngang lo mjug la slebs/ de dus mtha' 'khor gyi dmag 'khrug phal cher mtshams bzhag pa dang so mu'u gtsang bo'i dmag 'khrug don dngos su mjug rdzogs/ thengs 'di'i goyul 'gyed kyis g.yul sa dang dmag 'khrug gi gnas 112 spyi rji 'gyur ldog gtong ma thub/ phyogs gnyis la nyams nyes shin

tu tshabs chen byung bas mu mthud nas dmag 'khrug rgyag pa'i nus pa zad/thengs 'di'i g.yul 'gyed khrod shi rmas byung ba'i mi grangs bsdoms na khri 120lhag la slebs/ de'i khrod kyi khri 61ni hpha dmag dang dbyin dmag yin la/khri 65ni 'jar dmag yin/ dmag 'khrug ni dza drag che 'ing gdug rtsub che bas rgyang ring pa'i pu re then gling tshom steng gi dbyin ji nas kyang g.yul sa'i phyogs sgra'i skad go bar grags/ so mu'u gtsang bo'i g.yul 'gyed ni deng rabs lo rgyus thog zungs khrag bzhur ba ches mang ba'i g.yul 'gyed cig yin pa dang / 'jar man gyi dpal 'byor dang dmag don nus shugs nyams pa'i mtshon rtags thog ma yin/ thengs 'dis g.yul 'gyed kyi rjes nas dbyin pho'i dmag don nus rtsal 'jar man las brgal ba'i 'go bcoms/hphan tan dang so mu'u gtsang bo'i g.yul 'gyed chen po 'di gnyis brgyud de 'jar man la myur du rgyal kha thob pa stong bsam du gyur ba dang /rjes nas dmag 'khrug gi 'phel rgyas kyi gnas tshul des gros chings rgyal khab kyi gnas bab je legs su song bas 'jar man gyis phar rgol nas 'gog srung gi 'thab jus la mi bsgyur ka med byung / de'i rjes nas mna' 'brel rgyal khab rnamasakha thor ru thor du gyur pa red/1918lo'i zla 11pa'i tshes gnyin 'jar dmag gi 'thus tshab pas kon tshi nye nags tshal nas zhi mthun yong ba'i re ba zhu ba'i dar dkar bsgrengs/zla 11pa'i tshes 11nyin gyi tho rengs chu tshod 5ba'i steng 'jar man dang gros chings rgyal khab gnyis kyi dmag 'khrug mtshams 'jog pa'i chings yig la ming rtags bkod de 'jar man mgo sgur ba khyab bsgrags byas/ de nas lo bzhi dang zla gsum ring la 'thab pa'i 'dzam gling 'khrug chen thengs dang po dngos su mjug rdzogs so//— 233 —

dpa'aca'i snying stobs mtshon zhinga'ad skyoba'i 'phab glu zhigawa wasi phan gyis hpha zhi sir ngo rgol byas pa'i mi rigs gsar brje'i dmag 'khrugakrung go'i gsar brje'i dngos mang bshams ston khang du bshams pa'i dar cha zhig tu rgya yig dang dbyin yig gnyis kyis 'di ltar bris 'dug ste/rgyal spyi'i gzhung sgrig ru khag krung go yan lag ru khug gi krung si mi dasnangs mnyam 'brel byas te mi rigs kyi spyi dgra hpha zhi si btsan rgyal ba gtor da sa/dmag 'khrug gi me lce brgyud pa'i gos chen gyi dar cha 'di ni krung go dang si phan rgyal khab gnyis kyi mi dmangs kyis lhan du hpha 'i sir ngo rgol byas pa'i mdza' brtse'i mtshon rtags shig yin/ 'dis nga tshor bstan pa ni si phan dmag 'khrug gi lo zla ste 1936—1939lo'i bar gyi mi rigs gsar brje'i dmag 'khrug de yin/ dmag 'khrug 'dir zhugs mkhan krung go ba yod pa ma zad rgyal khab gzhan gyi yar thon mi sna yang mang po yod/ kho tshos tshe srog dang zungs khrag gis 'byor med gral rim gyi rgyal spyi'i ring lugs par rgyal kha thob pa'i glu dbyangs shig bris/1936lor hpha zhi si'i sprin nag yo rob kyi mkha' dbyings su 'khrigs dus rgyal spyi'i ring lugs kyi 'thab mo ba skor skor byas te si phan rgyal sar bskyod nas hpha zhi si dmag 'khrug la ngo rgol byed pa'i g.yul sa gtso bo nas gsar du tshugs pa'i si phan spyi mthun rgyal khab srung skyob byas pa red/— 234 —

si phan ni dus rabs 16pa'i skabs su 'dzam gling steng ches stobs ldan gyi mi ser spel mkhan gyi btsan rgyal yin/ 1588lor dbyin jis mtsho thog dmag 'khrug khrod si phan 2 zla med dmag gru ru khag ’ phal cher rtsa med du btang / de nas bzung si phan rim bzhin nyams rgyad du 'gro ba'i 'go brtsams shing sngon chad kyi mi ser spel yul yang re re bzhin shor te mtsho thog gi stobs ldan rgyal khab kyi go gnas la dbyin ji thon/ dus rabs 20pa'i dus mgor/ si phan gyi srid 'byor dmag gsum rgyal khab gzhan rnams las rjes lus su gyur/1931lor si phan gyi gral rim 'gal ba dang mi rigs 'gal ba rno ngar can du gyur nas/ sger gcod la ngo rgol dang spyi mthun brtson len byed pa'i gsar brje'i 'gul skyod de rgyal yongs sa gnas so so nas dbyar mtsho rgyas pa bzhin 'phelargyas byung mthar 'byor ldan gral rim gyi dmangs gtso gsar brje langs pa red/ rgyal po a hpheng so sku rabs 13pa skrag snang gis phyi rgyal du byi( dhri kā/ta/ / phan gyi phor pang rgyal rabs de gsar brje'i mtho rlabs kyis rtsa zla 4pa'i tshes 14nyin si phan spyi mthun rgyal khab dngos su dbu brnyes/gsar du dbu brnyes pa'i 'byor ldan gral rim gyi mnyam 'brel srid gzhung gis mi dmangs kyi skul 'ded 'og rtsa khrims khyab bsgrags byas pa dang 'byor ldan gral rim gyi rang dbang dmangs gtso lag bstar byas te gung khron tang khrims dang mthun pa'i sgo nas gnas chog la/ ca the lo ni ya mi rigs la rang skyong gi dbang cha cung tsam sprang pa dang sa bogs je yang du btang / gnam bdag chos lugs dang rgyal khab kyi srid dbang so sor phye/ zhon kyang / zhing ba'i sa zhing gi gnad don dang bzo ba'i las zhugs/ gla rdzogs kyi gnad don/da dung mi rigs rang skyong gi dbang cha'i gnad don sogs gtso bo khag cig — 235 —

rsharshayokā bye lha 'i/ rta rnge 5 475 da 5 ri ༷ dal / sa/) sne / 41— ri 'i ( ska sgo dī ma do 9 dī mo /dzha 7 44 (khang sgo dzaX4༷ rdzong /shuXng shār tho 3 32 ( 4sna rtoshā zhe chidapyoring nga (4ṭa )ri na kā cho /mi tsho ske sno 55 4 motso ri'i tho ringan snar ri ngaX

po thob pa dang / le lu'u si gtso byas pa'i log spyod srid gzhung btsugs/srid gzhung 'di'i lo gnyis kyi ring srid skyong byas pa'i khrod gsar brje par smyo spyod kyi sgo nas phyir rgol slog rtsis byas shing gsar brje'i 'gul bskyod la drag gnon byas/ dmangs gtso gsar brje'i thog ma'i 'bras bu rnams rim bzhin med par btang / si phan gung khron tang gi kha lo thur du bsgyur/ lo 'di gnyis la gzhan kyis 6 mun nag gi lo gnyis mi zhes zer/smyo spyod can gyi ngo log pa'i stobs shugs mdun nas si phan gung khran tang gis bzo ba gral rim gcig gyur dang hpha zhi sir ngo rgol ba 'thab phyogs gcig gyur byed ched bya ba mang po bsgrubs/ 1936lo'i zla dang por gung khran tang dang spyi tshogs tang / g.yon phyogs spyi mthun tang dang spyi mthun ring lugs mna' mthun tshogs pa/ bzo ba'i mna' mthun tshogs pa sogs rtsa 'dzugs kyis mi dmangs 'thab phyogs kyi hpha zhi si'i chab srid la ngo rgol gyi mna' mthun btsugs/ cang ma 'gor bar mi dmangs 'thab phyogs la1936lo'i zla 2pa'i tshes 16nyin gyi dbyi tu'i 'dems bsko khrod rgyal kha thob/g.yon phyogs spyi ma thun tang mi a sa ni ya yis srid gzhung rtsa 'dzugs byas shing kho rang tsung thung la bdams/ g.yon phyogs spyi mthun tang gi ce lu'u cas tsung li'i 'gan 'khur/ 'di ni si phan dmangs gtso'i nus shugs kyi rgyal kha thengs dang po yin/ci lu'u ca'i srid gzhung gis mi dmangs ma/nga tshogs kyi gsar brje'i las 'gul gyi skul 'ded 'og chab srid nyes can pa 30000btson grol btang / 6 mun nag gi lo gnyis ’ jiding 'dzin bzung byas pa'i bzo ba rnams kyi las ka slar gso byas/ cwa the lu'u nyi ya'i rang skyong dbang cha'ang slar gso byas/ hpha 'i si rtsa 'dzugs kyi 'go khrid 'ga' 'dzin bzung byas te btson la bcug zhing pa khri tsho bcur nye tsam la sa zhing thob/ si phar ga~X 3stan tshong

slar pazlo khrims dang mthun pa'i srid tang du gyur te tang yon mi grangs khri 10la si dīpa/ mi dmangs 'thab phyogs kyi rgyal khab dang rjes kyi hpha ran si mi dmangs 'thab phyogs la rgyal kha thob pa des dbyin hpha btsan rgyal ring lugs par nam rgyun dang mi 'dra bar 'jigs skrag chen po byung / kho tshos mi dmangs 'thab phyogs de ni rang nyid kyi srid dbang la nyen kha che ba'i lha gung khran ring lugs kyi nad yams ’ su sems nas/ kho tsho hpha zhi si la dga' bor brtsi ba las mi dmangs kyi 'thab phyogs la mi dga' bas 'jar man dang dbyi tha li'i hpha 'i si sogs la skul slong gis si phan la the gtogs byed du bcugaskabs der zhe the lis hpha zhi si stobs shugs rgya bskyed par 'dod pa ma zad 'jar man la ma 'ongs pa'i btsan 'dzul dpung rogs pa 'tshol bzhin yod/si phan ni yo rab lho nub kyi ye pe li ya phyed du gnas shing byang phyogs hpha ran si dang 'brel/ lho ngos nas spyi le 20yis bar chod pa'i e pu'u la'o tho mtsho 'gag nas a hphe ri kha gling mthong thub/ nub rgya mtsho chen po dang sa dbus rgya mtsho'i mtsho thog 'grim 'grul gyi mgrin pa lta bu yin pas 'thab jus kyi gnas bab ha cang gal chen po bzung yod/ 'jar man gyis nges par du gnas 'di thob 'dod pa'i re ba bcangs nas si phan phyogs su the gtogs byas nas dbyin a tha'i stobs shugs kyi khongs su 'dzul/ 'di ltar si phan ni zhe the lis gdon lag bsrings pa'i dmigs yul du gyur/ 'jar man gyis dbyi tha lir mnyam 'brel byas te si phan la the gtogs byas pa ni hpha zhi si stobs ltogs de 'thab 'dzing gi bgrod lam la phyogs pa'i gom stobs gal chen zhig na/ si phan ngo rgol phyogs khag gis zhe the li dang mo su'u li nyi gnyis kyi rgyab skyor 'og srid gzhung gsar bar ngo rgol byed pa'i dmag don gyi 'char gzhi — 238 —

bkod sgrig byas/ thengs 'di'i ngo rgol byed pa'i 'go khrid pa ni si phan gyi mo ro ki mi ser spel yul du sdod pa'i dmag dpon hpho lang ki yin/hpho lang ki yis sngon chad si phan skam dmag gi spyi'i drag jus dmag dpon gyi 'gan 'khur myong / 1936lor a sa nyi ya ci lu'u cwa srid gzhung gis spyi sems med pa'i ngo rgol can gyi dmag dpon rnams rim bzhin rgyal sa las phyogs gzhan du mngags te las 'gan sgrub par btang / (sgo lang ki ni cwa li nā gling tshom ru khag gi si phan gyi 'go 'dzin par mngags/) mi 'di dag gis mu mthud du sa gnas dmag srid kyi dngos yod dbang cha bzung yod pas gnod pa chen po byung ba red/1936lo'i zla 7pa'i tshes 18nyin gyi zhogs par/ hpho lang gis dbyin ji'i mkha' bskyod kung zis mkho 'don byas pa'i gnam grur bsdad de mo ro ko'i (5070000sgo/67)ri hri an la slebs nas/ gnas der srid gzhung la ngo log byed pa'i zing 'khrug la mdzub ston byas/ khos ngo log gi dmigs yul ni si phan 'byor med gral rim gyi gsar brje la bkag rgya bzo ba dang dmar 'gyur 'gog rgyu de yin zhes mngon gsal du khyab bsgrags byas/ ngo log zing 'khrug la snga mo nas jus bkod yod pas myur du rgyal nang sa gnas so sor sdod pa'i dmag gis dang len zhus/ rgyal yongs su dmag grangs 145000yod pa las dmag 100000ngo log zing 'khrug gi phyogs su langs/ngo log zing 'khrug dmag dpung gis ngo log zing 'khrug gi thod brgal rang bzhin dang srid gzhung the tshom du gnas pa'i go skabs bed spyad de nub phyogs kyi mo ro ko dang cwa na li gling tshom pa li a li gling tshom bcas la dbang bsgyur/hpho lang ki yis 'go khrid pa'i mo ro ko dmag tshogs lho nas byang du bskyod pa dang / mo lā yi sa 'go khrid pa'i ngo log dmag byang nas lhor bskyod de rgyal sa ma ti li phyogs su dpung 'jug byas/ sa gnas so so'i log sdod ༵༵ skabs

de dang bstun nas zing cha slong grabs kyi nyen kha sngar las tsha bor gyur/ 'on kyang rgya che ba'i mi dmangs kyis spyi mthun rgyal khab srung skyob byas te/ bzo ba rnams kyis drag chas 'khyer te ngo log dmag la zhum pa med pa'i 'thab rtsod byas nas sa gnas so so'i ngo log zing 'khrug pa rtsa med du btang / ngo log zing 'khrug mkhan gyi gnas gzhi thor la nye ba'i skabs la thug kyang srid gzhung gis go skabs de dam 'dzin byed ma thub pas ngo log dmag rtsa ba nas gtor ma thubaska/ bas 'dir hpha zhi sis mngon gsal dod par g.yul sar zhugs te/1936lo'i zla 8par si phan spyi mthun rgyal khab la drag chas kyi the gtogs byed pa'i 'go btsugs/ kho tshos dngos skyel 'phrul chas mang po nub phyogs kyi mo ro kor bskyal te hpho lang gir rgyal nang la dmag chas 'dren grogs byas pa ma zad/gzhan than khe/ gnam gru/ mtshon cha/ rdzas mdel sogs mang po mkho 'don byas/ dbyin hpha a rgyal khab gsum gyi srid gzhung gis si phan spyi mthun rgyal khab nang khul gyi las don la the gtogs mi byed pa'i khyab bsgrags mdzad/dbyin hpha rgyal khab gnyis kyi skul ba'i 'og nas yo rob rgyal khab 20lhag gis 6 the gtogs mi byed pa'i chod yig la ming tho bkod/ chod yig der mtshon cha dang dmag bkol dngos rdzas si phan la bskyal mi chog pa dang si phan nas nyos pa'i mtshon cha rang nyid kyi rgyal khongs nas 'dren mi chog pa thag gis bcad/ 'di lta bu'i zu the gtogs mi byed ’ pa'i srid jus ni don dngos steng bshad na rgyal khab so so'i mi dmangs kyis si phan mi rigs gsar brje'i 'thab rtsod la rgyab skyor byed pa'i bkag rgya yin pa dang hpha zhi si dang si phan ngo rgol par rogs skyor byas te si phan dmangs gtso ring lugs rtsa med du gtong ba'i thabs bkod kho na'o// si phan spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi dpal 'byor bkag sdog byapa shād pa'i dus 'jar man dang dbyi tha li gnyis kyis si phan spyi mthun

rgyal khab kyi phyi phyogs 'brel ba bcad de hpho lang ki si phan srid gzhung gi 'go gtso yin par khas blangs/ kho tshos thad kur dngos gzhi'i dmag dpung mngags nas si phan spyi mthun rgyal khab la phar rgol byas/ 1936lo nas 1939lo bar gyi lo ngo gsum gyi dmag 'khrug khrod phyi'i rgyal khab kyi the gtogs byed pa'i dmag mi khri 30lhag brgal la/ de'i khrod 'jar dmag 50000yod pa dang / dbyi tha li'i mi 15800yod/ phor ju ghal gyi mi 20000yod/ mo ro ko'i mi 90000yod/ da dung rgyal khab gzhan pa'i dmag mi'ang 'dus yod/ dmag 'khrug 'go brtsams pa'i thog ma'i lo gnyis la 'jar dbyi gnyis kyis hpho lang ki la gnam gru 1650dang / than khe dang khrab ldan 'khor lo 1150 me phyogs 2700 me mda' khri tsho 10 mdel khri 750 mkha' bskyod 'gad mdel 17000rlangs 'khor 7600lhag bcas dang dmag don la mkho ba'i dngos rdzas 'bor chen mkho sprod byas pas dmag don gyi gnas bab bzang po de hpho lang ki'i phyogs su bsgyur/'on kyang si phan mi dmangs kyang khor rkyang min te 'dzam gling yongs kyi sngon thon mi snas hur thag gis si phan mi dmangs la rgyab skyor byas te skad grags can gyi rgyal spyi'i gzhung sgrig ru khag rtsa 'dzugs byas te si phan la bskyod nas hpha zhi sir ngo rgol dmag 'khrug la zhugs/ rlabs che ba'i rgyal spyi'i ring lugs kyi 'thab mo ba pe chi'u en yang rgyal spyi'i gzhung sgrig ru khag tu zhugs myong / 'dzam gling yongs kyis yar thon gleng phyogs tshang mas si phan mi dmangs la rgyab skyor byed pa dang hpha zhi si'i bcan 'dzul la rgol gtam drag po btang / krung hwa su'u we e srid gzhung dang krung go gung khran tang gis thengs mang por glog 'phrin btang ste si phan mi dmangs la rgyab skyor chen po gnang /su'u len dang hpha ran si/ kha na ta/ a ri/ krung go sogs rgyal khab 54dang rgyal spyi'i ring lugs kyi mos 'dun pa 4280se phan du 'byor rdo 4/la lti'i

gzhung sgrig ru khag rtsa 'dzugs byas/ dbyi tha li'i gung khron tang gi 'go khrid pa lung gis rgyal spyi'i gzhung sgrig ru khag gi spyi khyab chab srid u yon gyi 'gan 'khur/ si phan mi dam ngas kyis dpung ba mnyam sashib kyis hpha zhi sir ngo log zing 'khrug mkhan dang rgyal phyi'i drag chas the gtogs pa la rdung rdeg byas/rgyal spyi'i dpung sgrig ru khag khrod phul du byung ba'i krung go'i na gzhon pho mo 100lhag yod/ kho tsho mang che thos si phan nas rang srog shor/ lhag par du spyi tshogs ring lugs su'u len gyis rogs ram rgya chen po mdzad/ 1936lor su'u len mi dmangs kyis zhal 'debs gnang ba'i u sgor khri tsho 6160de si phanasbyi mthun rgyal khab kyi rogs skyor ma dngul byas/ su'u len srid gzhung gis si phan spyi mthun rgyal khab la a sgor khri 8500dngul bun btang ba dang /'bru rigs/ sman rdzas dang sgrig chas kha shas las gzhan gnam gru 64skyidang than khe dang khrab lda na 'khor lo 470 phyogs chen 1186 me mda' 2500dang mdel khri 50nye ba lhag mkho 'don byas pa ma zad dam ga don blo 'dri mi sna dang slob khrid dmag dpon yang mngags so// gung khran tang gi rgyal spyi'i rtsa 'dzugs dang rgyal khab so so'i gung khran tang gi phul byung 'thab mo ba mang po si phan du mngags la/ rgyal spyi'i ring lugs kyi 'thab mo ba khri lhag si phan nas sku gshegs so//'di ltar si phan nang 'khrug rim bzhin rgyal spyi'i don snying gal chen yod pa'i si phan mi dmangs kyi hpha 'i si btsan 'dzul la ngo rgol byed pa'i mi rigs gsar brje'i dmag 'khrug tu gyur ba red/thengs 'di'i mi rigs gsar brje'i dmag 'khrug gi thag gcod rang bzhin gyi g.yul 'gyed ni rgyal sa ma ti li srung skyob kyi dmag 'khrug red/1936lo'i zla 9tshes 27nyin/ hpho lang ki dmag dpung gis 'jar o btsan 'dzul ཿstug tram̐ mkha' dmag dang / stogs dmag than khe ru khag gi

gzhogs 'degs 'og ma ti li lho nub du spyi le 70las med pa'i tha'o le to mnga' khongs su bcug de nas ma ti lir dpung 'jug byed pa'i gra sgrig byas/skabs der hpho lang ki la stobs shugs shin tu che bas su'u u zla ba bcu ba'i gsar brje nas lo ngo 19'khor nyin ma ti li mnga' khongs su bcug pa yin zhes 'chal gtam bsgrags/ ma ti li'i phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad hpha zhi sis bskor yod pa red/ si phan mi dmangs ni gung khran tang gi nus ldan gyi rtsa 'dzugs 'og nas dngos gzhi'i dmag dpung btsugs pa dang ma ti li lho nub mtshams su 'gog srung rags rim pa gsum btsugs so// si phan gung khran tang gi 6 hpha zhi si gom gang mdun du bskyod mi nus 〉pa'i 'bod tshig sgrog nas gung khran tang gis rtsa 'dzugs byas pa'i dmag tshogs ang lnga ba ches mdun gyi g.yul sa srung bar skul slong byas/1936lo 'i zla 11pa'i tshes 6nyin gyi sa srod la/ ngo log dmag ma ti li nye 'gram la slebs/ nyin gnyis par ngo log dmag gis phyogs yongs nas tshur rtsol byas/ spyi mthun rgyal khab phyogs nas ngo log dmag gi mdun phyogs su ru khag bdun bkod sgrig byas yod la/ de'i khrod du rgyal spyi'i gzhung sgrig ru khag gnyis dang than khe 50'dus yod/ dmag 'khrug khrod spyi mthun rgyal khab dmag gis dpa' ngar zhum med kyis mdun phyogs kyi gnas rags srung bzhin yod pa ma zad rang 'gul gyi ngang nas dgra bo'i dpung tshogs kyi rgol thengs re re pham par byas/ nyin zhag 10tsam ring gi shi gson gyi dmag 'khrug khrod dgra phyogs la shi rmas kyi zad gron chen po brgyud man thong li si gtsang bo'i rgyud du slebs kyang man thong li si gtsang po brgal ma thub pas grong khyer du 'dzul ma thub/ 1937lo'i 1tshes 3nyin hpho lang ki yis ma ti lir phar rgol thengs gnyis pa byas kyang tshes 16la slebs dus sngar bzhin 'bras bu byung med/ mdun phyogs nas rgol yang ngo log dmag gi bkod 'arjoma~X 43'u spras

ma ti li'i phyogs thams cad bskor rgyu thag gis bcad de ma ti li dang rgyal yongs sa khul gzhan dang 'brel lam gcod pa'i re ngan bcangs pa dang mnyam du glo bur du 'phral sgrub byed rgyu gtan la phab/ zla 2tshes 6nyin ngo log gi phar rgol thengs gsum pa'i 'go bcoms pa red/ dbyi tha li'i rgyang skyod dmag 40000yis gtso 'gan blangs/ de'i khrod kyi dmag dpung khag cig gis lho phyogs rgyud kyi hwa la ma gtsang bo'i shar phyogs su dpung 'jug byed rgyu dang dpung khag ga'an cig the kun sā nas lam la chas te ma ti li la phar rgol byas/ gza' 'khor gsum ring gi dka' ngal ldan pa'i 'thab 'khrug byas pa rgyud ngo log dmag la chu 'gram gyi sa khul dog mo zhig las ci yang ma thob de bas hpha zhi sis ma ti li'i phyogs yongs bskor te len rgyu'i 'dod pa stong bar gyur/ thengs 'dis dmag 'khrug khrod ngo log dmag gra sgrig ru khag gis dmag mi khri gnyis lhag shi bas/ kho chos byang shar phyogs nas ma ti lir phar rgol byed pa'i dus tshod nar 'gyangs byas/ spyi mthun rgyal khab phyogs kyi dmag mi 10000lhag tsam shi rmas byung / zla 3pa'i tshes 8nyin hpho lang ki dmag dpung gi dmag 50000dang / phyogs chen 220 than khe dang khrab ldan 'khor lo 140 gnam thu60 rlangs 'khor 450 bcas ma ti li byang shar phyogs kyi spyi le 50sar yod pa'i hwa ta la kwa la nas chas te ma ti li la phar rgol thengs bzhi ba byas te ma ti li dang spyi mthun rgyal khab shar phyogs kyi 'grim 'grul lam thig gcod rgyu'i 'dun pa bcangs/ thengs 'di'i phar rgol la ngo log dmag gi than khe dang khyab ldan 'khor lo'i 'go khrid de spyi mthun rgyal khab dmag gi mdun nas bsal bas/ ma ti li byange shar phyogs kyi rnam pa nyen kha tsha bor gyur ba'i dus 'dir spyi mthun rgyal khab bkod 'doms pu'u yis myur du kwa ta la hwa la'i phyogs su dpung chen kha shas kyi dmag shugs btegs la deX khro) shān tram̐ ru khag gcig yod pas dgra bo'i tshul rgol la bkag rgya bzos/

zla 3pa'i tshes 18nyin spyi mthun rgyal khab dmag gis phyir rgol byas/ dus tshod 'gas 'thab rtsod drag po brgyud ngo log dmag la pham nyes chen po byung ste/shi ros sa steng bkang / dgra dmag khri lhag bsad cing stong phrag kha shas bzung 1/936lo'i zla 11pa'i tshes 6nyin nas 1937lo'i zla 3pa'i tshes 18nyin bar gyi nyin 'ag 133ring gi 'thab 'khrug khrod ma ti li ni hpho lang ki hpha 'i sir ngo rtsol byed pa'i 'thab ra gtso bo yin la gtor mi thub pa'i btsan rdzong du gyur ba red/ rgyal spyi'i gzhung sgrig ru khag gi 'thab mo ba dang si phan gung khran tang gis 'gran du med pa'i zhum med kyi dpa' rtags gsal bor bstan pa red/ ma ti li gung khran tang yon 25000yod pa las 21000lhag g.yul sar zhugs yod/ gung khran tang gis mes rgyal gyi sa srung skyob kyi ched du 'phral rgol ru khag bzhi btsugs pa phal cher gyis 'thab 'khrug khrod rang srog shor/ grong mtha' ru mcho dmag gzhon nu kha'o li yis sked la lag 'bom 12bcangs te dpa' ngar zhum med kyis dgra bo'i than khe phyogs su rgyugs te than khe gnyis gtor ba dang rang nyid kyang lnga ba'i lam du gshegs/ gung khran tang gi snyan grags je cher song ba dang rtsa 'dzugs kyang rim ba'in rgya je cher song ste/ 1938lor slebs pa na sngar yod kyi mi grangs khri las med pa'i tang khag chung ngu de 'phel rgyas su song nas mi grangs khri 30yod pa'i tang khag chen por gyur yod/si phan gung khran tang gi stobs shugs chen por gyur ba dang mi dmangs 'thab phyogs la brten nas spyi tshogs kyi gnad don bcos bsgyur byas pas rgyal khab phyi nang gi ngo log pa rnams dngangs skrag chen po skyes/ kho tshos si phan spyi mthun rgyal khab myur du med par bzo ched btsan 'dzul dmag dang mtshon cha mang po hpho lang gir sprad pa red/ der ma zad hphan tis ༵༵ gi spras

kyi rgyal bos kyang nyin rer hpho lang ki la dbyi tha le'i sgor mo khri 200yis rogs skyor byas/ de dang mnyam du spyi mthun rgyal lab nang khul gyi gsar brje ngo log pas las 'gul la gtor brlag byas pa dang dus tshod dam 'dzin byas te drag chas ngo log zing 'khrug bslangs pas spyi mthun rgyal khab srid gzhung gi stobs shugs nyams dmas su phyin pa red/1938lo'i dpyid kur/ ngo log dmag gis cwa the lo nyi ya sa khul ga'an dang 'brel ba bcad pa red/ 1939lo'i zla 1po'i tshes 26nyin cwa the 'o nyi ya'i rgyal sa pa se 'u 'u nā shor/ zla 2pa'i tshes 11nyin cwa the lu'u nyi ya'i mnga' khongs tshang ma bdag gir bzung / 1939lo'i zla 2pa'i tshes 27nyin dbyin hpha gnyis kyi spro lang ki ni si phan srid gzhung gi 'go gtso yin pa khas blangs pa ma zad si phan spyi mthun rgyal khab gyi phyi 'brel bcad/ btsan shed kyis spyi mthun rgyal khab myur du mgo sgur bar bskul/ zla 3pa'i tshes 5nyin dbyin ji'i gsang 'phrin las khungs kyi rgyab skyor 'og si phan krung dbyang g.yul 'byed sa khul gyi dmag dpon cwa the to hrang zho dang ma ti li mkhar srung dmag dpon mes ya hwa/ g.yas phyogs tang mi pe si the lu'u bcas dang hpha 'i si phyi nang mnyam 'brel byas te ma ti li chab srid la 'gyur ldo ga byung ba red/ ma ti li la phar rgol byed pa'i hpho lang ki dmag dpung gi bkod 'doms byed mkhan gyi 'go ba ma'o la yis ra nga tshos gzhung sgrig ru khag bzhis ma ti lir phar rgol byed bzhin yod/ nga tsho'i gzhung sgrig ru khag ang lnga bas rgyal sar nga tshor sgug 'dug mi ces 'ur gtam bshad/ de nas bzung gzhung sgrig ru khag ang lnga ba zhes pa'i tha snyad 'dis gtor brlag gi bya ba bsgrub pa'i nang rul pa dang myul ma sogs mtshon pa red/ zla 3pa'i tshes 28nyin phyi nang zung 'brel gyi gcur rdung 'og ma ti li dngos su dgra lag tu shor ba red/ dpa' ngar ldan pa'i grong khyedī shādi tram̐ gnyis dang zla brgyad ring la dmag 'khrug gi 'khyud brdar

byas kyang hpha 'i si dmag dpung gi skyogs me yis 'dul ma nus/ 'on kyang /skabs der nang log byung ba'i rkyen gyis pham pa'i nyams myong 'di shin tu yid skyo ba zhig red/ si phan spyi mthun rgyal khab gyi pham pa'i phyi rkyen ni 'jar dbyi'i drag pos the gtogs byas pa dang dbyin pho'i 6 the gtogs mi byed mi pa'i srid jus yin/ nang rkyen phyogs mang po na yod de/ gsar brjer ngo sol pa'i ngo log gsang 'tshong gi la sa 'gul las ga'an/ si phan gung khran tang gis mi dmangs kyi g.yul sa dang spyi mthun rgyal khab dmag dpung gi 'go khrid pa'i dbang cha legs por 'dzin ma thub pa dang / grong gseb khul du song nas 'ing ba rnams la skul slong byed ma thub pa ni gsar brje pham pa'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo 'ig yin/ dam ga don gyi steng nas gung khron tang gis snga mo nas dngos gzhi'i dmag dpung rtsa 'dzugs ma byas pa dang / 'gog srung gi 'thab jus mang po bton nas dngos ga'i'i dmag kho nar re ba ni phyi nang gi dgra bo pham pa dang spyi mthun rgyal khab srung skyob byed par dge mtshan chen po med/1936 — 1939lo'i si phan mi rigs gsar brje'i dmag 'khrug ni 'dzam gling 'khrug chen thengs gnyis pa'i sngon la yo rab nas zungs khrag bzhur ba ches mang ba'i 'thab 'khrug cig yin/ dmag 'khrug hril bor khyon bsdoms pas mi grangs khri 100lhag gi srog shor/ thengs 'di'i dmag 'khrug gi bden dpang byas yod pa ni dmag rigs dang dpung rigs sna tshogs dbar phan tshun 'brel 'dris byed pas g.yul 'gyed la rgyal kha thob par don snying gal chen yod pa de red/ gzhan yang / mkha' dmag la 'thab 'khrug gi nus shugs ha cang chen po yo da pa gsal bor mtshon pa ma zad de la cha rkyen 'dzoms tshe grub 'bras g.yur du za ba thob thub pa mtshon/spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi srid gzhung gtor rjes si phan la hpho lang ki'i hpha 'i si'i sger gcod dbang bsgyur gyi 'go brtsams pa red/ yo rodī 4shāngadzi la

dmag 'khrug gsar ba zhig gi 'jigs skul bzhin yod de/ 'dzam gling 'khrug chen thengs gnyis pa 'byung la nye/ rgyal spyi'i gzhung sgrig ru khag gi 'thab mo ba rnams si phan dmag 'khrug gi 'khyud brdar brgyud rjes phyogs nas rgyal khab so so'i hpha zhi si la ngo rgol byed pa'i rkang 'dzin stobs shugs su gyur pa red/

mo si kho srung skyob dmag 'khrugaspyi lo1939lor/ mi'i rigs kyi lo rgyus de nyen kha che ba'i dus rim zhig la slebs/ 'jar man dang dbyi tha li/ lngar pan bcas hpha zhi si'i rgyal khab gsum gyis 'dzam gling bdag 'dzin byed ched lo rgyus steng gzhi khyon ches che ba'i dmag 'khrug ste 'dzam gling 'khrug chen thengs gnyis pa bslangs/ spyi lo 1939lo'i zla 9pa'i tshes /nyin/ zhe the les pho lan du dpung mjug byas shing /nyin nyer bdun nang bdag 'dzin byas/ de nas mu mthud du tan mag dang nor we/ ho lan/ stel kram/ hpha ran si/ yu sgo si la wi ya/ ke ri si/ khu le the gling bcas dbang du bsdus pa ma zad/ btsan shed kyis dbyin ji yo rab skam sa chen mo nas phyir 'bud byas/ de ltar zla dgu tsam gyi dus chod nang yo rob nub ma'i mnga' khongs chen po 'jar man hpha zhi si'i lcags sder 'og tu tshud pa red/ zhe the le nga rgyal khengs dregs skyes nas su la'ang kha ya byed mi srid/ khos mtha' mar yo rob dang 'jom gling dbang du bsdu ched/sdig nyes kyi mche sder shar phyogs spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi su'u len gyi phyogs su brkyangs/ glog 'khyug pa lta bu'i dmag 'khrug ni kho'i rgyun bkol gyi byed thabs shig ste/ khos 66smag nag pa'i mtshan mor glo bur glog 'khyug pa bzhin du dgra bor rgol ba'i mi thabs jus bton pa ma zad/ thabs jus de thengs dang por pho lan la bkol nas rgyal kha blangs pa dang / spyi lo 1941lor/khos 'thab jus de bkol nas su'u len la phar rgol byas mod/ mjug mthar pham nas mtshams 'jog dgos byung /spyi lo 1941lo'i zla 6pa'i tshes 22nyin gyi zhogs pa'i dus tshod gsum dang phyed ba'i steng / zhe the lis su'u 'jar phan tshun mi rgol ༵༵ mthun

chings gtor nas ru khag brgya dang dgu bcu'i steng me skyogs dang gnam gru'i dmag mang po bsnan nas pa lung kri mtsho nas mtsho nag bar gyi spyi le 3000lo na pa'i su'u len mtha' mtshams nas glo bur ba'i 'jab rtsol byas te 6 pā pā li 'char gzhi ’ yis dmag 'khrug gi 'go bslangs/ dmag 'khrug gi nyin dang po ni tag tag gza' nyi mar khel bas/ su'u len la gra sgrig byed long ma byin pas pham nyes tshabs chen phog nyin der gnam gru thang 66dang gnam gru 1200lhag 'jar dmag gi gnam grus 'gad gtor byas shing / su'u len gyi brda 'phrin ma lag la gtor brlag byas pas/ dmag dpung khag dbar la 'brel ba chad de rgyun ldan gyi bkod 'doms byed thabs bral te zang zing gi rnam par gyur/ 'jar dmag gi nyin 'di kho nar su'u len rgyal khongs kyi spyi le 25 — 20lhag gi sa cha btsan bzung byas/ 'jar man hpha zhi si'i dmag dpung gis skabs thog gi dmag don gnas bab bzang por brten nas/6 pā pā li 'char ga'i ltar dmag khag gsum du bgos nas su'u len gyi dkyil dbus su dpung 'jug byas/ byang lam du 'jar man gyi dmag spyi hphan li pa'o yis byang phyogs dmag dpung mthun tshogs kyi sne drangs nas le nyin ku lir phar rgol byed rgyu dang / lho lam du dmag spyi lung ti tho the the yis sne drangs pa'i lho phyogs dmag dpung ma thun tshogs kyis wa'u kho lan du 'dzul nas ci spro dang o ti sā/ tun pa si sogs sa khul la dpung 'jug byed rgyu/dbus lam du dmag spyi phen pa'o khes sne drangs pa'i krung dbyang dmag dpung mthun tshogs kyis pe u ru su brgyud nas/ su'u len gyi rgyal sa mo si kho len rgyu'i 'char ga'i bzos pa red/'byor med gral rim gyis dbang bsgyur byas pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi rgyal khab dang po der srung skyob byed ched/ su'u len mi dmangs kyis si ta li'i ga/ shān pa'i tang gi 'go khrid 'og rlabs che ba'i rgyal srung dmag 'khrug

gi 'go bcoms pa red/ dmag 'khrug gi thog ma'i dus rim nang / 'gog srung cha rkyen 'an pa'i dbang gis su'u len gyi gnas bab shin tu mi bzang /'jar dmag gis gza' 'khor gsum tsam du byang lam nas spyi le 500lhag la bskyod pa dang / lho lam nas spyi le 350lhag la bskyod/ dbus lam nas spyi le 600lhag gi sar bskyod thub pa byung / su'u dmag gis 'thab zhir dang phyir 'then byed zhor du/ dgra bo'i stobs shugs rim gyis nyams dmas su btang /mo si kho ni su'u we ed srid dbang gi rgyal sa dang lte ba yin cing / chab srid dang 'thab jus gang thad nas gal che ba'i don snying ldan/ der brten/mo si kho len thub min de thad kur dmag 'khrug gi rgyal pham dang 'brel ba dam po yod pas/ zhe thi les mo si kho bdag tu 'dzin rgyu ni dmag 'khrug gi ches mjug mtha'i rgyal kha ru rtsis pa dang / tshab ming la zu drag rlung mi zhes btags nas/ ru dpung don lnga'i (de'i khrod me phyogs ru dpung bcu ba'i dang sbag sbag ru dpung brgyad 'dus yod)dmag shugs phyogs gcig tu bsdus te/ mi sa ya gcig dang 'bum brgyad/ than khe chig stong bdun brgya/me phyogs dang drag skyogs chig khri ba'i stong / gnam gru chig stong sum brgya dgu bcu bcas kyis mo si kho la btsan 'dzul byas pa red/skabs der su'u len gyi gnas tshul ha cang mi legs ste/ khe las mang po zhig shar phyogs sa khul la gnas spor mi byed thabs med byung bas/ dmag don dpal 'byor gyis dmag dpung gi drag chas dang dmag chas lag rtsal thad kyi dgos mkho yongs su skong thub kyi med/ de bas dmag dpung gi stobs shugs la nyams zhan tshabs chen shor/ zla 9pa'i zla mjug la slebs dus/men si khe dang si mo lun si khe/ ci hphu sogs grong khyer 'ga' dgra lag tu shor ba dang / le nyin ku li yang nyen kha'i gnas su tshud/ zla 10pa'i zla stod du/'jar dmag gis khā lu'u cwa dang cwa li nyi/ khe lin sogs grong ba/rdo bdag

tu bzung pa ma zad mgyogs myur ngang rngo si kho yi phyogs su bcar/mo si kho yi srung skyob dmag 'khrug la su'u len gyi ches mtho'i bkod 'doms khang gis gzhi rgya che ba'i gra sgrig gi bya ba bsgrubs te nub khul dmag dpung dang / gra sgrig dmag dpung / pu'u lang si khe'i phyogs kyi dmag dpung bcas rtsa 'dzugs byas/ der bsdoms pa'i ru dpung go lnga dang mi sa ya gcig dang 'bum gnyis khri lnga lhag yod pa dang / than khe 990 me skyogs dang drag sgrogs 7600 gnam gru 677bcas yod/ de dang bsdur na/ ljar dmag gi stobs shugs shin tu che ste/ mi grangs su'u len las 40lkomang ba dang /mesnyogs dang drag stogs 80slo ban khe 70cha gnam gru ldab gcig bcas kyis mang / da dung drag chas spus ga'i thad nas kyang bzang shos yin/ su'u dmag gi than khe dang gnam gru mang che ba rnying ba yin/ de ltar mo si kho srung skyob dmag 'khrug ni su'u dmag 'jar dmag las 'an pa'i gnas tshul 'og 'go bcoms pa red/ gnad 'gag gi dus skabs der/ si ta lin gyis nub khul dmag dpung gi 'go 'dzin pa kru'u kho hphu la kha par btang ste/ gzab nan gyi sgo nas ra khyed la nga tsho'i mo si kho 'gan srung byed thub pa'i gdeng tshod 'dug gam/ ngas drang ngos nas khyed la dris pa yin/ khyed rang gung khran tang mi zhig yin pa'i cha nas nga la drang mor shod 〉ces dris/ kru'u kho sprus 6 mo si kho srung skyob byed thub nges yin mi zhes lan btab/ rgyal sa'i mi dmangs kyis kyang 'jar dmag pham par byed rgyu'i 'bod skul btang ba red/zla 9pa'i tshes 30nyin/ zhe thi les 'jar dmag la thengs dang por mo si kho la phar rgol byed dgos pa'i bka' phab/ nyin der/ 'jar dmag gis pu'u lang si khe'i phyogs su phar rtsol byas shing / zla 10tshes 2nyin/ we ya ci'i phyogs su phar rgol byas/ su'u dmag gis kyang 'gog rgol drag po byas na yang / ༵༵da khamag 'gog srung sa tshigs las brgal ba byung / der brten

su'u dmag gis mo si kho dang spyi le 80yod pa'i nub phyogs sa khul du 'gog srung sa tshigs gsar ba rtsa 'dzugs byas/ skabs der/ zhe thi le rgyal khas myos drag te 'jar dmag la nges par du zla 10pa'i tshes 12nyin mo si kho len dgos pa'i bka' phab/ 'jar man gyi dril bsgrags pu'u krang ka pher gyis 'jar man tshags par las rigs khag la zla 10pa'i tshes 12nyin gyi par gzhi dang po ru 66khyad par can gyi gal che'i gsar 'gyur 'god dgos mipa'i mdzub ston byas/ zla 10pa'i tshes 10nyin/ 'jar dmag gis tha na mo si kho la btsan 'dzul byas rjes kyi dmag dpung gi gnas gzhi khag kyang bkod 'doms byas tshar ba red/ 'on kyang / zla 10pa'i tshes 12nyin la slebs dus/mo si kho da dung su'u len mi dmangs kyis bdag tu bzung yod pa red/ zhe thi le'i kha bshad don du ma gnas kyang / mo si kho yi gnas bab je legs gtong ma thub/ 'jar dmag gis nub dang byang / lho bcas phyogs gsum nas mo si kho bskor yod pa dang / su'u len srid gzhung gi las khungs khag cig dang phyi 'brel gzhung tshab khag cig mo si kho dang bar thag spyi le 800ring pa'i gu pe zhe rmu la phyir 'then byas/ yin na yang / krung dbyang gi gtso 'dzin dag phyir 'then byas med pa dang / si ta lin mo si kho dang kha ma bral bar sku dngos kyis mo si kho srung skyob dmag 'khrug la bkod 'doms mdzad bzhin yod/ zla 10pa'i tshes 19nyin/ rgyal srung u yon lhan khang gis mo si kho ru nyen brda bsgrags te/ rgyal sa'i mi dmangs kyis dmar dmag dang mnyam 'brel byas nas mo si kho srung skyob byed par lus sems 'bul dgos pa'i 'bod skul btang / mo si kho yi mi dmangs hur thag gis dmag la zhugs pa'am dmag 'khrug la zhugs shing / 'gog srung 'dzing rags rtsig mkhan gcig pur sdod dmangs 'bum bzhi dang khri lnga lhag yod la/ de'i khrod bud med kyis 374zin/rgyal yongs mi dmangs kyis kyang mo si kho srung skyob dmag 'khrug la ༵༵sa tshom

byas te/ drag chas mdel rdzas dang dmag gi mkho chas sa gnas so so nas rgyun chad med par mo si kho la skyel 'dren byas pa red/ mo si kho dmag dam ngas kyis srog bsdos kyis phyogs yongs nas 'jar dmag la ngo rgol byas pas dgra bkag dgod bro ba 'ig la/ zhe thi les yang bskyar kha pho chen pos zla 11pa'i tshes 7nyin mo si kho thang chen dmar po nas dmag dpung la gzigs 'ib gnang rgyu yin zhes bshad/spyi lo 1941lo'i zla 11pa'i tshes 6nyin/ mo si kho'i mtha' khul na dza drag che ba'i dmag 'khrug rgyag bzhin yod/ nyin der/ ma'o si kho'i mi dmangs kyis sngar rgyun ltar zla 10pa'i gsar brje byas nas lo 'khor nyer ba'i lon pa'i rten 'brel tshogs chen bsdus te mā we kha'o hphu si ci'i sa 'og lcags lam 'bab tshigs su mo si kho grong khyer ngal rtsol mi dmangs 'thus mi'i su'u we yed tshogs chen 'tshogs pa red/ tshogs chen stong si ta lin nas snyan zhu phul te su'u len mi dam/ngas kyis hpha zhi ser ngo rgol byas pa'i rlabs che ba'i dmag 'khrug gi grub 'bras phyogs sdom byas shing / deng phyin dgra bo pham par rgyag dgos pa'i 'os 'gan gsal bor bstan/khong gis yid ches kyi ngang nas bstan don/ sna nga tsho'i las don ni bden don yin pas/ rgyal kha nges par du nga tshor dbang ba yin ’ zhes gsungs/ nyin gnyis pa sto zla 11pa'i tshes gnyin/ spyi le bcu phrag gi phyi rol du su'u 'jar phyogs gnyis kyis shi gson dbye ba 'byed bzhin yod/ 'jar dmag gi shugs che ba'i phyogs chen gyi dmar 'od 'og si ta lin gyis thang chen dmar por rgya che ba'i dmag dpung gzigs zhib mdzad sgo spel/ dmar dmag dang dmangs dmag khri tsho bcu phrag kha shas gral bsgrigs nas thang chen dmar por si ta lin gyis gzigs zhib gnang ba brgyud/ thad kur g.yul sang ba/)4 de spra si kho srung ba'i dmag 'khrug la zhugs/ si ta lin gyis

dmag gzigs mdzad sgo'i steng 'jar man hpha zhi si'i dmag dpung nges par pham nges yin zhes gsal bor bsgrags shing / su'u len dmag dmangs la dpa' ngar che ba'i sgo nas dgra bo dang dmag 'khrug rgyag dgos pa'i 'bod skul bton/ thengs 'di'i mdzad sgo la don snying ches cher ldan pa ste/ 'dis sbyi'u shāsbyi mi dmangs kyis hpha zhi ser ngo rgol byed pa'i chod sems la skul ma na suzlo sdom/ ga gi 'thab mo bas zhum med kyi brtul shugs bskyed de mo si kho ru bgrod pa'i 'gag sgo ru dmar 'dzing drag po byas/ pa'o hphe lu'u hphu dmag dpon gyi sku srung 'thab mo ba nyer brgyad chab srid u yon khe chan kha'o spru'i 'gokhrid 'og gal che ba'i 'dzing rags srung nas chu chod ba'i lhag la 'thab 'khrug brgyab ste/ bstud mar dgra bo'i than khe 50lhag gis tshur rgol phyir bzlog pa red/ mthar 'thab mo ba 'di dag gis stobs shugs la bar khyad che ba'i dmag 'khrug nang rang nyid kyi tshe srog btang / lus por rmas skyon tshabs chen phog pa'i khe char kha'o hphus lag 'bom phon po zhig bzung nas 'jar dmag gi than khe'i phyogs su mchongs nas rang srog blos btang / mo si kho yi 'bring rim slob ma kra'o yā srung skyob dmag 'khrug tu zhugs yod pa dang / kho mosasnag nag la grang ngar che ba'i mtshan mor las 'gan sgrub dus stabs ma legs par dgra bos 'dzin bzung byas/ dgra bos 'jigs snang ji ltar skul yang kho mo'i mgo gtan nas ma sgur zhing / lcebs thag ske la bskyon dus kyang kho mos da dung 'jigs dngangs med pa'i gsar brje'i snying stobs kyis dgra bos khrims rar khrid 'ongs pa'i zhing ba mang tshogs la hpha zhi si rtsa med gtong dgos pa'i 'bod skul btang / kho mos ra si ta lin nga tsho dang lhan du gnas/si ta lin nges par phebs nges yin mi zhes skad gsang mthon pos bsgrags te lo na chung ba'i tshe srog mi rigs dang mes rgyal kyi ched du phul/ de ltar su'u — 255 —

len gyi dmag mi mang po zhig gis 'jigs pa med pa'i snying stobs bskyed nas 'jar dmag gi thengs dang po'i tshur rgol rtsa ba nas pham par byas/'jar dmag gi ham sems gzhom ma thub par/ zla 11pa'i tshes 15—18nyin/ mo si kho ru thengs gnyis par gzhi khyon che ba'i 'jug rgol byas/dmag mi bsdoms pa'i ru dpung 80nye ba yod la/ su'u len nub khul dmag dpung gi gdong len la ru dpung 51tsam ma gtogs med pas gnas bab legs shos de da dung 'jar dmag gis bzung yod/ su'u dmag gis dgra bo'i 'jigs snang la mgo ma sgur bar rgyal sa skyob pa'i 'bod skul sgrog pa 'di ltar/ 6 u ru su'i sa rgya che na yang / nga tsho gom gang yang phyi sdur byed don med la byed sa'ang med/ nga tsho'i rgyab phyogs ni mo si kho yin zhes zer/ 'jar dmag gis gom gang mdun spos sgos lho byang gi sa cha brtson len byas nas mo si kho bdag tu 'dzin pa'i ham sems bcangs/ zla 11pa'i tshes 27nyin/'jar dmag ru dpung ang 258pa'i ru khag chung shas shig mo si kho dang spyi le 24yod pa'i sar slebs/ zla 12pa'i tshes 2nyin/ 'jar dmag gi myul zhib ru chung zhig mo si kho grong khyer gyi 'gram du slebs nas khu len mu len pho brang gi rtse mo mthong thub par gyur/ mo si kho ni me skyogs kyi 'ben du gyur 'dugader mthud 'jar dmag gis mjug mtha'i stobs shugs kyang baspyad tshar nas gra sgrig dmag kyang 'thab 'khrug tu zhugs/ krung dbyang dmag tshogs kyi dmag dpon pa'o khes 'jar dmag gi spyi khyab tshan mu'u krang hwar ti la kha par btang nas/ smyo 'jar dmag nyen kha che ba'i gnas su thug yod ces snyan zhu phul/ su'u dmag gis phyogs gcig nas dgra bor 'gog rgol byas pa dang phyogs gcig nas 'jab rgol byas nas dgra dmag mang po tshar bcad/ lhag par bzo ba rnams bzo grwa nas thon te thon skyed lag cha bzung nas 'jar dmag kā16 'arjib/ pa'o khe'i hur brtson byas na'ang / thengs re re bzhin

su'u dmag gis pham par byas/mo si kho la grang ngar che ba'i dgun kha slebs pa dang / kha char 'dres ma babs shing rgya lam 'khyags pas bsdams pa sogs gnam gshis kyis 'jar dmag dka' ngal che ba'i gnas su bskyal/ de ltar kho tsho'i mdun bskyod kyi myur tshad kyang je dal du song / glog 'gyu ba lta bu'i 'thab rtsal la re ba bcol ba'i zhe thi les zla phyed nang mo si kho len rgyu'i 'char gzhi bzos yod pa las dgun dus kyi bya bar gra sgrig ci yang byas med/ grang ngar shin tu che ba'i dgun kha'i dus su/ 'jar dmag gi 'grul lam 'khyags pas sbubs su zhugs pas/ rlangs 'khor dang me 'khor la kha lo bsgyur ma thub/ der brten dmag gi rgyags bro chad pa dang / drag chas sogs kyi snam yang 'khyags rom du gyur/ da dung gnam gru'ang bkol spyod byed ma thub par lus/ 'jar dmag dka' ngal 'di 'dra'i khag po zhig la 'phrad pas/ rim gyis 'thab rshakhrug shā nus shugs phyogs yongs su zhum zhing grang ngar gyis mi phal mo che'i tshe ga 'azla 11pa'i zla mjug nas zla 12pa'i zla 'go'i bar gyi 'gog srung dang phar rgol brgyud 'jar dmag gis mo si kho la thengs gnyis par phar rgol byas pa pham par byas/ zla 11pa'i tshes 6nyin nas zla 12pa'i tshes 5nyin bar/'jar dmag 155000tsam shi ba dang / me phyogs 800tsam/ than khe 300gnam gru 1500bcas la gyong gud thebs/ de ltar 'jar dmag gi stobs shugs nyams nas ci byed 'di byed med pa'i gnas su thug pas/ su'u dmag gis rgol lan sprod pa'i dus skabs la slebs yod/1941lo'i zla 12pa'i tshes 5 — 6nyin/ gnam gshes shin tu grang ba dang kha ba ji 'dra'i mthug kyang / su'u dmag gis snying stobs bskyed nas rgol lan sprod pa'i 'go bcoms/ 'jar dmag thang chad ngal du pa2 spyang /geg

sgrig dmag dpung med pa'i khar dgun khar g.yul 'gyed kyi dmag sbyong yang byas med pas nyin 'ga' 'gor rjes su'u dmag gis gnas bab legs shos bzung / zla 12pa'i tshes 8nyin/ zhe thi les dmag dpung phyir 'then byed pa'i bka' mi gnang thabs med byung / su'u dmag gis 'jar dmag gi rjes bsnyegs/ 'jar dmag khyi spyang gi rnga ma bcad pa ltar gros/ lo rjes ma'i zla 4pa'i tshes 20nyin/ yang bskyar su'u 'jar dmag gis g.yul bshams pa red/ sa thog nas dmar 'dzing drag po byas pa dang mkha' thog nas kyang 'gad rdzas kyis 'jigs snang skul/ bsdud mar nyin mang po'i ring gnam sa cha lang deb pa lta bu'i dmag 'khrug byas pa dang / mtha' mar 'jar dmag mkha' dmag gis pham kha chen po nyos/1941lo'i zla 10pawa 1942lo'i zla 4pa'i mo si kho srung skyob dmag 'khrug ni gzhi rgya che ba'i g.yul 'gyed cig yin/ 'jar man hpha zhi si'i dmag dpung la thengs 'dir pham nyes chen po byung ba red/ mi khri 50lhag gron pa dang / skyogs chen 2500tsam/ than khe 1300tsam/ rlangs 'khor 15000lhag gnam gru 1392lhag gi gyong gud thebs pa ma zad/ lag rtsal sgrig chas shin tu mod po rtsa med du btang / de ltar su'u len mi dmangs kyis rgyal sa skyob pa'i las 'gan rgyal kha'i ngang legs grub byung /mo si kho g.yul 'khrug la rgyal kha thob pa 'dis zhe thi le'i 6 glog 'khyug pa lta bu'i 'thab rtsal mi rtsa ba nas pham par byas pa yin/ thengs 'di'i rgyal kha ni su'u len spyi tshogs ring lugs lam lugs kyi rgyal kha yin la/ mi dmangs stobs shugs kyi rgyal kha'ang yin/ 1965lo'i zla 5pa'i nang / su'u len gyi rgyalasang dmag 'khrug la rgyal kha thob nas lo nyer drug 'gor ba'i rgyal ston mdzad sgo'i steng / mo si kho grong khyer la ra dpa' bo'i grong khyer zhes pa'i mtshan snyan btags/— 258 —

zhi bde min pa'i gi bde rgya mtsho/wa wazhi bde rgya mtsho'i dmag 'khrugatshang mas shes gsal ltar/ 'dzam gling steng ches che ba'i rgya mtsho ni zhi bde rgya mtsho red/ de ni a she ya dang a mi ri ka gling / lho sne gling bcas kyi bar na gnas yod la/ rgya khyon la spyi le gru ba'i ma khri 17968yod/ rgya mtsho chen mo 'dis 'dzam gling gi rgya mtsho'i phyed ka zin yod la/ 'dzam gling skam sa dang bsdur na 175che/ de ni rang byung gi thon khungs phun sum tshogs shing 'grim 'grul gyi lte ba ru grub yod/ de'i nang gi ha we ye gling tshom ni 6 zhi bde rgya mtsho'i steng gi bzhi mdo miru 'bod cing / ming du grags pa'i ljongs rgyu'i gnas mchog cig yin/ yin na yang / dus rabs nyi shu ba nas bzung zhi bde rgya mcho ni zhi bde zhig min te/ btsan rgyal ring lugs rgyal khab khag gis ham sems kyi lag zung bar med du rkyong bzhin yod/ 'dzam gling 'khrug chen thengs gnyis pa'i skabs/ 'jar pan btsan rgyal ring lugs pas lho phyogs su mnga' khongs rgya bskyed/ 1941lo'i zla 12pa'i tshes 7nyin/ 'jar pan dmag gis glo bur du a ri'i 'i bde rgya mtsho'i gru kha ste/ ha we ye gling tshom gyi mu tug gru kha gtor ba yis/ zhi bde rgya mtsho'i dmag 'khrug gi yol ba thog mar phye/dza/ma gling 'khrug chen thengs dang po'i rjes nas ma rtsa ring lugs kyi dpal 'byor ma lag nyen kha chen po zhig la slebs/ 'jar pan hpha zhi si dbang sgyur tshogs pas gdug rtsub kyi sgo nas krung go khyur mid byed rgyu dang lho rgya mtsho'i gling tshom dang byang zhi pa'o li ya 'dzin rgyu ma zad/ a ri dang dbyin ji'i stobs shugs shar phyogs nas bskrad de kho tsho'i mi ser spepa yu15 pas/ ba

btsugs nas a she ya dang 'i bde brgya mtsho'i bdag po ngo ma byed 'dod kyi ham sems bcangs/ de'i stabs kyis 'jar pan gyis dmag gi mkho chas dang drag chas kyi phyogs su shugs bsnan pa ma zad/ 'jar pan dang thag ring ba'i gling phran dag tu dmag don lte ba btsugs/ 1941lo'i zla 11pa'i nang /gong mas 66lho bskyod mi 'thab jus byed dgos pa'i gros tshogs bsdus nas gtan la phab ste/ thog mar a ri'i mu tig gru kha gtor rgyu byas/ de ni 'jar pan lho bskyod kyi 'gag sgo yin pas so//'jar pan gyis btsan 'dzul byed pa'i rtsa ba'i thabs phyogs ni glo bur ba'i phar rgol yin/ byed thabs 'di lag bstar byas pa'i yar sngon du/ kho tshos dus rgyun 6 zhi bde'i byed thabs spyad nas chab srid la bslu brid byas pa dang 'thab phyogs zol ma bzos pa red/ 'jar pan gyis mu tig gru khar phar rgol byas pa'i sngar nyin yang / a ri dang zhi bde gros mol mdzad/ don dngos su a ri'i zhi bde rgya mtsho'i gru kha gtor rgyu'i 'char gzhi ni 1941lo'i 'gor 'jar pan mnyam 'brel gru khag gi dmag dpon hran pan wu hri li'u yis gtan la phab tshar yod/ phar rgol byed pa'i dmag gru dag kyang zla 11pa'i tshes 10nyin chan to gling tshom du lkog tu mnyam 'dzoms byas nas gra sgrig byas yod/ de yang a ri'i myul zhib gru la g.yol ched yin/ 'jar pan gyis da dung a ri'i gru'i 'gul skyod kyi gnas tshul tshang ma gsang myul byas yod/1941lo'i zla 12pa'i tshes 7nyin ni tag tag gza' nyi ma'i nyin yin pas/ a ri'i mtsho dmag mang po skam sar phyin nas ngal gso byed bzhin pa las dmag 'khrug byed rgyu'i sta gon ci yang med/ a ri'i tsung thung la 'jar pan gyis 'jab rgol byed pa'i gra sgrig gi gnas tshul 'byor na yang / khos kyang bden kha ma byin par snang med du bskyur/ 'jar pan gyi gnam gru mu tig gru ༵༵ brda snang du 'phur bskyod byed dus kyang / kho tshos rang nyid kyi

gnam gru'i sbyong brdar byed pa red snyam/ dngos gnas a ri'i dmag mgo 'thom po red/ nyin de'i zhogs pa'i chu tshod 6dang skar ma 30stong / 'jar dmag gi mtsho dmag dmag dpon yon he yis gnam gru 183tsam gyis glo bur du phar rgol byed rgyu'i bka' phab/ chu tshod 7dang skar ma 55stong / 'jar pan gnam gru mu tig gru kha'i bar snang du slebs nas 'gad rdzas khag dang po 'phangs/ a ri'i gnam gru 'phur long ma byung bar gas gtor btang / de'i nang skam dmag gnam gru 152yod la/ mtsho dmag gnam gru 86tsam yod/mtsho khar sdod pa'i a ri'i 'thab 'dzing gru 5lhag kyang bkad nas chur byings/glo bur gyi 'jab rgol des a ri'i dmag ci bya gtol med du gyur/ skabs der 'jar pan dmag skam sar 'gos pa'i gnas tshul go rjes/(don dngos su skam sar ma yong /) a ri'i dmag gis 'jar dmag gi gyon pa dang dbye ba 'byed ched myur du rang gi gyon par kha hphe bskus/ chu tshod 8dang skar ma 54steng / thengs gnyis par 'jar pan gnam gru 171lhag gis bkad gtor byas shing / chu tshod 9dang skar cha 45steng 'jar pan gyi gnam gru tshang ma phyir log pa red/ thengs 'di'i 'jar pan gyi glo bur ba'i 'jab rgol des a ri la pham nyes chen po bzos/ gnam gru 300lhag 'bar gas byung ba dang /gnam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings chen po gsum gtor/ skam dmag dang mtsho dmag 3615tsam gron/ gzhan mi 916lhag gar song cha med du gyur/ 'jar pan phyogs su gnam gru 28dang dmag 100tsam las ma gron/'jar pan gyis mu tig gru khar 'jab rgol byas nas dus tshod gnyis 'gor rjes a ri la 'thab gtam bsgrags/ de'i phyi nyin/ a ris kyang 'jar pan sogs hpha zhi sir 'thab gtam bsgrags/ zhi bde rgya mtsho'i dmag 'khrug dngos su bslangs/ 'di ltar/ 'dzam gling 'khrug chen thengs gnyis pa'i khyab khongs kyang sngar las je cher gyur/ — 261 —

mu tig gru khar 'jab rgol byed pa dang chabs cig 'jar pan gyis skam dmag ru dpung 21lhag lam gsum du bgos nas lho bskyod byed du bcugadakyil lam gyi dmigs 'ben ni hphi li phen dang hin rdu shar ma'i gling tshom blangs nas dpal 'byor thon khungs je legs su gtong ched yin/ 'jar dmag snga gzhug tu li zon gling phran dang ma'o lan lo gling phran nas skam sar 'dzegs/ 1942lo'i zla 1po'i tshes 2nyin/ mā nyi lā blangs pa dang hphi li pin blangs pa brgyud de hin rdu gling tshom du bskyod/ 1942lo'i zla 2pa'i zla dkyil nas zla 5pa'i tshes 1bar/ pa'o lu'u krig dang su'u men ta la/ kra bā/ zhe thā sogs gling phran 'ga' blangs/ zla 5pa'i tshes 8nyin/ hin nyi'i ho lan dmag dpung gis 'jar dmag la mgo sgur/ 1941lo'i zla 12'i tshes 25nyin/ 'jar pan gyis shang kung bzung / phyi lo'i lo mgor sing ga phor la btsan 'dzul byas pa dang / 'bar ma'ang bdag 'dzin byas nas krung go'i lam bcad pa dang thad kur rgya gar la 'jigs snang skul ba red/ 1941lo'i zla 12pa'i tshes 10—20bar/ lja pan gyis snga gzhug tu kon to gling phran dang bī khi gling phran bcas bzung / phyi lo'i zla 1 —5bar/ nub bskyon byas te zhi ci nyi ya dang sa'o lu'u men gling tshom la gtugs/ zhi bde rgya mtsho'i byang khul du/ 'jar pan gyis 1942lo'i zla 1por a li hrir gling tshom ham 'dzin byas/'jar pan gyi dus yun ring bo'i gra sgrig 'thus tshang shing / glo bur ba'i 'jab rgol la mkhas pa/ de'i steng mkha' mtsho skam gsum gyi dmag dpung gi ram 'degs byas pa bzang rkyen gyis lo phyed ring btsan 'dzul gyi mnga' khongs shar du kron thu'u gling bar dang nub du hin rdu'i shar rgyud/ byang nas zhi pa'o li ya'i bar/ lho nas o si khru'e li ya'i bar la rgya bskyed/ a ri dang dbyin ji/ ho lan/ hpha ran si sogs rgyal khab bzhi'i gling phran dang mi ser spel yukta sdul rder 'jar pan gyi lag tu shor/ skabs 'dir 'jar pan gyis
