mi grangs khri tsho 45000tsam sdod sa'i mnga' khongs dang thon khungs mod po bdag 'dzin byas yod/ 'gyig gi thon tshad kyis 'dzam gling spyi'i 956zin pa dang / sman rdzas rin po che khu'i nying gi thon tshad kyis 'dzam gling gi 90lkozin/ 'bras sogs kyis 'dzam gling gi 704zin pa ma zad/ rdo snum thon khungs phun sum tshogs po yod/yin na yang / 'jar pan gyi bde skyid de la phugs ring po zhig gtan nas med de/ rgyang 'dul gyi khe phan ni ches tha ma'i bya ba 'ig yin la/ kho tsho'i 'thab gral bsgrigs yun shin tu ring ba ma zad/ phyogs so sor phog thug btang bas dmag gi stobs shugs kyang kha 'thor gyi tshul du yod/ krung go dang a she ya rgyal khab so so'i mi dmangs kyis ljar 'gog mi rigs bcings 'grol dmag 'khrug bshams nas 'jar pan gyi stobs shugs nyams dmas su btang / a ris kyang rim gyis ngo rgol drag po byas/ 1942lo'i zla 5pa'i tshes 7nas 8bar/ a ri dang 'jar pan gnyis kyis byu ru'i mtsho nas dmag 'khrug byas par/ 'jar pan mcho dmag la a mi ri ga'i mkha' dmag gis rdung rdeg drag po thebs/ 'dis 'jar pan mtsho dmag la 'i bde rgya mtsho'i steng du pham kha chen po thengs dang por bzos/ de bas 'jar dmag lho bzhud kyis o si khru'e li yar btsan 'dzul byed pa'i ham sems mi bskyur ka med byung / 'jar dmag la pham kha byung rjes/ 1942lo'i zla 6pa'i 'gor 'jar dmag gis dkyil lam gling phran la dmag 'khrug byed pa'i gra sgrig byas/thengs 'di'i dmag 'khrug gi sngon du/ 'jar dmag la gsang ba shor ba'i don rkyen chen po gnyis byung / gcig ni mtsho dmag tshogs pa gnyis pa'i ru chung dpon po gzhon pa zhig gis dma' rim gsang grangs yi ge'i glog 'phrin bskur te/ yi ge 'di dkyil lam gling phran la bskur ba yizi zheX 6ཿshad pa

dang / gzhan gcig ni 'jar dmag gi rgyab phyogs zhabs 'degs ru khag gis 'thung chu skyel 'dren gyi gnas tshul sla ba'i gsang grangs kyi sgo nas dkyil lam gling phran la bskur ba de red/ glog 'phrin gsang grangs 'di gnyis a ri'i gtol bas 'jar pan gyi thengs 'dir dpung 'jug gi dus tshod dang dmag shugs tshang ma shes pa red/ spyir bshad na 'jar pan gyi stobs shugs shin tu che ste/ gnam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings bzhi dang chu thog gnam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings lnga/ dmag gru sna 70lhag chur 'dzul gru 16bcas yod pa ma zad/ da dung skyel 'dren gru shin tu mang / a ri la gnam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings gsum dang / dmag gru 22 chur 'dzul gru 19bcas yod pa dang / gzhan dkyil lam gling gi a ri'i srung dmag la gnam gru 100lhag yod/ yin na yang / a ris 'jar pan gyi gsang grangs gtor bas gnas tshul thams cad shes phyir de bzhin gyis gra sgrig 'thus tshang byas yod/zla 6pa'i tshes 3nyin/ a ri'i myul zhib gnam grus 'jar pan gyi skyel 'dren gru rnams mthong ma thag bka' ltar 'gad rdzas 'phangs kyang don thog tu ma rdzog phyi nyin dngos su dmag 'khrug gi 'go bcoms/ nyin de'i chu tshod drug pa yas mas su 'jar pan gyi gnam gru brgya lhag dkyil lam gling phran du 'byor bas gling phran thog tu btsugs yod pa'i nyen rtog 'phrul chas kyis nyen brda btang bas/ a ri'i gnam gru nyer drug ma gtogs gtor ma thub pa dang gnam gru 'bab thang la skyon chen po ma byung / chu tshod 6pa dang skar ma 50stong /'jar pan gyi gnam gru phyir log chu tshod 9ba dang skar ma 25steng a ri'i myul zhib gnam grus 'jar pan gyi gnam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings gsum mthong pas phar rgol byas kyang 'jar pan gyis cham la phab/ chu tshod 10pa dang phyed tsam du gnas tshul la 'gyur ldog byung ste/ a ri'i gru gzings chen mo dzi ༵༵ ’ rtags can dang 6 yo khu grong brdal mi rtags can nas 'phur ba'i

gnam grus 'jar pan gyi gnam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings gsum gtor bas 'jar dmag la pham nyes chen po thebs/ nyin gung a ri'i 4 yo khu grong brdal mi rtags can gyis gnam gru la snum sdug skabs 'jar pan gyi skyogs mdel phog pas gnod skyon chen po thebs/ phyi dro'i chu tshod 4pa dang skar ma 45steng / a ri'i gnam grus 'jar pan gyi ches mtha' mjug gi gnam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings 66g.yu 'brug ’ rtags can mthong phyir/ gnam gru nyer bzhi mngags te 'gad rdzas 'phangs/ 'gad rdzas bzhi lhag 'phangs pa na 46g.yu 'brug ’ rtags can gyi gnam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings la me 'bar rkyen/'jar dmag phyogs su mi 'thor ka med byung / a ri'i gnam gru gsum gron/hran pin wu hri li'u yis rang nyid kyi gnam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings bzhi bo brlags tshar ba dang a ri'i phyogs su da dung gnyis yod pa mthong nas phar rgol byed ma thub par/ zla 6pa'i tshes 5nyin gyi zhogs pa'i chu chod 2dang skar ma 55steng dmag dpung phyir 'then byed dgos pa'i bka' phab/ tshu tshod 9ba dang skar ma 30stong / a ris 'jar pan phyir bros pa shes nas byang phyogs su rjes 'ded btang yang rjes ma chod/thengs de'i dmag 'khrug gi mjug 'bras ni 'jar pan la gnam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings 4dang myul zhib gru 1 gnam gru 300lhag gi gyong gud thebs pa ma zad/ dmag mi 3500lhag gron/ a rir gnam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings gcig dang myul zhib gru gcig gnam gru 150lhag gi gyong gud thebs pa dang / mi 300gron/ skabs de nas bzung / zhi bde rgya mtsho'i dmag 'khrug gi gnas bab legs po a ri'i lag tu shor ba red/ 1942lo'i zla 8pa'i 'go dang phyi lo'i lo stod du/ 'jar dmag gis bka' gling nas a rir 'thab 'khrug byas/ lhag par thengs gsum la dmag dpung rtsa 'dzugs byas nas a rir rgol yang mtha' mar pham kha chen po nyos nas tram̐ bo~X ṭā byed

thabs med byung ba red/ dkyil lam gling phran nas bka' gling gi dmag 'khrug ni 'i bde rgya ma/tsho'i dmag 'khrug gi dkyogs mtshams kyi dus skabs shig red/ bka' gling dmag 'khrug gi rjes nas/ 'jar pan gyis 'i bde rgya mtsho'i lho nub nas phar rtsol gyi thabs lam 'gog rgol la bsgyur dgos byung /de'i rjes nas/ a ris mkha' mcho skam gsum gyi dmag dpung grab sdebs byas nas 'jar dam ga rtsa med gtong bar thabs jus 'then/1943lor/ hpha zhi sir ngo rgol byed pa'i mnyam 'brel rgyal khab dag gi dmag ༷/ ri 7( 9712tre ༷ 79po tshotshomatsho pho rdzo cho~X ṇḍaṃ rtso lko1lha rdzo / zla to sgosna sgo 7 7lhakyorsha molho'ilha merdzo 7do lharmāX ( —1༷༵ cirdo ༷ a ri'i gnam grus 'jar pan gyi dmag gru'i phyogs su 'gad rdzas 'phangs ba/— 266 —

mis rgya mtsho chen mo'i lho byang gi gling phran 'ga' nas phar rgol byas/ de'i phyi lor yang 'i bde rgya mtsho'i dkyil khul nas phar rgol byas te/ snga gzhug tu a li hrin dang cer pa'o the/ mā gro sogs gling tshom dang se pin gling / kon to gling sogs blangs/ yang zla 'ga'i dmag 'khrug brgyud nas rgyal kha bstud mar blangs/ 1945lo'i zla 2pa'i nang / mnyam 'brel dmag gis 'jar pan lag nas hphi li phen blangs/ dbyin a dmag dpung dang krung go'i dmag dpung mnyam 'brel byas nas 'jar dmag ru dpung gsum gtor ba dang /dgra mi khri tsho 34lhag bsad/ 1945lo'i zla 3pa'i nang / a ri'i dmag gis le'u hong gling blangs pa dang zla drug 'gror rjes kyang krong hrin gling blangs/ de dang dus mnyam du/ a ri'i mkha' dmag gis 'jar pan gyi bzo las lte ba gtor ba dang / 'jar pan gyi mtsho lam bkag zla 8pa'i tshes 6nyin/ a ris kon gling thog rdul phran mtshon cha thengs dang por 'phangs/ zla 8pa'i tshes 8nyin/ su'u len gyis 'jar pan la dmag 'khrug rgyag rgyu bsgrags/skabs der 'jar pan ci bya gtol bral du gyur nas zla 9pa'i tshes 2nyin mgo skur yi ger ming rtags bkod/ de nas 'i bde rgya mtsho'i dmag 'khrug mjug rdzogs pa royen la/ 'dzam gling 'khrug chen thengs gnyis pa ma jug rdzogs pa'ang sna ba// rgya mtsho'i dmag 'khrug gis 'jar dmag pham pa yin la/ don dngos su nga tshor nam yang btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i glo bur gyi 'jab rgol la mnyam 'jog byed dgos pa'i gsal 'debs byas yod/ da skabs ha we ye ru ljongs rgyur bskyod pa rnams kyi ma thong lam du mu tig gru kha'i dran gso khang lhang nger 'char nges yin la/ der skabs de'i lo rgyus kyi rnam pa ris su phab yod la/ 6 nam yang do snang yang dag byas te lo rgyus kyi skyo gar slar 'khyab du 'jug mi rung mi zhes skul ma gtong ba dang 'dra'o//— 267 —

zhe' le pham thag gcod pa/wa wasi ta lin ki li'i 'gog srung dmag 'khrugamo si kho'i g.yul 'khrug mjug rdzogs rjes/ dus yun ring bo'i su'u len dang 'jar man gyi dmag 'khrug rim gyis zhol 'jags su gyur/ yin yang phyogs gnyis gas dmag rta go tshon gyi grabs gshom byas nas de las gzhi rgya che ba'i g.yul 'gyed chen po zhig byed rgyu'i gra sgrig byas te lag gang snga dang rgyal kha su thob kyi las su brtson bzhin gnas/ skabs 'dir 'jar dmag la mtshon na su'u len la phyogs yongs nas phar rgol byed pa'i stobs shugs med par/ dmag dpung gi stobs shugs phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas lho phyogs kyi 'thab ra bzung zhing mdung rtse si ta lin ki li'i phyogs su gtad pa red/si ta lin ki li ni tun chu bo'i 'gram nas shar phyogs su spyi le drug cu tsam gyi byor cwa chu bo'i rgyud du chags yod pa dang / dngos ming la khra li cin zer/ 1918lor/ le nyin gyis si ta lin la mngags bcol byas te khra li cin srung skyob byed dgos par gdams pa ltar/ si ta lin gyis tun nyi cin gsar brje ngo log pa dang phyi rgyal btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi drag chas kyis nang srid la the gtogs byas pa pham par byas nas/ gsar du btsugs pa'i su'u we e rgyal khab la byas rjes chen po bzhag 1925lor/ su'u len mi dmangs kyis si ta lin gyi byas rjes gzengs su bstod pa'i tshogs chen bsdus shing /khra li cin zhes pa'i ming de si ta len ki li zhes par bsgyur/ (1962lor/su'u len gyis de'i ming byor cwa ki li zhes par bsgyur/) si ta lin ki li ni su'u len lho phyogs kyi bzo las dang 'grim 'grul gyi lte ba zhig yin te/ nub nas tun nyi ༵ ༵zo las sa khul dang / lho nas ko cwa su'u 'bru mdzod dang snum

mdzod/ shar nas wu'u ar gyi bzo las gsar ba'i sa khul dang su'u len dmag dpung bsdu 'dzoms kyi lte gnas/ byang nas mo si kho bcas la 'brel yod/ zhe thi les gal te su'u len gyi phun sum tshogs pa'i rang byung thon khungs dang bzo las kyi lte ba ste si ta lin ki li len thub pa byung na/ kho'i gnas bab je legs su 'gro ba gdon mi za bar snyams/ zhe thi les 'jar pan dang 'brel nas shar nub gnyis nas su'u len rtsa med du gtong rgyu dang /mu mthud nas stobs shugs gcig sgril gyis dbyin ji dang a ri/ krung go sogs dbang du bsdus nas 'dzam gling ham 'dzin byed rgyu'i dmigs yul bcangs/ de'i stabs kyis si ta lin ki lir phar rgol byed rgyu ni su'u len la dmag 'khrug rgyag rgyu'i gnad ga yin/ de bas si ta lin ki li'i dmag 'khrug la chab srid dang dmag don thad la don snying gal chen ldan/zhe thi les si ta lin ki lir dmag 'khrug byed pa'i 'char gzhi ni 'di ltar te/ thog mar tun chu bo dang spror cwa chu bo'i bar gyi 'gag bcad nas su'u len lho byang gi 'grim 'grul gcod rgyu dang / si ta lin ki li blangs rjes dmag dpung phyogs gnyis su bgos te/ phyogs gcig spror cwa chu bo rgyud nas byang phyogs la bskyod de mo si kho bskor rgyu dang / phyogs ga'an zhig shar lto'i phyogs su bskyod de snam mdzod sogs blangs te ko cwa su'u la dbang bsgyur rgyu dang / de nas i ran brgyud lho phyogs kyi par sig 'gag bskyod mthar/'jar pan dmag dpung dang nyin rdu rgya mtsho chen mo nas 'dzoms rgyu de yin/thengs 'di'i lho phyogs la dpung 'jug byed par zhe thi les dmag khri tsho brgya dang lnga bcu tsam bsdus shing / gnam gru dang me phyogs skor zhig kyang yod/ hpho lan har phen we khe si dmag dpon gyis 2ru khag la bkod 'domasabyas te thengs 'di'i si ta lin ki lir rgol ba'i 'gan gtso bo khur yod/ zla 7pa'i zla dkyil du/ kho'i dmag dpung gi ru khag pricu stusbyam ༄ra

bsdoms pa'i dmag khri nyer lnga dang / me skyogs sum stong dang than khe lnga brgya/'thab 'dzing gnam gru chig stong nyis brgya bcas yod/ de'i rjes nas 'i thrig lis da dung mu mthud du dpung rogs mang po bsnan/su'u len phyogs kyi spyi'i 'char ga'i ni/ thog mar dgra bo nang la bsdu rgyu dang de nas ngo rgol drag po byed rgyu/ rme tha' mar dgra bo'i stobs shugs zad rjes phar rgol byed rgyu de'o// su'u len gyi ches mtho'i dmag dpung bkod 'doms khang gis si ta lin ki li srung ched/ zla 7pa'i tshes 20nyin/ the mo zhin ki dmag dpon gyis bkod 'doms byas pa'i sa srung dmag dpung gsar du btsugs/ spyi le 250tsam gyi tun chu bo'i ngogs su 'thab rags bzung yod/ dmag khri tsho bcu drug dang / me phyogs 2200 than khe 400/gnam gru 454bcas yod pa dang / gzhan 'gal rdzas 'phen pa'i gnam gru brgya lhag yod/ phyogs gnyis kyi stobs shugs bsdur na/ 'jar dmag su'u dmag las ldab 0 7gyis mang ba dang / me skyogs dang than khe ldab 0 3gyis mang / da rung gnam gru ldab 1lhag gis mang ngo //si ta lin ki li'i dmag gis dgra bo'i mdun nas phyi nur mtho gang yang mi byed ces pa'i 'bod skul bton/ mkhar gyi phyogs so so nas phyi bskor dang nang bskor/ bar bskor sogs srung rags bskrun pa dang / de dag gi rgyu cha gtso bo shing yin na yang 'gog srung la nus pa mi dman pa bton yod/dmangs dmag gis ru chung 83tsam rtsa 'dzugs byas te dmag dpung la ram 'degs byas pa ma zad/ mkhar nang gi sdod mi tshang mas dgra 'gog la gra sgrig byas yod/1942lo'i zla 7pa'i tshes 17nyin/ g.yul 'khrug gi 'go brtsams/'jar dmag gis su'u dmag la phar rgol drag po byas kyang de mtshungs kyi sol lan pho/70zla /pa'i zla mjug tu/ 'jar man dmag tun chu bo'i 'gram la

'byor/ skabs der 'jar man bkod 'doms khang nas 2ru dpung kho nas si ta lin ki li len mi thub pa shes nas/ ko cwa su'u nas than khe'i dam ga dpung ba'i ba rgyab rogs su mngags te/ lho phyogs nas phar rgol byed du bcug su'u len nas kyang dmag dpung la yang bskyar bkod sgrig byas/su'u len gyis 'jar man 'gog ched tun chu bo'i 'gram nas zla gcig ring khrag dmar gyi yur chu bzhur ba'i g.yul 'khrug byas kyang / 'jar man dmag la nyung mtha' med par nyin re las nyin rer je ma nga yin pa dang stobs shugs kyang je cher gyur bas/ zla 8pa'i tshes 23nyin tun chu bo brgal nas klor cwa chu bo'i 'gram du slebs/ mkhar grong la'ang gnod pa tshabs chen bzos pa ma zad su'u len dmag phyogs gnyis su gyes/ de dang dus mnyam du 'jar man gyis mkhar nang la gnam gru nas 'gad rdzas 'phangs pa dang / bsdoms pas 'gad rdzas khri brgya lhag 'phangs pas mkhar de thal rdul du btang / yin na yang si ta len ki li'i mi rnams kyi dpa' zhum pa phar zhig sems su sha 'khon gyi me lce drag tu 'bar/ dgra bos 'gad rdzas kyi 'jigs rngam ji 'dra che yang kho /sa ༵ mthud nas than khe dang me stogs gsar skrun dang zhig gso byed ba na zla )pa/ 'i tshes 12nyin/ 'jar man dmag gis nub phyogs dang lho phyogs nas si ta lin ki li'i mkhar grong bskor ba dang / nyin gnyis par/phar rgol drag po byas/ de bas zla 9pa'i tshes 14nyin gyi phyi dro/ 'jar man dmag gi 'dzing rags gtor nas mkhar grong nang du slebs/ 'jigs su rung ba'i mkhar nang gi dmar 'dzing zhig gi 'go brtsams byung / 'jar man dmag gis mkhar de 'phrog ched ru dpung 13gyi dmag 170000dang than khe 500 me phyogs 1700sogs bkod sgrig byas/ mkhar srung bar dam ga mi khri tsho dgu dang me smyogs 10① than khe 120tsam las med kyang / si ta byinā ki tram̐

srung mkhan rnams kyis 'chi bar phangs sems ma skyes par ngo rgol byas pa dang /srang lam re re dang thog khang re re/ tha na khang pa re re yang 'phrog rtsod drag po byas pas 'thab 'khrug gi yun bsrings/ mkhar srung dmag dpon ya kho hphu'u pā hphu'u lo'u hphu dang dmag ba'is thog khang zhig nas zla gnyis ring ngo rgol byas te dgra bos len ma thub par grags/ tshul des 'jar man la dngangs 'dar skye ru bcug 'jar man gyi dmag zhig gis nyin tho bris yod pa 'di ltar/6 su'u len mi ni sha khrag gdos bcas kyis grub pa'i mi min te/ kho tsho ni rdo dang lcags kyis grub pa sha stag red/ me skyogs kyi nyen khar mi skrag pa dang thang chad pa'i rnam 'gyur yang mi 'dug zhes dang / yang 'jar dmag ga'an zhig gis 2 si ta lin ki li'i g.yul 'khrug gi nyin 'ag brgyad cu'i ring sung lam du mi ro'i khengs shing / mkhar du me sbar pa'i dud sprin 'thibs/dngos gnas skyi g.ya' ba'i snang tshul zhig go zhes bris yod/ su'u len mi dmangs kyi 'jigs pa med pa'i snying stobs des 'jar man dmag la ci / gi —— smi /( sa cicagardoX lta/ 3sna khorī snadi — ci/shā 3nu /lhamo sdu'os // ru sa —— ༷༷'i ci ji ༷ tsho0mi — ru ༷ ci nga snye sna tre snyeX gyi smi 4 ci sna tsho / ma /sde — tsho rdoX ri ༷ ༷sna (ci ci ༵ — sgyu si ta lin ki lir srung skyob byedapa'imu'u len gyi rdemarsha ṅgi dang 'jar man dmas gnyis kyis mkhar grong du 'thab 'khrug rgyag pa/

dbang med kyi dngan pa zhig shor du bcug yod/zla 11pa'i tshes 18bar du g.yul 'khrug byas pas/ 'jar man gyi stobs shugs phyogs yongs nas zad yod de/ lhag par gdung len dmag rnams thang shin tu chad pas rgol ba nas 'gog pa'i thabs la zhugs/ zla 7pa nas zla 11pa'i bar du/ 'jar dmag bsdoms pa'i khri 70tsam gron pa dang /than khe 1000lhag dang / me stogs 2000tsam/ gnam gru 1400tsam bcas kyis gyong gud thebs/ zhe thi les myur du si ta lin ki li len pa'i 'char ga'i dang 1942lo'i dbyar ston g.yul 'khrug gi jus bkod stong bar gyur/'jar dmag gis 'gog sol gyi dus skabs de ni su'u len dmag gis phar rgol byed pa'i dus skabs yin/ su'u len gyis myur du dmag 1106000tsam bsdus pa dang / me sgrogs 15500tsam/ than khe 1463lhaga'athab 'dzing gnam gru 1350lhag bcas bkod sgrig byas nas phar rgol byed rgyu thag bcad/ thengs 'dir 'jar dmag dang bsdur na dmag khri 10mang ba dang / me skyogs 500lhag dang than khe 1700lhag gnam gru 100lhag gis mang ngo // de las gtso bor gyur ba zhig ni su'u len dmag la rgyal kha thob pa'i yid ches dang stobs shugs kyis khengs yod la/ 'jar dmag gi snying stobs shor ba de yin/ 1942lo'i zla 11pa'i tshes 19nyin gyi zhogs par/ su'u len nub lho phyogs kyi dmag dpung gis si ta lin ki li'i nub byang nas phar rgol byas/ me phyogs 2000tsam mnyam gcig tu 'phangs pas sa rub dus/'jar dmag mkhar grong dang spyi le 20— 30tsam la ded/ zla 11pa'i tshes 20nyin/ su'u dmag gis lho phyogs nas yang bskyar phar sol byas/ tshes 22nyin gyi dgong mor/ su'u dmag gis tun chu bo'i zam pa len par/dmag gi bkod 'doms pa ཿsa li pa'o rmus 'thab jus shig bton pa ni zam 'gram gyi 'jar dmag ma lus rtsa rdzogs byed par than khe'i glo1 ba/shā napa mu

mthud nas ma dun skyod byed dgos pa de yin/ de ltar bskyod pas 'jar dmag gi than khe rnams rang phyogs kyi yin pa ra 'khrul bas mang po 'ig gi srog shor ba dang / ཿsa li pa'o rmu la 6 dpa' thod mi kyi mtshan snya na thob/ zla 11pa'i tshes 23nyin/ nub byang dang lho phyogs nas phar rgol byas pa'i su'u len dmag dpung kha la chi dang su'u we e tshi ce/ ma la no'u hphu khā sogs su lhan 'dzoms byas pas 'jar dam ga khri tsho 33tsam gyis mtha' bskor/ rim gyis phyogs so so nas thag je nyer bcar nas gcig kyang ma lus par gsod pa'i sta gon byas/skabs 'dir 'jar dmag gi ma kha' 'grul gnam grus 'bru rigs dang sman rdzas/ 'gad rdzas sogs ṣpe — mi niX snye la — ne tsho 3 ci dro — skyel thabs ma byung / dngha — ri la khu rshaci — — //rgyu mtshan ni su'u len gyis mkha' tha lam bkag sdom byas yod pas ji me 3yin/ der yod pa'i 'jar man gyi gnam gru 'bab thang gcig pu'ang su'u dmag gis blangs pa dang / kho tshos skud med glog ci / ma lam nas 'jar man gyi gnam gru / sdu 45ji 〉zimo'i ma nga po zhig la mgo bskor btang rsha〉 rme sgrornga ṭwāṃmu zhu dma 15 kyā te nas 'bru rigs dang sman rdzas (34 tsho ci ———mu sku 'ipesduze chotshu ci sogs nom du blangs/ 1943lo'i zla 1por/ 'jar man dmag dpon 'jar man gyi dmag pa'o leg si gtsos dmag dpon 24su'u rnams ltogs skom gyis mnar dmag ris 'dzin bzung byas pa/— 274 —

nas rang rang gi zhin rta bsad nas de'i sha mi bza' ka med byung / dmag mi res nyin rer khe brgya can gyi bag leb sob sob cig dang khe sum cu can gyi mar tsam ma gtogs med/ than khe la'ang snam zad pas bkol spyod byed thabs med par gyur/1943lo'i zla 1pa'i tshes 8nyin/su'u dmag gis 'jar man ma go sgur dgos pa'i bka' bsgrags/ yin na yang / zhe thi les dang len ma byas/ zla 1po'i tshes 10nyin gyi chu tshod 8pa dang skar ma 50stong / su'u dmag gis phyogs so so nas me phyogs 'phangs nas 'jar dmag la 'jigs snang skul/zla 1po'i tshes 24nyin/ yang bskyar 'jar dam ga dpon po pa'o li si yis zhe thi les la mgo sgur ram zhes snyan zhu phul yang / zhe thi les dmag gcig ma gtogs ma lu sa rung ma go sgur mi chog ces bka' phab/ tshes 26nyin gyi dgong mor/ 'jar dmag phyogs gnyis su bgos pa dang / phyogs gcig la pa'o lig sis bkod 'doms byas pa dang / phyogs gzhan 'ig la hri thu li kher gyis bkod 'doms byas/ rjes nas pa'o lig si'i dmag tshang ma/ su'u dmag gis bzung ba dang / zla 2pa'i tshes 2nyin/ hri thu li kher gyi dmag gis mgo sgur ro//de dang dus mnyam du/ si ta lin ki li'i nye 'gram gyi 'jar dmag tshogs pa drug pa dang / than khe'i tshogs pa ba'i ba/ ro ma ni ya'i dmag tshogs gsum pa dang bzhi ba/ dbyi tha li'i dmag tshogs brgyad pa sogs pham nas spror cwa chu 'gram dang kha bral nas nub phyogs su bros/si ta lin ki li'i dmag 'khrug ni 1942lo'i zla 7pa'i tshes 17nas 1943lo'i zla 2pa'i tshes 2nyin bar yin/ zla drug ring gi dmag 'khrug der/'jar dam ga bsad pa dang bzung ba/ rmas pa sogs bsdoms pa'i khri 150tsam la nye/ — 775 —

si ta lin ki li dmag 'khrug ni dbyin ji dang a ri'i tshags par gyis hphan tan g.yul 'khrug la 'gran thub par bkod kyang / de'i don snying ni hphan tan g.yul 'khrug las ches cher brgal yod de/ de ni su'u len rgyal srung dmag 'khrug gi dkyogs mtshams shig yin pa ma zad/ 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa'i dkyogs mtshams shig kyang yin/ g.yul 'khrug gi nyin mtshan kun tu 'dzam gling mi dmangs kyis si ta lin ki li'i g.yul 'khrug la sems khur byed bzhin yod pa dang / dmag 'khrug la rgyal kha thob pas mi rnams kyis hpha zhi si la ngo rgol gyi spobs pa rgyas/ 'jar man skabs 'di nas pham thag bcad pa red/ — 276 —

a the ri kha gling byang ma'irna la man g.yul 'khrug1940lo'i ston khar/ hpha zhi si dbyi tha lis hpha ran si pham par byas pa dang / dbyin jis yo rob skam sa chen po nas phyir bsnur ba'i go skabs dang bstun nas dmag dpung 'bor chen zhig bsdus nas a hphe ri kha gling byang ma dang a hphe ri kha gling shar mar dpung 'jug byas nas dbyin ji dang hpha ran si'i mi ser spel yul 'phrog rgyu'i 'dun pa bcangs/ dbyi tha li'i dmag dpung la thog mar rgyal kha 'ga' thob kyang mtha' mar ma brtan/ zla 12pa'i nang / dbyin jis dpung chen bco lnga tsam gyis dbyi tha li'i dmag la rgol nas myur du zhi lan ni cwar slebs pa dang de nas a hphe ri kha gling byang rgyud nas nub phyogs su ded/ 1941lo'i zla 1po'i nang tha'o phu'u lu'u khe blangs pa dang /zla 2pa'i nang a ke la blangs/ dbyi tha li'i dmag dpung la bstud mar pham kha byung / zhe thi les kho'i nus med kyi grogs po de skyob rgyu dang / e cib dbang du bsdu ba'i ham sems bcangs nas 'jar man gyi dmag dpon lung me ar la dmag dpung cig khrid du bcug nas a hphe ri kha gling byang mar mngags/ lung me ar zhes pa ni spyang grung 'dzoms pa'i 'thab jus pa 'ig yin la kho ni zhe thi le'i ches nus pa ldan pa'i dmag dpon nang gi gcig yin/ rilung me ar gyi glog 'khyug pa lta bu'i glo bur gyi phar rgol des/ dbyin jir bsdud mar pham kha byin myong / 1942lo'i zla 1po'i tshes 21nyin/ lung me ar gyis thengs lnga bar glog 'khyug pa lta bu'i 'thab rtsal bkol nas dbyin dmag pham par byas pa ma zad/ tho ri pho li tha ni ya'i 'gram nas kha 'thor du phyin pa'i dbyin dmag la rgol rdung byas pas/ dbyin dmag spyi le 500tsam dgye /sta phyi nd+rar

byas/ de'i rjes btsan shed kyis dbyin ji'i lag nas tha'o phu'u lu'u khe phyir blangs pa dang / dbyin dmag 30000tsam mgo skur/ skabs de nas lung me sbyar snro mtshan snyan shin tu rgyas pa dang / 6 bye thang gi dpa' rgod mices pa'i nga sa/ )pa/ 'i tshes 4nyin/ 'jar man dang dbyi tha li'i mnyam 'brel dmag e cib kyi a la man nye 'gram gyi dbyin dmag gi g.yul sar bcar/ ya li hran ta mtsho khug dang spyi le 140tsam las med/ yin yang skabs 'dir 'jar dmag la mo si kho nas pham kha chen po byung ba'i rkyen gyis mu mthud nas hphe gling byang mar dpung snon pa'i stobs shugs med par ma zad/ 1941lo'i stod du sa dbus rgya mtsho dang a hphe ri kha gling byang ma'i g.yul sar mngags pa'i mkha' dmag phyir 'then nas/ shar phyogs su 'jar dmag gi dpung rogs la mngags/ mkha' dmag phyir song nas skam sa'i dmag la mkha' dmag gi 'gebs srung med pas stobs shugs je gnyom du phyin/ lung me ar gyis su'u ye hri chu 'gag len ma thub par mdun bskyod byed mtshams bzhag de'i rjes nas phyogs gnyis kyis 'thab ra bzung nas sdod pa las sus kyang phan tshun la hāl ma thub mod/ gang ltar gnas bab legs shos da dung 'jar dmag la da/ dbyin jir dka' khag mang po 'phrad yod de/ 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa nas bzung / hpha ran sis bar mtshams med par rgol rdung byas pa dang e cib kyis kyang ngo rgol byas pas/ dbyin ji'i srid dpon chi'u ce ar gyi sems kha bde la gtan nas 'bab ma thub par nyin mtshan kun tu bsam ga'igs kyi rgya mtshor lhung / lhag par a hphe ri kha gling byang ma'i dbyin dmag gi nyen kha ji ltar sel bar bsam blo btang /— 1/rdo2lo'i zla 8pa'i tshes 3nyin gyi zhogs par/ chi'u ce ar drag jus

dmag dpon a lan pu'u lu'u khe dang mnyam du gnam grur bsdad de khe ro ((21 1077)la bskyod nas rang nyid dngos kyis a hphe ri kha gling byang ma'i g.yul 'khrug gi gnas bab la rgyus lon dang / 'thab jus gsar ba zhig 'don par song / chi'u ce ar gyis dbus shar g.yul sa'i dmag don mgo khrid pa brje spor byas te/ dmag phyir 'then byed par brel ba'i dbus shar spyi khyab dmag dpon dang ru tshogs brgyad pa'i dmag dpon gyi 'gan gcig lcogs kyis khur ba o cin le khe go sa nas phab pa dang / hwa lu'u ti ya li hran ta dbus shar spyi khyab dmag dpon la bskos pa dang / men ka ma li ru tshogs brgyad pa'i dmag dpon du bskos/ men ka ma li ni lon ton gyi chos lugs mi sna zhig gi khyim nas skyes/ lo bco brgyad steng nas dmag gi slob grwar zhugs/ da dung 'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang por zhugs myong ba dang / so mu'u chu bo'i g.yul 'khrug steng dbyin dmag khag cig la bkod 'doms byas nas 'jar dmag dang 'thab myong ba sogs kyis dmag don thad nyams myong phun sum tshogs pa yod/ khos kyang phyir dran byas nas bshad rgyur 6 'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang po mjug rdzogs rjes/ ngas da gzod dmag don gyi bya ba'ag la mi tshe gang por 'ib 'jug byed rgyu 'ig yin pa gzhi nas rtogs mi zer/zla 8pa'i tshes 11nyin/ men ki ma li khe ror slebs/ zla 8pa'i 13nyin gyi snga dro chu tshod 11steng / kho a hphe ri kha gling byang ma'i ru tshogs brgyad par bkod 'doms byed du phyin/ g.yul sar dmag mi rnams kyi sems shugs nyams yod pa dang phyir bskyod byed pa'i re ba che phyir/ nyin de'i dgong mor bkod 'doms pa drug cu lhag bsdus nas gros tshogs 'tshogs/ tshogs thog tu khos dmag gi sems shugs slar gso byed dgos par skul ba dang / stobs shugs gsar ba zhig bskyed dgos pa'i bka' phab ste/ e cib kyi 'gog srung 'dzing rags ni a la man dang lu'u hphun sa the ri rgyud la 'brel yokā/79de sa

'gog srung 'di shor na e cib hril bo dgra lag tu shor nges yin pas nges par du phyi snar byed mi nyan zhes sogs bsgrags/men ki ma lis thengs 'dir dbyin dmag la ngar shugs chen po bskyed pas/ sems shugs nyams pa dag la'ang rang shugs kyis spobs pa zhig skyes ru bcug de dang dus mnyam du khos dmag dpung la dag ther nan mo byas/rgyu rngam sdar ma dag gi lag nas dmag dpon gyi go sa blangs/ skam dmag dang mkha' dmag la sbyong brdar legs po byed du bcug de ltar ru tshogs brgyad pa'i dmag la dag ther byas pa'i rjes nas stobs shugs gsar ba zhig mngon byung ba red/ skabs 'dir rgyal spyi'i gnas bab la bltas na'ang dbyin jir phan thogs chen po yod nges red/ 'jar man la si ta lin ki li'i dmag 'khrug khrod pham kha chen po byung bas a hphe ri kha gling la dam/ga dang drag chas kyi mkho sprod byed pa je nyung du song / 'dis ni dbyin jis a hphe ri kha gling byang ma nas 'jar dmag la rgol bar cha rkyen legs po bskrun pa red/zla 8pa'i tshes 31nyin/ men ki ma lis a la man nye 'gram gyi a la mu'u hwa hpha mtho sgang du g.yul bshams/ khos thog mar lung me ar tshur rtsol gyi lam de yin par tshod dpags byas pa red/ de ltar du kho'i 'char gzhi dang lung me ar gyi gom stabs ma thun pas sa de nas 'jar dmag cham la phab/yin yang / dmag 'khrug gi rtsa ba'i rnam pa bsgyur ma thub/ de bas/ a la man g.yul sa'i phan tshun gyer 'dug gi rnam pa 'di bsgyur ched/ dbyin dmag gis zla bcu ba'i zla mjug tu 'jar man dang dbyi tha li'i mnyam 'brel dmag la phar rgol byed rgyu'i thag bcad/dbyin dmag a la man g.yul 'khrug la zhugs pa'i ru tshogs brgyad par dpung khag bcu dang rang dbang ru khag bzhi bcas yod/ bsdom sa pa'i dmag /8 ༵ 3lhag dang / than khe 140dang / me skyogs 2311tsam/

gnam gru 1500lhag bcas yod/ men ki ma li'i g.yul 'khrug gi 'char gzhi ni skam pa'i bar du btsir ba dang 'dra ba'i 'thab jus bton nas/ a la man gyi lho nub nas rgol te zhi tewa har me ti sa cha'i phyogs su bskyod nas dgra bo mtsho 'gram la bcug nas sen bar gyi shig ltar gsod rgyu de red/ lung me ar gyis mnyam 'brel dmag a la man nub phyogs nas spyi le 60tsam gyi char 'thab rags las nas gra sgrig byas/ bsdoms pa'i dmag 80000tsam dang than khe 540lhag me stogs 1450dang gnam gru 350bcas yod/ yin na yang / mnyam 'brel dmag la mkho chas kyi phyogs nas shin tu zhan/ khos thog mar rim pa dang po'i rkang dmag gis dgra bo'i gdong len rgyu dang / de napa sdim pa bzhi ba'i than khe'i dmag gis gdong bsus nas pham par gtong rgyu /byi/na dmag gis phar rgol byed pa'i dus tshod ni zla 10pa'i tshes 23nyin gyi dgong mor thag bcad de/ men ki ma lis thengs 'dir lung me ar pham par gtong thub rgyur yid ches yod par bshad pa dang / mi shugs dang rgyu shugs kyi phyogs nas kyang kho tsho pham par byed thub par bsgrags/dgong mo der/ dbyin dmag gis me phyogs 1000tsam dus gcig tu dgra phyogs su 'phangs/ skar ma 20'gor ba'i rjes nas/ dbyin dmag gi rkang dmag mdun bskyod byed 'go bcoms/ zhag gcig gi g.yul 'khrug khrod/ dbyin dmag dgra bo'i 'gog srung 'gram du 'byor ba dang / de'i rjes nas chu tshod gcig gi ring dpung khag la bkod sgrig legs po byas nas mu mthud du mdun bskyod byas/ nyin gnyis pa'i snga mo'i chu tshod lnga'i steng /dbyin dmag gi dpung khag gnyis dmigs sa der slebs yod kyang / gtso dpung bskyod pa shin tu dal bas dgra bo'i 'gog srung 'thab rags gtor ma thub/ — 281 —

men ki ma li'i sems su 6 rus 'brad byed pa ’ lta bu'i phar rgol 'dir shor ba mang par snyam nas/ zla 10pa'i tshes 27nyin phar rgol byed mtshams ba'ag ste yang bskyar dmag dpung ru gral bkod sgrig byas nas dmigs sa byang phyogs su 'khor/ lung me ar gyis kyang yang bskyar ru gral bsgrigs/tshes 28nyin gyi phyi dro/ dbyin dmag gi gnam gru mang pos dus mnyam du mnyam 'brel dmag gi than the dang me stogs gtor ba dang tshur rgol gyi gra sgrig kyang gtor/ zla 11pa'i tshes 2nyin gyi nam gung dus tshod gcig steng /dbyin dmag gis me skyogs dang than khe bkol nas mnyam 'brel dmag la phar rgol byas/ sa rub pa'i bar 'khrug pas/ dbyi tha li'i dmag dpung nyi shu pa tshang ma bsad rmas ci rigs byas pa dang dmag dpon kyang bzung /skabs de nas mnyam 'brel dmag pham kha'i phyogs su phyin/lung me ar la pham nyes chen po byung yod pa ma zad rgyab dpung nas 'bru rigs sogs mkho sprod byed par yang dka' ngal chen po byung bas/ thengs 'dir rgyal kha mi thob pa gsal bor shes yod/ zla 11pa'i tshes 3nyin/ lung me ar gyis zhe thi ler re ba bton nas kho la rang dbang gi 'gul spyod dbang cha sprod dgos par zhus kyang / zhe thi les sna gom gang phyi nur med par g.yul sa 'dzin dgos mi zhes bka' bstsal/ de'i stabs kyis khos dmag phyir 'then byed mi chog par mi bsgrags thabs med byung / zla 11pa'i tshes 4nyin gyi snga dro/dbyin dmag gis mnyam 'brel dmag rtsa ba nas pham par byas pa red/ dbyi tha li'i ru dpung bzhi dbyin jir mgo 'bul byas/ lung me ar gyis dmag 35000tsam khrid nas spyi le bdun brgya'i sar bros nas bsdad/nyin bcu gnyis ring gi a la man g.yul 'khrug khrod/ mnyam 'brel dmag 50000tsam gron pa dang / than the 525lhag me phyogs 1000lhag gi gyong guX sbyong —/ dbyin dmag kyang 13500tsam gron/ thengs 'di'i dmag

'khrug ni 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa'i khrod kyi a hphe ri kha gling dbus ma'i g.yul 'khrug gi dkyogs mtshams shig tu gyur ba dang / dbyin dmag gis 'jar 'gog g.yul 'khrug khrod blangs pa'i rgyal kha chen po thengs dang po yin/men ki ma lir thengs 'dir rgyal kha chen po thob pas khor dmag dpon chen po'i mtshan snyan thob/ma 'gyangs par a ri'i ming du grags pa'i dmag dpon chen mo pa tun gyis dpung khag khrid nas a hphe ri kha gling byang mar slebs nas/ dbyin ji dang mnyam 'brel gyis 'thab ra bzung / 1943lo'i zla 4pa'i 20nyin/mnyam 'brel dmag gi tho'u ni si mkhar na yod pa'i 'jar man dmag la phar rgol byas/ zla 5pa'i tshes 13nyin/ a hphe ri kha gling byang mar gnas pa'i 'jar dmag dang dbyi tha li'i dmag bsdoms pa'i khri tsho 25tsam gyis mnyam lha/shā nāmag la mgo sgur bas/ a hphe ri kha gling byang ma'i g.yul 'khrug mjug

btsan rgyal g.yul 'khrug 'char gzhi'i〈bag bstar/wa wano'u man ti nas skam sar 'dzeg pa'i dmag 'khrug1940lo'i zla 5pa'i nang / zhe thi les ru dpung 136dang / than khe 3000lhag dang rlangs 'khor/ 'thab 'dzing gnam gru sogs mang po phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas dbyin ji dang hpha ran si/ sgyel kram/ ho lan sogs kyi phyogs su dpung 'jug drag po byas/ zla 5pa'i tshes 15nyin/ ho lan pham nasi mgo sgar/ 'jar dmag stobs shugs chen po'i ngang nas to spror mtsho 'gag brgal te mdun bskyod byas/ zla 5pa'i tshes 27nyin nas zla 6pa'i tshes 4nyin bar/ dbyin pho'i dmag gru 1200dang dmangs gru mang po bkol nas mi 338226lhag tun khi ar (77)lo)nas phyir 'then byas/ de nas dus kyi 'gyur ba dang bstun nas 'jar man gyi gnas bab je sdug tu phyin pa dang /mna' mthun rgyal khab kyi stobs shugs nyin re bzhin je cher gyur/ lo bzhi 'gor rjes/ dbyir ji dang a ri'i ngo sol dmag yang bskyar slebs/1944lo'i zla 6pa'i tshes 6nyin/ mnyam 'brel dmag gis dbyin ji li mtsho 'gag brgal nas dmag don lo rgyus steng ches che ba'i skam sar 'dzigs pa'i g.yul 'khrug chen po bslangs/ thengs 'dir skam sar 'dzeg sa ni hpha ran si'i no'u man ti ( cha༅ṭha)mtsho rgyud yin/si ta lin ki li g.yul 'khrug mjug rdzogs pa nas/ 'jar man zhe thi le'i rgyal khab nyams rgud du 'gro bar thag mi ring ba gsal bor shes/1943lo'i zla 11pa'i tshes 28nyin nas zla 12pa'i tshes 1nyin/ su'u len dang a ri/ dbyin ji gsum gyi srid 'dzin pa si ta lin dang lu'u si rmu/ chi'u ce ar gswā14 i sdan gyi rgyal sa the ho ran (166678bas phra)du 'dzoms nas

gros sol gnang / gros don gtso bo ni yo rob du g.yul sa gnyis pa gtod rgyu'i skor yin/ gros tshogs kyis bstan don/ zu dmag 'khrug gi skor la nga tsho'i dmag don 'thab jus pa dag gis gros mol gnang ba ltar/ 'jar man rtsa med gtong ba'i 'char gzhi dngos su gtan 'khel byas pa yin/ nga tsho shar phyogs dang nub phyogs/ lho phyogs nas phar rgol byed pa'i dus tshod dang 'thab jus la gros 'cham byung bas rgyal kha nga tshor dbang pa khag theg yin mi zhes zer/ g.yul sa gnyis pa gtod ched/ rgyal khab gsum gyis 66btsan rgyal ’ zhes pa'i dmag 'khrug gi 'char gzhi lag bstar byed rgyu byas/ si ta lin gyis thengs gnyis pa'i g.yul sa de yo rob nub ma nas phye na shin tu legs pa'i re ba bton pa dang a ri'i tsung thung lu'u si spru yang der yid 'thad byung / mtha' mar rgyal khab gsum gyis 66btsan rgyal ’ 'char gzhi de 1944lo'i zla 5par 'go brtsam rgyu thag bcad/1943lor/ su'u len dang 'jar man gyi dmag 'khrug gi rnam pa yongs su bsgyur te/ su'u len gyis 'jar man lag nas 273tsam gyi sa phyir blangs pa dang / 'jar dmag khri tsho 400tsam gron/ 1944lor/ su'u len gyis phyogs yongs nas ngo rgol drag po byas pa dang / zla 6pa'i nang / su'u dmag shar phu ra hri dang hwa so'i nye 'gram du 'byor nas/ mu mthud du gom stabs chen pos byang phyogs su bskyod ba'in pa'i dus skabs der/ de dang dmigs yul mtshungs pa'i yo rob g.yul sa gnyis pa'i 'thab 'khrug gi 'go rtsom stuzhin yod la/ der dbyin a rgyal khab gnyis kyis bkod sgrig 'ib mo byas ༵/43lo'i ye shu'i 'khrungs skar gyi snga nub/ a ri'i tsung thung lu'u si rmus rgyang bsgrags nas bshad rgyur/ nub byang yo rab mnyam 'brel dmag gi ches mtho'i dmag dpon gyi 'gan e san ho wer nas khurawa da/sdu 5pa 〉nga /

dbyin ji'i mkha' dmag dmag dpon the tis ches mtho'i dmag dpon gzhon pa'i 'gan 'khur dgos pa/ dbyin ji'i dmag dpon men gi ma lis dbyin dmag gi skam dmag bkod 'doms pa'i 'gan 'khur dgos pa/ a ri'i dmag dpon pu'u le ti les a ri'i skam dmag bkod 'doms pa'i 'gan 'khur dgos pa khyab bsgrags byas/ 1944lo'i zla 1po'i tshes 14nyin/ e san ho wer gnam grur bsdad nas lon ton du slebs pa dang / 6 btsan rgyal midamag 'khrug la phyogs yongs nas gra sgrig byas/mnyam 'brel dmag skam sar 'dzeg sa 'dems rgyu ni rgyal pham dang 'brel ba shin tu chen po yod pa zhig red/ de la ma mtha' yang cha rkyen gnyis 'dzom dgos te/ gcig ni dbyin ji'i mkha' dmag lte gnas dang thag shin tu nye dgos/ de ltar na bar snang nas sa thog gi dmag dpung la 'gebs srung byed thub pa yin/ gnyis ni nges par du bkod sgrig ldan pa'i gru kha yin dgos/ de ltar na skam sar 'jog pa'i dmag dpung la dmag gi mkho chas skyel bar stabs bde bas yin/ de ltar ma byas na 'jar man gyi ngo rgol 'gog thabs bral/ sa cha de 'dems 'gan khur mkhan ni dbyin ji'i mtsho dmag gi dmag dpon mo kun zhes pa de yin/ khos yo rob skam sa chen po'i sa'i gnas babs brtag dpyad zhib mo byas pa dang / tha na rlung gi rgyu phyogs/mtsho'i zab tshad/ sa'i chags rim sogs la'ang zhib 'jug byas pa ma zad/yang 'jar dmag gi ru gral gyi sgrigs stangs la'ang brtag dpyad byas te mtha' mar sa gnas gnyis 'dems pa red/ de las gcig ni hpha ran si'i cwa le (10lko)mtsho rgyud yin pa dang / gzhan gcig ni hpha ran si'i no'u man ti mtsho rgyud yin/ de nas mo kun gyis mtsho rgyud 'di gnyis la gshib sdur nan mo byas te/ cwa le mtsho ni dbyin ji dang spyi le bzhi bcu ma gtogs med pas thag shigā ñtsha nye dang gru kha yang bzang mod/ sa 'gag dog pa dang 'jar

man gyi 'gog srung 'dzing rags btsan pa'i dbang gis skam sar 'dzegs pa'i gnas bab de 'dra'i legs po med/ no'u man ti dbyin ji dang spyi le 140tsam yod pas thag cung ring yang nye 'gram du gru kha yod pas mtsho thog nas ram 'degs byas chog pa ma zad/ 'jar dmag gi 'gog srung yang zhan la mtsho rgyud khod snyoms pas dmag dpung mang po skam sar 'dzeg bde bas g.yul gshom sar shin tu 'os shing 'tsham pas no'u man ti bdams pa red/no'u man ti nas mis bzos gru kha yang bzos pa dang / dbyin ji'i mkha' dmag bzo bkod ched mkhas kyis zhib 'jug byas te stabs bde'i gru kha 'ig bzos/ de ni thog khang lnga brtsegs can gyi khang chen zhig gi che chung dang 'dra la lcags dang ar 'dam gyis grub pa'i khong stong leb chen zhig yin/mnyam 'brel dmag gis bsdoms pa'i rnam pa sna tshogs kyi ar leb 200lhag bzos/ de'i nang nas ches che ba ni mtho tshad la dbyin khre 60dang / zheng la dbyin khre 55yod pa/ ring tshad la dbyin khre 200yod pa dang ljid tshad tun 6000yod pa can yin/mnyam 'brel dmag gis than khe gsar ba skor zhig drangs yod pa dang /de'i nang ches gtso bo ni zher man dbyibs can gyi than khe yin/ der ljid tshad tun 33yod pa dang rang stobs kyis chu la 'jug thub/ de ltar mtsho thog gi stobs shugs shin tu 'dzoms po yin pas 'jar man gyi 'gog srung 'thab rags gtor rgyur gra sgrig byas/mnyam 'brel dmag gi drag chas dang dmag mi mang po dbyin ji'i lho phyogs kyi gru kha so sor gab sbas byas yod pa dang / g.yul 'khrug gi snga nub tu phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i dmag khri tsho 287lhag dang / gru gzings 5000tsam/ gnam gru 13000lhag la nye ba yod/skam sar ma 'dzeg pa'i sngon du/ mnyam 'brel dmag gi ma~X dmag

gis 'gad rdzas tun 366000tsam 'jar man gyi phyogs so so'i 'grim 'grul 'gag sgo dang / rdo snum gter kha/ mkha' 'grul bzo las ma lag dang mkha' dmag gi gnas gzhi'i le ta'i ma lag sogs su 'phangs pa dang dus mnyam du/ dbyin ji li mtsho 'gag la rgya btab pa dang skam 'jogs ru dpung bgrod lam gyi phyogs gnyis kyi chu la 'gad rdzas sbas/thengs 'dir mnyam 'brel dmag skam sar 'dzeg ched kho tshos byed thabs sna tshogs bton nas 'gebs srung byas pa dang / dbyin ji'i gsang 'phrin khang gis cwa le sa khul gyi sa khra 'tshol sdud byas pa ma zad/ 6 lon ton tshod 'dzin tshogs pa zhes pa zhig btsugs nas ched du 'jar man mi la bsru brid byas te gsang 'phrin rdzun ma mang po bsgrags/ de ltar 'jar man mi la phyogs yongs nas mgo bskor te sems shugs nyams par byas/ de bas zla 6pa'i tshes 6nyin skam 'dzeg dmag dpung gis bde blag ngang 'char gzhi legs 'grub byung /mdor na/ skam sar 'dzeg rgyu'i bya ba legs 'grub yong ched/ mnyam 'brel dmag gis dka' ngal khyad bsad kyis dmag don phyogs su shugs bsnan pa red/ dper na men ki ma lis nyin thor bkod pa lta bu ste/ 66nye ba'i zla 'di dag ni brel 'tshub dang dka' sdug gi dus shig red/ phal cher mi tshang mas dka' sdug gi tshad ngo ma shes kyi mi 'dug mi ces bkod yod/'di dag tshang mas 'jar man la mgo skor btang ba sha stag red/ zhi thi les mnyam 'brel dmag skam sar 'dzeg pa'i kha phyogs dang dus tshod kyang go ba log nas/ dbyin ji'i shar lho nas ru dpung 92—97tsam gyi dmag gis zla 7par cwa lir rgol rgyu yin par snyam nas/ dmag dpung gi stobs shugs gtso bo cwa li mtsho 'gag gi phyogs su bkod sgrig byas/ no'u man tir ru dpung sdi/ci darji thon 3gsum gyi dmag ma gtogs bkod sgrig ma byas/ de

bas phyogs de'i 'gog srung stobs shugs shin tu zhan no//mnyam 'brel dmag zla 6pa'i tshes 5nyin dbyin ji li mtsho 'gag brgal rgyu thag bcad kyang / skabs der gnam gshes glo bur du 'gyur nas mtsho ngos su rim pa drug gi rlung chen g.yos pas bya thabs ma byung / skabs der a ri'i gnam gshes rig pa chen po si thā gis tshes 6nyin gyi zhogs pa nas tshes 8nyin bar gnam legs pa'i sngon brda bsgrags pas/ e san ho wer gyis go skabs de rtsod len gyis zla 6pa'i tshes 6nyin zhigs pa'i chu tshod drug dang phyed ga'i steng phyogs bgos kyis skam sar 'dzeg dgos pa'i bka' phab/ 'jar dmag gis gnam gshes la 'gyur ldog byung rkyen mnyam 'brel dmag skam sar slebs mi thub snyam nas nyams snang ci yang med par bsdad/ 'jar man gyi no'u man ti srung ba'i dmag dpon te/ a hphe ri kha gling byang ma'i g.yul 'khrug khrod pham pa'i lung me ar dmag dpon da dung 'jar man na ngal gso ba'in yod la/ kho'i gnas tshul ci yang shes kyi med/zla 6pa'i tshes 6nyin gyi zhogs par/ dbyin ji dang a ri'i gnam gru nas gdugs mchongs mkhan ru dpung gsum tsam gnam gru 2395bsdad nas 'gad gtor gnam gru 2219yis 'gebs srung 'og skam sar babs pa dang /no'u man ti g.yul 'khrug gi yol ba thog mar phyes/ de dang dus mnyam du mnyam 'brel dmag dpung chen po mtsho lam brgyud nas skam sar 'dzeg 'go brtsams/ de nas gnam gru chig stong lhag dang mtsho dmag me skyogs mang pos dus gcig tu 'jar man 'gog srung la phar rgol byas/ o ma hwa (tsho khya)zhes pa'i gru kha'i 'thab 'dzing la dza drag shin tu che na yang mi 34000tsam skam sar 'dzegs pa dang / dmag 2000tsam gron/ tshes drug pa'i dgong mor/mnyam 'brel dmag khri 13tsam skam sar 'dzegs yod/ tshes 12nyin/dmag khri tsho 32tsam skam sar 'dzegs nas rab kha so so mnyam 'brel byas te — 289 go

dang skyel 'dren rlangs 'khor sogs kyang mtsho 'gram du slebs yod/ zla 7pa'i tshes 18nyin/ skam sar 'dzegs pa'i ru dpung la dmag khri tsho 150lhag yod pa dang / skyel 'dren rlangs 'khor khri tsho 33yod/ 'thab 'khrug la mkho dngos tun khri 160lhag yod pas/ mnyam 'brel dmag skam sar 'jog pa'i 'gan 'khur bde blag ngang grub/mnyam 'brel dmag gis glo bur rgol bas/ 'jar dmag nang khul du zang zing lang long du gyur ba dang / lhag par nang khul nas kyang 'gal ba byung bas/ dbyin ji li mtsho 'gag na yod pa'i skyogs gtor ru dpung bdun nyin gsum gyi rjes su da gzod g.yul 'khrug tu zhugs/ yin yang skabs der mnyam 'brel dmag gis g.yul sa phal cher blangs yod/ lung me ar gyis brel 'tshub ngang zhe thi ler glog 'phrin btang nas dmag dpung myur du log dgos par bshad kyang 'phyis drag pa red/ mnyam 'brel dmag gis dus yun ring bor 'gad gtor byas pas 'jar man pham par byas pa dang / lung me ar la yang rmas phog nas phyir bros/no'u man tir skam sar 'dzegs pa'i dmag 'khrug la rgyal kha thob rjes/zla 7pa'i tshes 25nyin nas skam sa nang khul du mdun bskyod byas/ zla 8pa'i tshes 25nyin/ pha ri si mi dmangs 'os langs dang mnyam 'brel byas nas pha ri ser bskyod pas/ hpha zhi si 'jar man gyis yo rob nub mar g.yul 'khrug byed pa'i 'thab rags rtsa med btang /yo rob kyi g.yul sa gnyis pa 'di gsar du gtad pas/ 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis par rgyal kha thob par byas rjes chen po bzhag yod/ des 'jar man dmag kha 'thor du btang ba dang stobs shugs phyogs yo ngas nas zad par byas yod/ lhag par 'dzam gling nas hpha 'i si g.yul 'khrug la ngo rgol byed par skul ma thebs/— 291 —

thad por zhe le'i 'gul gtorari/wa waper lin dmag 'khrug1945lo'i dpyid kur/ su'u dmag la bskud mar rgyal kha thob rjes/yo rob shar mar g.yul 'khrug chen po bslangs te mtha' mar per lin la dpung 'jug byed ched brel 'tshub kyis gra sgrig byed bzhin yod/ nub phyogs su dbyin ji dang a rir no'u man ti nas rgyal kha thob rjes/ thad kur per lin la bzhud bzhin pas/ su'u dmag dang dbyin as per len rtsod pa'i 'gran bsdur gyi 'go bcoms/e san ho wer thengs 'dir rgyal kha thob par yid ches brtan po yod de/su'u dmag ma slebs bar du per lin len thub par snyam/ 1944lo'i zla 9pa'i tshes 15nyin/ khos men ki ma li dang pu'u le ti gnyis la yi ge bskur nas bshad rgyur/ per lin ni dmag thob dngos po rtsa chen yin kho thag red/ngas re ba ni myur du dpung 'jug byed rgyu'i thabs la brten rgyu dang dbyin a mnyam 'brel dmag ru dpung gzhan pa'i 'gebs srung 'og mkhar grong gal chen dag len rgyu dang / de nas gzhogs gnyis nas thad kur per lin la gtugs dgos zhes bris yod/ khos tshod dpags 'di'ang ha cang thal drag pa'i ngang thung gi bya ba 'ig tu 'dug mnyam 'brel dmag lu tsem pog(6550770576〉rsāṣṭha)dang sgyel kram/ 'jar man sa mtshams kyi a tin (༅ṣṭha)sa khul du 'byor ba'i skabs su/ zhe thi les ru dpung 20tsam khrid nas btsan sa bzung yod pa dang / 1944lo'i zla 12pa'i tshes 16nyin gyi zhogs pa'i chu tshod 5dang skar ma 30stong / glo bur du mnyam 'brel dmag la phar nokā sdus rjis zang zing lang long du bzos/ 'jar dmag spyi le 60tsam

gyi sar mdun bskyod byas/ 1945lo'i zla 1po'i stod du phyogs gnyis kyis dmar 'dzing byas pas/ mnyam 'brel dmag gi gnas bab mi legs pa sogs kyi dbang gis rgyal kha ma thob/ chi'u ce ar gyis si ta lin la dmag rogs mi zhu thabs med byung / su'u dmag gis mnyam 'brel dmag skyob ched we si tu'u la chu bo o te chu bo'i g.yul 'khrug nyin brgyad kyi sngon du snar/su'u dmag gis tshur rgol byas pas/ zhe thi les nub phyogs kyi dmag dpung shar phyogs su 'then pas/ nub phyogs dpung shugs je gnyom du song ba dang mnyam 'brel dmag gis nyin bcu phrag 'gar 'thab pas zla 1po'i tshes 28nyin hpha zhi sir btsan 'dzul byed pa'i 'jar man dmag phyir bskrad/thengs de'i g.yul 'khrug khrod mnyam 'brel dmag 77000tsam gron pa dang /'jar dmag 82000tsam gron/thengs 'di'i g.yul 'khrug gis mnyam 'brel dmag gi dus chod la 'gol 'dzol byung du bcug pas/ kho tsho'i 'char gzhi gza' 'khor drug gi rjes su snar/ de bas dbyin as su'u dmag ma slebs pa'i sngon du per len len rgyu'i 'char gzhi stong bar gyur/ skabs 'dir mna' 'brel dmag per lin dang spyi le 480yod la/ su'u dmag per lin dang spyi le 60tsam gyi sar yod pa ma zad/ per lin g.yul 'khrug gi sta gon yang tshar yod/ de'i stabs kyis e san ho wer gyis 'thab 'dzing gi kha phyogs le pe thi dang ti li si'i phyogs su bsgyur nas per lin rtsod len ma byas/ zla 4pa'i tshes 19nyin/a ris le pe thi blangs pa dang / tshes 25nyin/ a ri'i dmag khag dang po per lin lho phyogs kyi spyi le 120tsam yod pa'i ye pe chu bo'i byang rgyud kyi tho'o ko na/ su: dmag dang 'dzoms/ 'di ni ming du grags pa'i ye pe chu bo'i lhan 'a ma 191/5lo'i zla 4pa'i nang / su'u dmag i ti chu bor slebs pa dang per — 293 —

lin la dpung 'jug byed rgyu'i sta gon byas/su'u dmag gis per lin gyi gnas tshul la rgyus lon gsal bo byas nas brtag dpyad 'ib 'jug brgyud 'thab jus legs po bton/ stobs shugs kyi cha nas bshad na/ pe u ru su'i dpung khag dang po dang gnyis pa/ wu kho ren gyi dpung khag dang po/ pho lan gyi mtsho dmag dang mkha' dmag gi dpung khag bco brgyad pa sogs bsdoms pa'i dpung chen 162yod pa dang dmag mi khri tsho 250lhag zin la/ me skyogs 42000dang / than khe 6250lhag gnam gru 7500lhag bcas yod pa ma zad/ da dung su'u dmag gis rang srung 'thab rags sogs gra sgrig gang mang bzos yod/zhe thi les tsa byang phyogs bskyur nas shar phyogs 'dzin pa'i ’ byed thabs dang per lin srung rgyu'i byed thabs spyad/ de yang dbyin a 'i dmag ma slebs pa'i bar du khos stobs shugs yod rgu bton nas su'u dmag gi gdong len dang / dngos gnas bya thabs zad na per lin dbyin ar sprad nas mgo skur rgyu de yin/ de'i phyir/ zhe thi les kyang 'gog srung 'dzing rags mang po bzos pa dang / khor sdom pas dmag khri tsho 100lhag dang / me smyogs 10400lhag than khe 1500lhag gnam gru 3300bcas yod pa las ga'an/gra sgrig dmag dpung brgyad lhag yod la mi grangs khri tsho 20lhag zin/phan tshun gyi stobs shugs bsdur na/ su'u dmag 'jar dmag las ldab 1gis mang ba dang / me smyogs ldab 3gyis ma nga / than khe ldab 3 1gis mang / gnam gru ldab 1 3gyis mang / de las ches gtso che bar gyur ba ni su'u dmag gi stobs shugs dang dpa' ngar la zhum pa med par 66per lin rtsa rdzogs byas nas mes rgyal du phyir log rgyu yin mizhes ngar skul chen po bton/zhe thi les mkhar nas shi yang mi gtong ba dang su'u dmag gis btsan gyirji pha/ ༵la sbyod pa 'dis thengs 'di'i g.yul 'khrug ni shin tu 'jigs

rung 'ig tu 'gyur ba rtogs thub/su'u len dmag gis phar rgol drag po byed rgyu thag bcad de/ nyin 'ag 12— 15nang per len len dgos par sems/1945lo'i zla 4pa'i tshes 16nyin gyi zhogs pa'i chu tshod lnga'i steng phar rgol byed 'go brtsam sa/ zla 4pa'i tshes 16nyin nas 19nyin ni g.yul 'khrug gi dus rim dang po yin/ su'u dmag gis me phyogs khri stong mang po dus gcis tu 'phangs pas/ gnam sa g.yo 'gul byung cing 'jar man gyis chu tshod phyed ku'i ring rgol lan sprod ma thub/ chu tshod 5dang phyed ga'i steng su'u dmag glog sgron chen rngo bkar nas mdun bskyod byas pas 'jar dmag gis mig zung 'byed thabs gral / go skabs de dang bstun nas mu mthud du sol bas 'jar dam ga la pham nyes chen po byung / yin yang 'jar dam ga gis shi bar phangs sems ma skyes par rtsol la na sprad/ zla 4pa'i tshes 19nyin da gzod su'u dmag gis o ti chu bo'i 'gram gyi 'gog srung 'dzing rags gtor nas sa de bzung / de ni per len la 'jug pa'i sgo mo lta bu zhig yin/ zla 4pa'i tshes 19nyin gyi rjes nas/ mkhar bskor ba dang 'jar dmag phyogs gnyis su gtor ba ni g.yul 'khrug gi dus rim gnyis pa yin/ zla 4pa'i tshes 20nyin gyi phyi dro'i chu tshod gnyis pa'i steng su'u dmag gis phyogs ba'i nas bskor/nyin gnyis pa dang gsum par than khe'i dmag dang thon 47sogs 'jar dmag gi nye sar bcar nas mkhar grong g.yul 'khrug gi 'go brtsams/ zla 4pa'i tshes 25nyin/ pe u ru su'i dmag dang wu kho ren gyi dmag per lin nub phyogs kyi pa'o tshi than nas rgyal kha'i ngang mjal 'dzoms byung pas/dbyin a'i dmag dpung per len la 'jug pa'i lam bcad zin pas zhe thi les dbyin a'i dmag la mgo sgur rgyu'i 'char gzhi'ang gtor zin/zla 4pa'i tshes 26nas zla 5pa'i tshes 8nyin ni per lin gyi ༵༵ mjug

mtha'i dus rim gyi g.yul 'gyed yin/ su'u dmag gis per lin gyi phyogs so so nas rgol rdung drag po byas pa dang sung lam dang lcags lam bzhi mdo tshang ma blangs/ zla 4pa'i tshes 29nyin 'khrug pa je cher gyur/ de ni su'u dmag gis 'jar man ches mtho'i srid 'dzin sde khag mtshon pa'i rgyal dmangs tshogs chen gyi thog khang chen mor phar sol byas pas yin/ thog khang de'i khang shar re re dang khang mig re re nas kyang dmar 'dzing drag po byas/ zla 4pa'i tshes 30nyin/ su'u len dmag gis rgyal kha'i dar dmar thog khang de'i rtse ru bsgrengs ba red/ nyin de'i phyi dro'i chu tshod gsum pa'i steng / dbyin khre50tsam gyi sa 'og srid gzhung na yod pa'i hpha zhi si'i 'go ba zhe thi les rang srog bcad/ hpha zhi si'i 'go gtso ga'an pa ka per dang kho'i chung mas byis pa drug yod par dug blud nas bsad de mtha' mar rang srog bcad/zla 5pa'i tshes 2nyin gyi chu chod 15steng / 'jar man dmag gis ngo rgol byed pa'i mtshams yongs su ba'ag zla 5pa'i tshes5nyin/ nub phyogs su 'gro bar rtsom pa'i 'jar man dmag khag chung ngu dag kyang pham par byas/ zla 5pa'i tshes 8nyin gyi chu tshod 24steng / 'jar man mgo 'bul byas par ming rtags gros tshogs bsdus/ ming rtags 'god par zhugs mkhan su'u len gyi sku tshab ni dmag dpon kru'u kho hphu dang phyi 'brel pu'u krang we zhin si ci yin/mnyam 'brel dmag gi 'thus tshab dbyin ji'i mkha' dmag dmag dpon the ti dang a ri'i mkha' dmag dmag dpon si pa si/ hpha ran si'i spyi khyab dmag dpon ti tha zhi ne bcas yin la/ 'jar man phyogs kyi 'thus tshab ni skam dmag dmag dpon khe the ar dang mtsho dmag dmag dpon hpho li ti pa'o/mkha' dmag dmag dpon thu'u mu'u phu'u hpho sogs yin/ mgo 'dzul yi ge de ni 1945lo'i zla 5pa'i tshes 9nyin nas nus pa thon par gtan la phab pa dang /hpha gi se19 ༷ja man rtsa rdzogs byas pa dngos su khyab bsgrags byas/

thengs de'i nyin 'ag 16ring gi g.yul 'khrug khrod/ 'jar dmag khri tsho 48tsam bzung ba dang lhag ma rnams kyi tshe srog shor/ than khe dang me skyogs 1500tsam dang gnam gru 4500lhag thob la/ da rung dmag gi mkho chas mang po yang thob/ yin yang su'u dmag la'ang pham nyes byung ba tshabs chen yin la/bsdoms pa'i mi khri tsho 30lhag gron/zla 5pa'i tshes 9nyin/ si ta lin gyis yo rob kyi dmag 'khrug ma jug rdzogs pa yin zhes rlung 'phrin nas khyab bsgrags byas/ su'u len mi dmangs dang yo rob mi dmangs kyis dka' ngal chen po myangs nas 'thab 'khrug byas mthar hpha zhi si rtsa med du btang / mo si kho nas me phyogs 1000lhag thengs 30la brgyab nas thob par dka' ba'i rgyal kha de la rten 'brel zhus/yo rob dmag 'khrug la rgyal kha thob nas cung ma 'gor bar/1945lo'i zla 6pa'i tshes 2nyin/ 'jar pan btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis kyang mgo sgur/ de ltar hpha zhi sir rgol ba'i 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa rgyal kha'i ngang mjug rdzogs/ zla 9pa'i tshes 3nyin ni hpha zhi sir rgol ba'i g.yul 'khrug la rgyal kha thob pa'i rjes dran nyin yin par gtan 'khel byas yod/— 297 —

sbyim dzī 'tshan chikhur pa/ ༵ trī/sbyob kā'i'i zlozo rshagod pa/ kārma trī rje tshe ring /da:bya / / phyi rgyal gyi dmag 'khrug dang g.yul 'thab grags can//rdo //sdu//// sdu /bye/ /sdi /zloshā / /lhashāshā rnyi zlekha mkhan/ trī trī/lha )sbya sdi rnyi spriX ṭī :spya swākā rdodri sdi// nga /stu/ //rdobye rdo/rdo/// /snyu di /(2 (13 /sdo 'debs tshad yod kung sis par btab/bye/ / sprichong mkhan /sbru /krodri di /shāX /ba so/ lta/ ṭwāṃ dpe tshong khang /༷/ spriX sgrib thengs/ stuXsdo /bye shā/ ༵ // sngu kārji shā drosgyu /dri/ po brgyab/rinagong/ 132sa978—7—1/bye//baX2—179 11(bod/ 2)

ngaXrmyoXrā /snyomabyes na lang / 'phro 54 5 4 44 du ——— cu //༄8 〉khro/4)/ sbya jo / snye // nye snye/ shā ci 'dzam gling lo rgyus kyi skor/ re // zirgyalagyidamaga'akhrugadangagayularing gragasag // ṭwāṃ ) 'a ma nga dus rangasarir ma'i yo sa kyigayo da/ ( /// :/ ge 'a ma 'gegangasal spyags da/ /— // nub zugs kyirnatshanalhada'ag la spags ga/ da byi rgyal gyi ba da snaspagasathar/ ru / 〉 'dzom 'ag 'gangs ma sazhugatso da/ ( ci 〉 /snye tsho) 'dom 'deng rabasal sa kyisatshi spyan/ tri bye/ 'dom nga'akhruga' gnyisari/ / tsho byi rgyal gyispags5 dardzogadapon/ ci ri 13 978—7 05 09852 4/ /3 9 787 05 09852 〉(3zanga'isru 'u ༷ 4skong rdzostonag — — — 24ska/ 16 00lo
